title: Spend Classification Without Leakage: An Evaluation Harness and What It Changed in a Deployed System
comment: 16 pages, 17 tables. Harness, protocol definitions and code reproducing every number: this https URL
summary: Assigning a standard commodity code to a free-text purchase line underpins enterprise spend analytics, and its reported accuracy cannot be checked. Published results use proprietary data or private samples under undocumented protocols; no two compare and there is no public benchmark. We build a harness with four protocols over 1.26 million labelled purchase lines from two US state governments. Enterprises rebuy continuously, so random splits put matching item text on both sides: 60.7% and 61.2% of test rows, 54.7% and 60.6% byte for byte. On California orders the best classical baseline scores 56.0% on repeated text but 31.9% on novel text, a 24-point gap widening with taxonomy depth. Embedding retrieval shrinks the gap from 23.8 to 19.1 points; a fine-tuned transformer does not escape it. On one corpus leaky evaluation cannot separate retrieval from the transformer, while three leak-free protocols put the transformer 2.3 to 3.6 points ahead, so leaky splits hide real differences, not just flatter both. We derive an upper bound on text-only classifiers from identical text with conflicting codes: 79.4% commodity accuracy on one corpus against 98.4% on the other, so accuracy does not compare across datasets. Spend-weighting the bound reflects the amount field more than labels. In a deployment of 920,927 lines, reviewers accepted 32.4% of suggestions on the novel-text population; 29.7-35.2% brackets benchmark rates near 31.9% and 34.8%. We release the harness in production use.

AI.tldr: 针对企业支出分类（spend classification）任务中普遍存在的"泄漏评估"问题，本文构建了一个基于126万条美国州政府公开采购数据的公开评测框架（harness），包含四种评估协议。研究发现标准随机划分因企业重复采购使60%的测试文本在训练集中已出现，导致报告的准确率虚高；并首次为支出分类任务推导了基于标注冲突的理论上界（ca-dgs语料上为79.4%，wa-amazon上为98.4%），证明跨数据集比较准确率在原则上不可行。该框架已部署到商业产品SpendSide中，将纯文本分类器替换为确定级联，并设置了弃权策略。
AI.motivation: 支出分类（将自由文本采购行映射到UNSPSC等标准商品代码）是企业支出分析的基石，但当前文献几乎全部基于专有数据或私有样本、未公开的评估协议，没有任何两个结果可比，也不存在公开基准。标准随机划分因企业重复采购行为导致严重的训练-测试文本重叠，使得所报准确率实质上衡量的是"记忆能力"而非泛化能力。
AI.method: 基于加州DGS采购订单（ca-dgs，343,484行）与华盛顿州Amazon marketplace支出（wa-amazon，914,683行）两个独立公开数据集构建评测框架。设计了四种评估协议：iid-naive（行级随机划分，保留泄漏）、iid-grouped（按文本分组，无泄漏）、temporal（按时序划分）、supplier（按供应商划分）。评估了多种基线：词级TF-IDF上的朴素贝叶斯/质心/1-NN检索、sentence embedding（all-MiniLM-L6-v2）上的检索与质心、以及微调的DistilBERT。提出基于"相同文本对应不同标签"推导的标注冲突上界（annotation-conflict ceiling）。
AI.result: 主要发现包括：(1) iid-naive协议下ca-dgs和wa-amazon分别有60.7%/61.2%的测试行文本在训练集中已出现，分组后降至0%；(2) ca-dgs上最强经典基线（朴素贝叶斯）在重复文本上得56.0%，在全新文本上仅31.9%，24点差距随分类深度增大；(3) sentence embedding只能将该差距从23.8缩小到19.1点，微调Transformer也未能消除；(4) 在wa-amazon上泄漏协议无法区分1-NN检索与Transformer（差距仅0.3点），但三种无泄漏协议将Transformer优势稳定在2.3-3.6点；(5) 文本分类器的理论上界在ca-dgs商品级仅79.4%，wa-amazon为98.4%，证明跨数据集比较准确率不可行；(6) 部署验证：920,927行商业部署中，新文本上人工接受率32.4%（95% CI 29.7-35.2），落在基准预测的31.9%-34.8%区间内。
AI.conclusion: 支出分类领域缺乏可复现的评测标准，导致当前发表的准确率数字在原则上有缺陷且不可比。本文提供首个公开评测框架与基准，揭示了随机划分协议将分类基准退化为记忆测试的事实，并为该任务建立了基于标注冲突的理论上界。该框架已投入商业产品使用，促成了从纯文本分类到确定性级联+弃权策略的架构变革，并通过外部数据-机制比构进行了现场校验。

title: AkasicMEM: Governed Enterprise Memory for Agents
summary: Agent memory enables enterprise agents to retain knowledge acquired during work and reuse it across tasks and agents, turning execution experience into persistent organizational knowledge. Realizing this potential requires both source--memory integration, through which enterprise sources and accumulated memory can be utilized together, and memory governance, through which shared memory remains subject to organizational policies throughout its lifecycle. These requirements interact when information from enterprise sources persists in memory. As this information is repeatedly derived and reused under changing principals and policies, source restrictions may be bypassed, resulting in information leakage. Preventing such leakage requires authorization continuity, under which source restrictions remain effective throughout source-to-memory and memory-to-memory derivation and reuse. Existing approaches address these concerns individually, but do not treat source--memory integration, memory governance, and authorization continuity as combined core design targets across the memory lifecycle. We define Governed Enterprise Memory as agent memory designed around this combined scope and present AkasicMEM as its realization. AkasicMEM realizes authorization continuity through transitive lineage, policy composition during memory formation, and policy re-evaluation during retrieval. It is built on GraphAI's AkasicDB, a unified vector--graph--relational database whose storage and execution substrate enables the underlying operations of these mechanisms to be jointly optimized and executed.

AI.tldr: AkasicMEM提出"受治理的企业记忆"(Governed Enterprise Memory)概念,通过在统一向量-图-关系数据库AkasicDB上实现传递性谱系、策略组合和检索时策略重评估三个机制,在记忆全生命周期中维持授权连续性,防止企业源数据通过记忆派生绕过访问限制导致的信息泄露。
AI.motivation: 企业智能体记忆中,源自企业数据源的信息在被派生、重用并形成新记忆的过程中,原有的访问控制限制可能被绕过,导致信息泄露。现有方案未能将源-记忆集成、记忆治理与授权连续性作为贯穿记忆生命周期的联合设计目标。
AI.method: 定义"受治理企业记忆"范式,核心为授权连续性的三大机制:(1)传递性谱系(transitive lineage)——记录源到记忆及记忆到记忆的派生边;(2)策略组合(policy composition)——形成时通过公式 A^t(m)=R^t(m)∩∩_{x∈anc^t(m)}R^t(x) 计算有效授权;(3)检索时策略重评估——延迟式惰性重计算被标记为过时的组合策略。通过去分类(declassification)机制作为受控例外。在AkasicDB(统一向量-图-关系数据库)的单一执行底座上联合优化这些操作。
AI.result: 提出了一个端到端的受治理企业记忆系统AkasicMEM,在单一数据库执行基质上统一处理关系型源数据、向量检索、图谱系遍历与策略评估,确保源数据访问限制在整个记忆派生与重用链中持续有效,并支持完整的决策审计。
AI.conclusion: 企业智能体记忆的关键问题不在于功能堆叠,而在于跨整个生命周期的依赖结构管理。授权连续性应作为核心设计原则;随着派生深度增加,累积限制与共享知识价值之间的张力(需通过受控去分类缓解)将成为企业智能体记忆的核心设计难题。

title: Generating Query Context for Relational Databases
summary: Relational databases are the systems of record for business applications, and there is growing demand to query them through natural language interfaces. A key challenge is that AI models need appropriate query context, i.e., sample questions paired with their corresponding data-model fragments, to generate accurate SQL. Today, creating this context is a manual, time-consuming process that requires expertise in both SQL and the database schema, leading to a cold start problem for new databases and an ongoing maintenance burden as schemas and query patterns evolve. We present an automated approach for generating query context for relational databases. Our method defines query flows that capture common patterns of data retrieval and analysis questions, systematically generates data models by traversing these flows, and instantiates them with specific values sampled from the database using weighted strategies that maximize diversity and coverage. The resulting question--data-model pairs can be used to guide natural language interfaces in accurately querying relational databases. We report on our experience deploying this approach across more than 50 real-world databases connected to Tursio.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种自动化生成关系数据库查询上下文（query context）的方法，通过定义查询流（query flows）、构建数据模型（data models）并使用加权采样策略从数据库中实例化具体值，生成问题-数据模型配对，以指导大语言模型更准确地生成SQL查询。该方法已部署在50多个真实数据库中，解决了手动创建样本查询对的冷启动问题和维护负担。
AI.motivation: 随着生成式AI驱动的自然语言接口（NLIDB）在关系数据库查询中日益普及，AI模型需要合适的查询上下文（样本问题配对应的数据模型片段）才能生成准确的SQL。然而，当前创建查询上下文依赖人工编写，需要同时具备SQL和数据库schema的专业知识，导致新数据库面临冷启动问题，且随着schema和查询模式演变，维护负担沉重。部分系统（如Databricks Genie）还对样本数量设限（如100条），增加了覆盖率优化的难度。
AI.method: 方法包含三个核心步骤：(1) 定义查询流（query flows）：构建包含7个层级（动词、度量、计数、层次、级别、值、日历/日期过滤）的结构化模板，每条路径对应一种数据检索/分析模式；(2) 生成数据模型：通过遍历查询流，按算法1系统化地构造包含project、select、join、aggregate、order、limit等关系操作的规范查询树；(3) 采样策略：对度量采用分层配额采样（区分可聚合level-1和不可聚合level-2度量），对级别采用逆频率概率加权（抑制高频列、抑制以"number/count/id"结尾的列），并使用贪心多样化策略减少度量-级别组合的重复。所有问题-数据模型配对通过模板生成自然语言，无需LLM改写。
AI.result: 基于50多个真实企业数据库的部署经验发现：(1) 最多约10,000个问题-数据模型配对即可充分引导LLM，覆盖大型企业schema；(2) 端到端生成仅需2-3分钟（包括嵌入到pgvector向量库），可作为例行流程随schema演化重新生成；(3) 完全消除冷启动问题，新数据库无需人工示例即可接入；(4) 模板生成的自然语言句式（如"Show total revenue by city where country = Germany"）与人工撰写的流畅问题同样有效，因为其作用是传达模式-片段映射而非供人阅读；(5) 组合性（composability）比单纯多样性更重要——每个配对暴露的小数据模型片段可被LLM组合，回答单个配对未覆盖的复杂问题，提高对查询流外表述的稳健性。
AI.conclusion: 本文将查询上下文形式化为"问题+数据模型片段"配对，视为教导LLM准确查询关系数据库的机制（根植于五十年的query-by-example研究）。提出的自动化生成算法结合查询模式模板、schema分析和数据采样技术，构建规范查询树。实际部署证明，相比Genie、Cortex等依赖人工编写样本的系统，该方法能以低成本系统性覆盖schema元素和数据点，主动枚举查询空间而非依赖已有查询历史或人工反馈，代表了从"被动收集上下文"向"主动生成上下文"的范式转变，与TextQL等确定性编译方法及Myriade、Genloop等自动构建上下文的系统方向一致但更前置。

title: Proof-of-Retention: A Framework for Auditable Cross-Organization Data Sharing
summary: The rapid adoption of AI across industries for (e.g.) fine-tuning and analytics has accelerated the need for high-quality data. To satisfy this demand, public and private entities will buy and sell data with other organizations. But such data sharing can and does violate privacy norms and laws. EU and American lawmakers have endeavored to control data sharing, restricting what data may be shared with whom, and under what circumstances. Unfortunately, accurately assessing compliance with new regulatory regimes remains a challenge, as data provenance, that is, metadata about data sharing, is rarely preserved. And even when provenance information is retained, unilateral changes to one party's database can render the provenance stale. To fill this gap, we present Proof-of-Retention a novel framework and interactive protocol that enforces auditable data sharing. Our framework requires each party involved in data sharing to retain a subset of information associated with each data exchange, and provides a mechanism for auditors to verify that the parties have indeed retained that information. Our approach combines techniques from database systems, including query witness generation, with cryptographic proof-of-possession protocols to provide retention guarantees. The framework enables efficient auditing that does not require full data replication or intrusive monitoring, thereby preserving privacy and remaining practical. We formalize the protocol, analyze its security and performance properties, and provide a reference implementation built on AWS infrastructure.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了 Proof-of-Retention 框架，通过要求数据交换各方保留见证（witness）并结合密码学证明持有协议，实现跨组织数据共享的可审计性，在不暴露敏感数据的前提下检测出溯源异常。
AI.motivation: AI 与数据分析的快速发展推动了大量跨组织数据交换，但现有隐私法规（如 CPRA、GDPR）缺乏有效的合规审计手段。核心问题是数据溯源（provenance）信息往往未被保留，或因一方对数据库的单方面修改而过时，导致无法判断数据交换是否合规。本文旨在解决这一审计空白。
AI.method: 方法包含三部分：(1) 形式化数据交换契约（定义 sender 和 destination 的保留义务、有效见证和满足见证的概念）；(2) 引入可信第三方 broker 执行共享协议（生成挑战、记录溯源映射）和验证协议（基于哈希承诺的交互式证明，要求源方在不知道原始见证的情况下用随机 nonce 计算哈希以证明保留）；(3) 基于 AWS Nitro Enclave、DuckDB、S3/KMS 设计参考实现，保证 broker 即使在不可信云环境中也不泄露敏感数据。
AI.result: 本文为理论框架，没有实验结果。主要贡献为：(1) 形式化了跨组织数据交换中的见证、溯源异常和可审计契约；(2) 设计了支持前向/后向溯源查询、保护隐私的共享与验证协议，并通过密码学分析证明未保留数据的方仅以可忽略概率通过审计；(3) 提供了基于 AWS 的参考实现架构，展示了使用 TEE（受信执行环境）保护见证和查询结果的可行性。
AI.conclusion: Proof-of-Retention 是迈向"查询中心"型数据保留义务的第一步。相比传统"数据中心"型义务，基于见证的保留要求更精确地保留了回答合规问题所需的信息，同时支持隐私保护的验证。该框架补充而非取代数据最小化原则，是确保已发生数据交换可被审计的机制。未来工作可扩展到其他溯源形式（如 how-provenance、where-provenance）以及更复杂的查询场景。

title: Databases with Missing Values that are Governed by Missingness Mechanisms
summary: We address the problems of giving a semantics to a relational database (RDB) that has missing values (MVs). The causes for the latter are governed by a Missingness Mechanism that is modelled as a Bayesian Network (BN) that involves the DB attributes as variables. The BN is called a Missingness Graph (MG). Our approach considerable departs from the treatment of RDBs with NULL (values). The combination of the MG and the observed DB allows us to build a block-independent probabilistic DB. We identify two optimal classes of its possible worlds on which QA can be performed. Those classes jointly capture probabilistic uncertainty and statistical plausibility of the implicit imputation of MVs. We obtain tractability results for the computation of some optimal classes; and we also obtain complexity results that characterize the computational feasibility of our approach.

AI.tldr: 本文针对带有缺失值（MVs）的关系数据库，提出了一种基于缺失机制（Missingness Mechanism, MM）的语义框架。将MM建模为贝叶斯网络（Missingness Graph, MG），结合观测数据库构建块独立概率数据库（BID）。在此基础上定义了两类最优可能世界类：最大概率类（MPC）和最大一致类（MCC），并对相关查询应答问题进行了复杂度分析。
AI.motivation: 传统关系数据库中处理缺失值的方式（如NULL）存在语义模糊的问题。本文旨在利用领域知识（以贝叶斯网络表示的缺失机制）为带有缺失值的数据库提供更合理的语义，同时联合考虑概率不确定性和统计合理性两个维度。
AI.method: 1. 将缺失机制建模为贝叶斯网络（Missingness Graph），包含原始属性、指示变量等节点。2. 基于观测数据库和MG构建块独立概率数据库（BID），其中每个含缺失值的元组生成一个概率块。3. 将可能世界按多重集等价性划分为"匹配类"，定义两类偏好类：(a) Most-Probable Classes（MPC）：概率最大；(b) Most-Compliant Classes（MCC）：与MG诱导分布的统计距离最小。4. 利用凸可分距离将MCC问题归约为最小费用流问题。5. 利用矩阵Permanent技术分析MPC问题的复杂度。
AI.result: 1. MCC语义：计算单个最大一致类可在多项式时间内完成（FP）；枚举所有MCC可在多项式延迟内完成（DelayP）；但计数问题（#MCC、#MCW等）是#P完全问题。2. MPC语义：Class Probability是#P完全问题；决策问题MPC[D]在NP^PP中；约束版本CMPC[D]{=}是PP完全的，CMPC[D]{=,≤}是NP^PP完全的。3. 总体上MCC的计算性质优于MPC。4. 在MCAR和MAR机制下，概率可从观测数据中恢复。
AI.conclusion: 本文为带有缺失值的数据库提供了一种基于贝叶斯缺失机制的语义框架，其中MCC语义兼顾了计算可行性和统计合理性。对于实际的概率可恢复情形（MCAR/MAR），该方法具有较好的实用性。未来工作包括混合语义（结合概率和一致性）、学习缺失机制、检查观测数据与MG的一致性等。

title: Discovery-Driven Integration of Disjoint Tables via Text
summary: Integrating heterogeneous datasets within data lakes is a critical challenge, particularly for semantically related tables that lack the explicit attributes needed to be joined. We study Discovery-Driven Integration, where the relevant sources and their missing relational structure must be discovered before integration. In this setting, unstructured text provides the evidence that connects otherwise disjoint tables. The fundamental challenge is to discover the relationships at a fine-grained level that connect individual rows from different tables through specific sentences. We formalize this task as Text-Mediated Join Path Discovery and propose a horizontal bidirectional cross-attention architecture called LOKI Latent-space Optimization for Knowledge Integration) that learns contextualized representations of table rows and sentences. Through a global table-text contrastive objective, fine-grained row-sentence associations emerge without explicit local supervision. Existing multi-modal discovery methods largely retrieve coarse-grained column-text associations, whereas integration systems assume supplied row-text links, schemas, or queries. LOKI instead transforms these implicit associations into explicit, interpretable join paths, organizes them into relation-consistent groups, and materializes them as typed integrated tables with sentence-level provenance. Comprehensive evaluations on real-world benchmarks demonstrate that LOKI consistently outperforms state-of-the-art multi-modal data discovery approaches, and materializes typed integrated tables with 0.982 macro typed-pair precision while being up to 40 times cheaper in LLM API cost than direct prompting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LOKI模型,通过水平双向交叉注意力架构,利用非结构化文本作为桥梁,自动发现并整合原本无法连接的异构表格数据,实现"发现驱动的整合"。
AI.motivation: 数据湖中包含大量异构表格与文本,但现有方法要么仅做粗粒度的表-文关联发现,要么假设行-文链接和文本模式已知,无法自动发现并整合通过文本证据连接的原本不相连的表格。
AI.method: LOKI包含:(1)冻结的句子编码器ξ进行行/句嵌入;(2)水平双向交叉注意力模块(前向R→S、反向S→R),通过共享LoRA适配投影和门控机制生成上下文嵌入;(3)由五部分组成的复合损失函数(全局表-文对比损失、局部行-句边际损失、蒸馏损失对齐教师分布、SIGReg正则化、Sinkhorn注意力均衡);(4)推理流程包括候选发现、自适应阈值与互Top-k过滤的原子链接提取、文本中介连接路径构建、HDBSCAN聚类及LLM泛化函数G生成关系标签。
AI.result: 在FEVEROUS、ProTrix、Pharma和MIMIC-IV四个基准上,LOKI在行-句关联AP指标上全面超越基线与单向注意力变体;在Pharma跨方向检索MAP达0.78(文档→表格),在完整2240候选池下F1@8和MAP约为TaBERT的3倍,且速度快32倍;在MIMIC-IV端到端整合任务上,类型化对精度达0.982,LLM token消耗仅为直接提示的约1/3,API成本降低约40倍,但覆盖率低于直接LLM提示。
AI.conclusion: LOKI成功将粗粒度表-文监督转化为细粒度行-句关联,将其组合为证据支撑的文本中介连接路径,并物化为带溯源的类型化整合表,证明非结构化文本可作为发现异构表格间潜在关系结构的显式证据;未来工作将聚焦于可索引检索表示以扩展数据湖规模、通过本体感知校准提升G函数的命名质量,并提高行-句关联的召回率。

title: Do Synthetic Personas Predict Real Audience Response? A Sim-to-Real Study Where a No-Persona Baseline Beats Persona-Based Copy Simulation
summary: Marketers increasingly use large language models (LLMs) as "synthetic personas" to predict how an audience will react to a piece of copy before it ships, encouraged by evidence that profile-conditioned LLMs mimic human samples. But is that prediction actually valid against real behaviour - and does the persona machinery help? We present a sim-to-real validity study using the Upworthy Research Archive - thousands of headline A/B tests on shared real traffic, with measured click-through - as held-out ground truth. We compare a ten-persona panel, grounded in the real audience's demographics, against a no-persona zero-shot baseline that simply asks the model how likely a typical reader is to click. Two findings stand out. First, ground-truth reliability is the binding constraint: most A/B tests have no statistically distinguishable winner, so validity can only be measured on the reliable subset (n = 399). Second, and counter to the persona-simulation premise, persona conditioning degrades predictive validity: the no-persona baseline ranks variants markedly better (Kendall {\tau} = 0.361, a medium effect; top-1 accuracy 49.2%) than the persona panel ({\tau} = 0.084; top-1 34.6%), with non-overlapping confidence intervals. Asking the model directly taps an accurate population-level prior; forcing it to role-play specific personas injects bias and noise. The result replicates across three independent Upworthy splits, holds in direction on a different-domain news dataset, and is robust to seed, prompt phrasing, and model choice - across three Gemini tiers and a different model family (OpenAI gpt-4.1, significant paired gap). The takeaway: for predicting aggregate engagement, a plain LLM ranker beats persona simulation - synthetic personas are not merely a weak predictor, they are worse than not using them. All numbers regenerate from a public, artifact-first replication package.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过使用Upworthy A/B测试档案作为真实地面真值，对基于合成persona的文案模拟进行了sim-to-real有效性测试。结果表明：1）数据可靠性是核心约束（仅23.5%的A/B测试具有统计显著赢家）；2）出人意料的是，无persona的零样本基线（Kendall τ=0.361，top-1准确率49.2%）显著优于10人persona面板（τ=0.084，top-1准确率34.6%），结论跨多个数据集和模型（Gemini三个层级、OpenAI gpt-4.1）均成立。这表明对于预测聚合参与度，persona条件化不仅无益，反而有害。
AI.motivation: 营销人员日益使用LLM作为"合成persona"来预测受众对文案的反应，这种做法被称为"硅采样"，并有研究表明profile-conditioned LLM能模仿人类样本。然而，该前提——合成persona能预测真实受众行为——很少针对真实结果进行测试，因为缺乏将具体文案与真实受众反应配对的地面真值数据。此外，persona机制本身是否有助于预测仍属未知。
AI.method: 采用sim-to-real有效性协议：1）以Upworthy研究档案中数千次标题A/B测试作为留出的地面真值；2）通过单侧双比例 z检验（p<0.05）筛选出具有可靠赢家的测试（399/1695，23.5%）；3）构建10人persona面板，基于Pew研究的人口统计数据构建；4）构建无persona零样本基线（单一"典型读者"提示）；5）使用gemini-3.1-flash-lite作为主评估模型，每个预测平均3次蒙特卡洛抽样；6）以package内排序（Kendall τ、Spearman ρ、top-1准确率）作为评估指标；7）预注册效应量阈值（τ, ρ ≥ 0.10），使用bootstrap置信区间（10,000次重采样，种子42）；8）跨三个Upworthy分割、MIND新闻、Reddit标题进行复现；9）跨三个Gemini层级和OpenAI gpt-4.1进行模型稳健性测试。
AI.result: 核心结果：1）只有399/1695（23.5%）的A/B测试具有统计可靠赢家，其余的真实点击差异与噪声无法区分；2）在可靠赢家测试中，无persona基线Kendall τ=0.361（95% CI [0.289, 0.430]），top-1准确率49.2% [44.2%, 54.3%]（随机基线30.4%），属于中等效应；3）10人persona面板τ=0.084 [0.020, 0.147]，top-1准确率34.6% [29.8%, 39.1%]，属于小效应且置信区间与基线不重叠；4）复现结果：三个Upworthy分割均显示基线优于面板（τ差距0.28-0.32），MIND新闻显示方向一致但差距小（0.038），Reddit标题两者均接近零；5）三种Gemini模型与OpenAI gpt-4.1均显示基线优于面板；6）六种聚合规则（中位数、修正均值、Borda排名融合、Condorcet配对多数等）均未能恢复基线效度；7）persona面板在识别最差变体上略优于识别最佳变体（37.1% vs 34.6%）。
AI.conclusion: 对于预测聚合参与度（如点击率排序），直接查询模型的总体先验（无persona零样本方法）优于让模型扮演特定persona的方法。persona条件化注入了偏差和噪声，产生了"漫画化效应"而非仅仅增加噪声——角色扮演以对特定persona的刻板猜测替代了准确的总体先验。在1695个测试中仅399个具有统计显著赢家这一事实表明，地面真值可靠性是评估此类模拟器的核心约束。该研究提供了一个可复现的sim-to-real有效性协议（含可靠性过滤、构造匹配启发和persona-free基线），可推广到更强的地面真值和其他文案领域。但研究也存在外部效度局限（数据为2013-2015年英语编辑性标题）、构造差距（陈述点击意图≠显示点击行为）、以及设计选择未穷尽（提示、心理画像persona、链式思维等）等威胁。

title: Do Existing Preconditioners Improve Biomedical Tabular Foundation Learning? An Empirical Study on TabPFN Optimization
summary: Tabular foundation models have recently shown strong potential for structured biomedical data analysis. Among them, TabPFN has emerged as an effective approach for low-data tabular classification tasks. However, the impact of optimization and preconditioning strategies on biomedical fine-tuning remains largely unexplored. In this work, we present a comprehensive empirical investigation of five AdamW-based preconditioning strategies for fine-tuning TabPFN v2.5 on 59 biomedical datasets spanning Alzheimer's disease, breast cancer, schizophrenia, significant memory concern (SMC), KEEL biomedical datasets, and UCI biomedical benchmarks. The evaluation considers predictive performance, computational efficiency, and statistical significance analysis. Experimental results demonstrate that the original AdamW optimizer consistently achieves the best overall performance and statistical ranking, while existing curvature-aware preconditioners fail to provide reliable improvements across diverse biomedical learning scenarios. The findings suggest that generic preconditioning approaches may not adequately capture the optimization characteristics of biomedical tabular learning, motivating the development of biomedical-aware preconditioners specifically tailored for healthcare-oriented tabular foundation models.

AI.tldr: 本文对TabPFN v2.5在59个生物医学数据集上微调时的五种AdamW类预条件策略进行了全面实证比较，发现标准AdamW优化器在预测性能和计算效率方面均持续优于现有的曲率感知预条件方法，统计检验证实其优势显著。研究表明通用预条件方法不适用于生物医学表格学习，呼吁开发领域特定的生物医学感知预条件器。
AI.motivation: 表格基础模型（如TabPFN）在生物医学数据分析中展现出强大潜力，但下游微调阶段的优化策略（尤其是预条件方法）对性能的影响尚未被充分研究。生物医学数据通常具有小样本、高维、不平衡和噪声大等特点，使得优化策略对模型收敛稳定性、泛化能力和校准可靠性至关重要。现有研究多关注架构改进和数据预处理，而将优化视为次要实现细节，这一假设在生物医学场景下存在严重问题。
AI.method: 以TabPFN v2.5为骨干架构，系统评估五种基于AdamW的预条件优化变体：(1) 标准AdamW；(2) AdamW-Diag（对角曲率近似）；(3) AdamW-Fisher（Fisher信息矩阵引导）；(4) AdamW-LBFGS（拟牛顿近似）；(5) AdamW-Shampoo（结构化矩阵感知优化）。实验在59个生物医学数据集上进行，涵盖阿尔茨海默病（3个）、乳腺癌（16个）、KEEL生物医学（6个）、精神分裂症（3个）、显著记忆关注SMC（5个）、UCI二分类生物医学（16个）和UCI多分类生物医学（10个）。采用80:20分层划分、5次随机种子重复实验、StandardScaler特征标准化。学习率5e-4，权重衰减0.01，20个epoch，余弦退火调度器。评估指标包括Accuracy、Sensitivity、Specificity、Precision、FMeasure、GMean以及训练时间、推理时间、GPU/RAM消耗。统计分析采用Friedman检验和Nemenyi事后检验。
AI.result: 标准AdamW在所有七个生物医学基准类别上均取得最高的平均准确率，平均秩次为1.81（最优），显著优于其他四种预条件方法。AdamW-Shampoo以2.78的平均秩次成为最接近的竞争者，性能差距保持在2.5%以内。AdamW-Diag、AdamW-Fisher和AdamW-LBFGS表现不稳定，性能波动较大。Friedman检验统计量χ²F=52.0404，Iman-Davenport统计量FF=16.4076（超过临界值F(4,232)=2.4106），Nemenyi检验临界差值为0.7942，证实AdamW与所有竞争方法之间存在统计显著差异。计算效率方面，各方法推理时间和GPU内存消耗几乎相同；AdamW通常训练时间最短，AdamW-LBFGS训练时间最长且GPU内存消耗最高。
AI.conclusion: 现有通用曲率感知预条件方法（对角、Fisher引导、拟牛顿、结构化矩阵）无法在多样化的生物医学表格学习场景中可靠地超越标准AdamW优化器。原因包括：曲率方法依赖的二阶统计量在小样本不平衡数据上不稳定、AdamW的解耦权重衰减提供更好的隐式正则化、对临床异质性的鲁棒性更强、以及更低的调参复杂度。研究呼吁开发生物医学感知预条件器，需结合不平衡感知梯度缩放、特征依赖建模和噪声鲁棒的曲率估计，专门面向低样本高维表格学习。

title: 4DGS-JEPA: Temporally Compositional Joint-Embedding Prediction for Dynamic Gaussian Splatting
summary: Dynamic Gaussian Splatting provides an explicit representation of evolving 3D scenes, but existing approaches are primarily optimized for reconstruction, future-state generation, or rendering rather than for learning reusable predictive dynamics. We propose 4DGS-JEPA, a Gaussian-native joint-embedding predictive architecture for causal multi-horizon prediction over dynamic Gaussian scenes. The model uses a hierarchical scene-, motion-group-, and Gaussian-level representation together with a horizon-conditioned transition operator that supports both direct prediction and recursive rollout. Its central principle is temporal composition: different chronological transition paths reaching the same future endpoint should produce compatible predictive states. Endpoint and multi-horizon path supervision anchor these predictions to future target embeddings, while a selective geometry decoder and geometry-level composition ground the learned dynamics in consistent group motion and Gaussian geometry without requiring complete future appearance reconstruction. We further introduce a hybrid correspondence mechanism that combines persistent canonical identity with residual optimal-transport matching under reordering and topology change. We characterize zero-loss path agreement and finite-error rollout accumulation theoretically. Three controlled experiments provide mechanism-level evidence that temporal composition reduces latent path dependence while retaining predictive accuracy, geometry-level composition improves consistency of decoded motion, and hybrid correspondence preserves reliable identity while remaining robust when correspondence becomes ambiguous. Together, 4DGS-JEPA provides a predictive, temporally compositional formulation of dynamic Gaussian worlds.

AI.tldr: 本文提出4DGS-JEPA，一种面向动态高斯泼溅（Gaussian Splatting）的联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA），其核心学习原则是"时间组合性"（temporal composition）：通过不同时间路径到达同一未来端点应产生兼容的预测状态。模型采用分层（场景/运动组/高斯级）表征与水平条件过渡算子，结合端点监督、路径监督和时序组合一致性损失；通过选择性几何解码器将潜在动力学映射为显式的SE(3)运动与协方差形变，并采用混合对应机制（持久规范ID + 最优传输）处理重排序和拓扑变化。在受控实验中对三个机制分别提供证据。
AI.motivation: 现有动态高斯泼溅方法主要针对重建、未来帧生成或渲染进行优化，缺乏对可复用的预测动力学的学习。JEPA类方法虽能从视频潜在空间中预测未来，但缺乏显式3D高斯表示。作者旨在将联合嵌入预测的优势与显式高斯世界动力学结合，并解决"到达同一未来的不同路径应产生一致预测"这一组合性问题。
AI.method: 方法核心包括：(1) 学生-教师分层潜在状态（场景/运动组/高斯级token）；(2) 水平条件过渡算子Φ_ϕ 支持直接预测与递归展开；(3) 三种互补损失：端点监督L_end、路径监督L_path（锚定递归生成状态）、时序组合L_comp（直接预测与组合路径间的双向一致性）；(4) 选择性几何解码器Q_ψ^G 预测群级SE(3)增量、局部非刚性残差、协变形变和存在概率；(5) 几何级组合L_gcomp 约束直接与组合解码路径在群变换和高斯几何上的一致；(6) 混合对应机制：固定持久规范ID，剩余质量由Sinkhorn正则化OT处理；并提出刚体、平滑、静态三种结构先验。理论上证明了零损路径一致性命题与有限误差递归展开的Lipschitz界。
AI.result: 三个受控实验在程序生成的高斯轨迹上验证：实验1表明时序组合将CompErr降低60.6%，同时维持目标相对精度（直接FDE改善3.6%）；路径监督将递归漂移Δ_roll降低约31%；组合性泛化至未见的时序分解。实验2表明SE(3)组合将群变换路径差异E_T^dc降低72.2%（Δ=8），完整几何组合将高斯级D_match降低32.5%。实验3在混合置换、裂变/合并、出生/死亡扰动下，Hybrid对应机制在每个严重度下均优于纯OT（LineageMass更高、几何差异更低），并在ID被遮蔽时优雅退化。
AI.conclusion: 4DGS-JEPA将联合嵌入预测原则成功迁移到显式高斯世界表示，提出了"时序组合性"作为动态高斯场景预测的核心学习原理，并通过分层潜在结构、选择性几何解码器和混合对应机制实现了在保持目标精度的同时显著降低预测路径依赖。论文提供了理论分析（零损一致性与有限误差界）和机制级实验证据，但目前仍处于小规模受控验证阶段，未来需扩展到实际动态场景重建、多模态预测、大规模高斯集和动作条件规划等场景。

title: An Accurate and Interpretable Hyper Graph Neural Network for GBM Survival Prediction
summary: Survival prediction for glioblastoma multiforme (GBM) demands models that are both accurate and interpretable, yet existing approaches treat these objectives as com- peting, where performant models sacrifice transparency, while interpretable models accept degraded predictive power. We argue that this trade-off is not inherent. Graph neural net- works offer a structural foundation for extracting interpretable, explainable representations without compromising discriminative ability. Furthermore, current methods typically rely on a single imaging modality, underutilizing the complementary information available across multi-modal MRI and clinical metadata. We propose a multi-modal framework that inte- grates three components to address both objectives simultaneously: (1) a sheaf hypergraph neural network that captures higher-order relationships among tissue patches through direc- tional, asymmetric message passing; (2) a concept bottleneck layer that compresses learned representations into clinically grounded concepts, enforcing ante-hoc interpretability; and (3) an extension sufficiency test (EST) regularizer that penalizes unfaithful explanations during training, ensuring that model explanations genuinely reflect the internal decision process. Clinical and genomic features are incorporated through gated fusion, preserving the dominant prognostic signal of molecular markers while retaining concept-level traceabil- ity. Evaluated on 593 patients from the UPenn-GBM dataset under 5-fold cross-validation, our framework achieves a concordance index of 0.643 with the lowest fold-level variance among all compared models (std = 0.015). To our knowledge, this is the first work to unify sheaf hypergraph convolution, concept bottleneck supervision, and EST regularization for interpretable survival prediction from brain MRI

AI.tldr: 提出 SheafHGNN + 概念瓶颈 + EST 正则的多模态 GBM 生存预测框架，在 UPenn-GBM 593 例上 5 折 CV 取得 C-Index 0.643（std=0.015），在不牺牲准确性的前提下实现概念级可追溯且保真的解释。
AI.motivation: GBM 临床决策需要既准确又可解释的生存预测模型。现有方法常将准确性与可解释性视为对立：高性能模型缺乏透明度，而可解释模型预测能力下降。此外，现有方法多依赖单一成像模态，未充分利用多模态 MRI 与临床/基因组信息的互补性。此外，后置 GNN 解释方法常出现“看似合理但不忠实于模型内部推理”的问题，影响临床信任。
AI.method: 1) 从六种 MRI 模态（T1-pre、T1-post、T2、FLAIR、DTI、Perfusion）提取 16×16 patch 块，每块 1536 维向量作为图节点；2) 构建拓扑+特征双空间超图，捕获局部空间邻域与跨区域概念相似；3) 三层 Sheaf 超图消息传递（带方向性约束映射与拉普拉斯归一化），学习高阶组织关系；4) 通过概念瓶颈层将节点嵌入压缩为 8 个临床概念（增强比、FLAIR z 分、T2 异常、DTI MD/FA、异质性、边界、空间位置），由预计算概念真值以 MSE 监督；5) HECRL 多头自注意力细化概念间依赖；6) 注意力加权池化获得图级表示；7) 门控融合 + 交叉注意力整合影像与 18 维临床特征（IDH1、MGMT、KPS 等）；8) 离散时间分箱 NLL 损失 + Kendall 不确定性任务加权 + 配对排序损失（λ=0.5）训练生存头；9) 训练时引入 EST 正则（λ=0.1），惩罚解释子图外节点对预测的扰动，确保解释忠实性。
AI.result: UPenn-GBM 593 例 5 折 CV：E6 配置 C-Index 0.6431±0.015（全模型最低方差，且 5 折均≥0.62），E7 最高 0.6435±0.023；时间依赖 AUC 在 6/12/18 月分别为 0.726/0.737/0.697；Kaplan-Meier 三分位风险分层在所有折上 log-rank p<0.005；概念预测 Pearson r>0.80（DTI MD 与生存相关 ρ=+0.142, p=0.046；增强比接近显著 ρ=−0.133, p=0.061）；EST 正则下 0% 充分性拒绝率。对比 DeepSurv（0.6502±0.028）、MRePath（0.6419±0.021）、HyperCBM（0.5346±0.021），E6 在统计上显著优于 HyperCBM（p=0.002），与其他基线无显著差异但方差最低。临床融合贡献最大（+18.2%），超图 +1.5%，概念瓶颈 −3.7%，EST +0.9%。
AI.conclusion: Sheaf 超图、概念瓶颈与 EST 正则的统一框架证明了 GBM 生存预测中准确性与概念级可解释性并非互斥。E6 在匹配图基线精度的同时，以最低的折间方差实现了临床可追溯的概念分解，为基于 MRI 的脑肿瘤预后提供了稳定、忠实、可审计的模型。临床融合是主导预测信号；超图结构与 EST 正则显著提升稳定性；8 概念瓶颈为影像推理提供结构化接地。建议后续工作扩展至多中心队列、纵向建模与更细粒度概念体系。

title: Ovis-Embedding: Pushing the Frontiers of Universal Omni-Modal Embeddings
summary: In this report, we introduce \textbf{Ovis-Embedding}, a state-of-the-art omni-modal embedding family built on native integration of text, image, video, and audio. Instead of assembling separate modality towers, Ovis-Embedding uses a shared multimodal backbone to encode different modalities in a common representation space. Specifically, we make \textbf{three key advances}: (1) \textbf{native omni-modal initialization}: we adopt a pretrained Qwen-omni model as the embedding backbone and adapt it through contrastive training with low-rank initialization; (2) \textbf{data-centric omni-modal training}: we construct a broad, high-quality corpus spanning text, images, video, audio, and interleaved multimodal data. To improve data efficiency, we introduce homogeneous-source sampling to form task-consistent batches with informative in-batch negatives; and (3) \textbf{embedding-specific training and inference optimization}: we use focal loss to emphasize hard examples and similarity-based Embedding Distillation to transfer fine-grained similarity structure from complementary experts. At inference time, low-rank feature decomposition enables compact embeddings with flexible dimensionality and minimal performance loss. Empirical evaluations show that the \textbf{Ovis-Embedding} family achieves state-of-the-art performance on \textbf{MMEB-v3}, \textbf{MMEB-v2}, \textbf{MVEB}, \textbf{MAEB}, and \textbf{RTEB}, demonstrating its effectiveness across text, image, video, and audio modalities. These results highlight the potential of unified omni-modal training to overcome modality fragmentation and advance universal embedding models for any-to-any retrieval.

AI.tldr: Ovis-Embedding 是一个面向任意到任意检索（any-to-any retrieval）的通用多模态嵌入模型家族，基于 Qwen-Omni 原生多模态骨干，通过共享表示空间统一文本、图像、视频和音频的嵌入，在 MMEB-v3/v2、MAEB、MVEB 和 RTEB 五大基准上取得 SOTA 性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的多模态嵌入模型要么仅支持视觉-语言对、缺少音频支持，要么将音频分支后期拼接到视觉-语言嵌入器上，导致细粒度跨模态对齐受限。本文旨在构建一个原生支持文本、图像、视频、音频的通用全模态嵌入模型，实现真正的任意到任意检索。
AI.method: 1. **原生全模态初始化**：采用 Qwen2.5-Omni-3B 作为骨干，丢弃 Talker 模块，使用最后非填充 token 的最终层隐藏状态作为嵌入，不引入额外的投影头；2. **数据为中心的全模态训练**：构建约 50M 训练对，覆盖文本、图像、视频、音频、交错多模态及智能体数据，提出同源采样（homogeneous-source sampling）形成任务一致的硬负例批次；3. **嵌入特定训练与推理优化**：四阶段训练——低秩对比预训练（结合 Focal Loss 强调困难样本 + Embedding Distillation 迁移教师分布）、全参数同源微调、退火式嵌入蒸馏（基于学生置信度的自适应 KL 权重）、低秩特征分解实现弹性嵌入维度（128/256/512/1024/2048）。
AI.result: - **MMEB-v3**：Ovis-Embedding-Omni-3B 总体得分 58.46，在全部 6 个模态组（图像 77.55、视频 64.99、视觉文档 78.26、文本 47.15、音频 50.08、智能体 45.52）均排名第一，超越最强基线 Tianmu-Emb-Uni（53.27）5.19 分；- **MAEB**：Mean(Task) 57.29、Mean(Type) 61.22，Borda 排名第一；- **MVEB**：Mean(Task) 61.77、Mean(Type) 59.72，在零样本分类、视频分类、检索、配对分类、视频问答 5/6 任务类型上第一；- **MMEB-v2**：VL-9B 总体 81.13（+1.04），VL-2B 总体 77.46（+2.04）；- **RTEB**：67.35，略超 Qwen3-Embedding-4B（67.27）；- **弹性嵌入**：2048→128 维度仅损失 6.8%，16 倍压缩后仍保留 93.2%，显著优于朴素截断（85.8%）。
AI.conclusion: Ovis-Embedding 证明了基于原生全模态理解模型构建统一嵌入空间的可行性，通过共享骨干替代分离的模态塔，成功打破了模态碎片化，为通用任意到任意检索建立了新的 SOTA 基线，并为社区开源了模型检查点、训练配方与统一评估工具包。

title: X-Planner: Event-Structured Task Planning for Embodied Intelligence
summary: Task planning bridges high-level instructions and executable behavior in long-horizon manipulation, yet modern Vision-Language-Action (VLA) systems often leave this intermediate structure implicit. Existing chain-of-thought (CoT) planners also tend to rely on coarse task-level annotations or serialize long reasoning traces token by token. We present X-Planner, a planning front-end that addresses both the supervision and representation of embodied reasoning. Our planning data combine Ego, UMI, and teleoperation under a hierarchy granularity with source-dependent annotation depth. Takeover-time annotations and human-designed failures supervise ongoing error recognition. On the model side, a shared VLM backbone exposes two event-structured plan forms: a discrete interface that emits interpretable event states and a latent interface that relays continuous CoT states across staggered Transformer depths through Staircase Decoding. A frozen latent-to-text reconstruction objective provides a semantic anchor for the latent representation. Offline two-step planning evaluation places X-Planner second among four evaluated models on both BERTScore-F1 and a judge-based Overall score. In real-robot experiments, respectively, outperforming the evaluated baselines. These results characterize planning-text quality and downstream execution.

AI.tldr: X-Planner 是一种面向具身智能的规划前端，旨在解决 VLA 系统中任务规划结构隐式化与推理序列化效率低的问题。它通过事件结构化的数据监督和双路输出方案（离散事件状态与潜在连续 CoT），在离线规划文本质量与真实机器人任务执行方面均取得了较好的表现。
AI.motivation: 现代视觉-语言-动作（VLA）系统在长时序操控任务中存在三大瓶颈：(1) 数据层面——任务级标注掩盖了诸如抓取、修正等细粒度的子目标与执行错误的内部事件结构；(2) 粒度层面——固定语义层级无法契合动作级"语义事件"作为可执行行为的时间一致性单元；(3) 延迟层面——逐 token 自回归解码的链式思考（CoT）产生了过长的串行依赖路径，且长显式推理链易发生错误传播。该研究旨在以事件作为规划的基本单元，在监督粒度与解码机制上联合弥补上述三大缺口。
AI.method:
1. 数据层面：融合 Ego、UMI 与遥操作三类数据，构建 L3 Task / L2 Subtask / L1 Action / L0 Segment 的共享层级；根据数据源差异施加不同标注深度（Ego、UMI 保留 L1–L3，遥操作保留全部四级）。对干预事件标注接管时间以支持运行中错误监督，并补充人工设计的失败演示以均衡错误分布。
2. 模型层面：基于 Qwen 系列 VLM 主干网络，提供 (a) 离散事件状态输出：发出可解释的有序初始计划、当前/下一事件、归一化进度、继续状态与回合结束标记；(b) 潜在连续 CoT 输出：通过"阶梯式解码（Staircase Decoding）"，将推理状态沿错位的 Transformer 层级跨深度中继，使共享的下层视觉-语言上下文可在上层并行推进，减少串行依赖。通过冻结的潜变量到文本重建目标为潜在表征保留语义锚点。下游世界-动作模型保持冻结，事件描述或潜在状态经共同信号输入以交叉注意力方式调控动作生成。
3. 训练目标：结构化监督（SFT）针对离散 assistant 响应；特征对齐损失使 VLM 输出与下游原始文本特征空间兼容；潜变量到文本重建损失仅优化阶梯推理分支与前缀投影器。
AI.result:
1. 离线两步规划评估中，X-Planner 在 BERTScore-F1（0.9011）与 Doubao Judge Overall 评分（1.411）上均位列四款模型第二，超过 Qwen 与 Doubao，低于 kimi3。
2. 在真实机器人（桌面双臂）评估中，事件模式下 X-Planner 条件化系统在推理操控套件上取得最高平均 Task Progress 71.60%（超过最强基线 U-Scratch 59.50% 共 12.10 pp）；在泛化套件（杂乱桌面场景下指令条件迁移）上取得 53.75%，超过 DreamZero（28.50%）、π₀.₅（24.00%）、U-Scratch（18.50%）。
3. 数据层面：对 1500 集确定性筛选子集的分析显示，该池覆盖 41 个原子动作标签、30 个命名任务类别及尾部分布，主体由刚性物体（58.2%）、场景定位（39.4%）与办公/公共场景（28.5%）构成；中位数含 5 个子任务、37.1 秒时长，第 90 百分位为 15 个子任务、113.1 秒。
AI.conclusion: X-Planner 以"语义事件"为规划基本单元，在共享 VLM 主干上统一显式与潜在两种推理表征。阶梯式解码缩短了潜在规划器的串行路径，冻结的潜变量到文本重建目标为连续表征提供语义锚点；结构化事件描述则提供可被人或上游代理检视与编辑的可读接口。在离线条文质量与真实机器人执行两方面均优于若干基线，但落后于 kimi3；离线指标不构成统计显著性，端到端延迟与两种规划形式的受控对比仍需进一步评估。局限还包括回合结束标签仅标记媒体边界而非语义成功、训练时使用注释派生的历史（产生"预言机上下文"缺口），未来工作包括流式在线规划修订、移动/人形平台评估以及系统级时序测量。

title: Lean Pool: An AI-Maintained Archive of Formalized Mathematics
comment: 52 pages, 6 figures. Includes a catalogue of imported projects
summary: Lean Pool is a repository of formalized mathematics. It is grown, maintained and optimized by AI agents.

AI.tldr: Lean Pool是一个由AI代理生长、维护和优化的形式化数学仓库，旨在成为arXiv在形式化数学领域的对应物，收录已完成的研究级数学形式化项目，并随Lean/Mathlib演进而持续保持兼容性。
AI.motivation: 随着生成式AI在数学研究中的进展，数学论证的产出速度超过了人类阅读消化的速度，形式化验证日益成为瓶颈。Lean/Mathlib生态虽已成为主要验证平台，但其数学库因线性增长的人力审查而无法覆盖大量研究级数学。本文动机在于：(1) 形式化证明不仅需保留源码，还需随依赖库演化保持兼容并支持复用；(2) 为已完成的形式化项目提供一个常青、可归因、可检索的公共家园，弥补arXiv在"可机器检查"层面的空白。
AI.method: Lean Pool采用AI代理驱动的维护模式：(1) 增长路径——通过AI代理发现Apache-2.0/MIT许可下的形式化项目并归入仓库，以及人类贡献者直接提交；(2) 维护机制——AI代理在Mathlib版本变更时自动bump版本并修复错误，定期优化代码以缩短编译时间、降低内存占用；(3) 质量保障——Lean内核保证证明正确性，严格linter与LLM审查共同保障定义与定理陈述质量，CI结合全库构建、Mathlib声明/源码linter及仓库专属质量门禁（含项目卡片、归因、公理限制、proof/file尺寸、绕过检测等）；(4) 数学审查服务对faithfulness、novelty、新颖性、重要性、来源与代码质量进行评估；(5) 文档体系包含Index、Exposition（基于Lean ML工具，展示项目卡片、非正式描述、依赖图与声明查看器）及Zulip公告；(6) 入库规则要求无sorry/admit、无新增公理（仅Classical.choice/propext/Quot.sound）、无set_option滥用、需完备项目卡片与许可证明。
AI.result: 截至2026年9月观测时点：(1) 仓库含211个已完成项目、7,043个Lean源文件、3,228,485行代码、193,862条声明命令、837条注册主结果，18名贡献者；(2) 项目来源构成——70项人类撰写、102项AI生成、39项混合；(3) 兼容性证据——6次Lean版本升级中，AI辅助修复使编译器失败从44/59降至3/148；(4) 优化成效——库级proof压缩移除45,217行（构建时间缩短3.3%）、certificate简化（缩短3.6%）、elaboration优化（缩短5.8%）；(5) 数学审查——278份项目报告中绝大多数予以批准；(6) 复用证据——在LeanEval结构审计中成为"匹配声明最多的外部仓库"，多个研究级后续形式化项目重用了存档数学（如Kurosh子群项目复用有限图span生成树基础）；(7) 干净构建——Lean Pool 60.28分钟 vs 同向Mathlib 37.44分钟（源规模3.23 vs 2.33 MLOC）。
AI.conclusion: Lean Pool证明：将已完成的形式化项目汇聚到一个由AI代理辅助升级、优化、审查的共享环境中是可行的；其运行历史记录了反复维护的可行性，LeanEval审计展示了存档数学在后续研究中的复用；随着越来越多的数学论文附带形式化证明，该仓库为保留其归因、维持依赖可用性并使形式依赖关系镜像数学文献广度网络提供了基础设施，未来有望成为arXiv在形式化层面的对应物。

title: The AI Neuroscientist: An Interactive Agentic Interface for Neuroimaging Analysis
summary: Analyzing neuroimaging data requires specialized coding and statistical expertise, which limits accessibility for researchers without computational backgrounds. We present the AI Neuroscientist, a language agent for interactive data exploration. The system integrates a large language model (LLM) with a neuroimaging toolset to perform quality control, modeling, and visualization. This allows researchers to query data quality and specify analysis parameters directly in natural language, providing a transparent and interactive alternative to conventional scripted pipelines for small-scale data exploration. We demonstrate these capabilities using functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) data, and evaluate the agent on a custom fNIRS benchmarking suite against general-purpose LLM agents with code sandboxes. Future extensions will generalize the architecture to additional modalities, including functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) data, and expand the benchmarking suite to additional fNIRS tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个名为"AI Neuroscientist"的交互式智能体系统，利用大语言模型（LLM）结合专门的功能性近红外光谱（fNIRS）工具集，让无编程背景的研究者能够通过自然语言完成神经影像数据的质量控制、统计建模和可视化分析。系统在自建的fnirs_bench基准测试中显著优于通用LLM编码智能体（总体得分0.79 vs. 0.45/0.14），尤其在真实数据的质量控制和伪迹检测任务上优势明显。
AI.motivation: 神经影像分析（尤其是fNIRS和fMRI）需要专业编程和脚本能力，对缺乏计算背景的实验研究者与临床医生构成高门槛；现有标准化流程（BIDS、fMRIPrep、MNE-NIRS等）虽统一了预处理，但仍然要求用户能够编写和审阅代码。论文希望借助LLM智能体作为协调层，把已成熟的领域工具以自然语言方式提供给用户，降低使用门槛同时保留科学严谨性。
AI.method: 方法构建在ReAct/LangGraph架构之上：(1) 阶段化策略驱动的工具调用，按"发现与质控→建模与统计校正→可视化→解释"四阶段严格执行；(2) 精选的fNIRS工具注册表，涵盖SNIRF/BIDS读取、心跳SNR质控、MAD尖峰检测、TDDR运动校正、Beer–Lambert转换、GLM+FDR、可视化与文献检索；(3) 阶段感知的数据路由，对强度/OD/浓度数据采用不同预处理链路；(4) 双轮多模态视觉接地循环，通过图像存储(image store)将生成的拓扑图重新注入LLM进行第二轮回话；(5) 自建fnirs_bench基准，包含心跳质控（T1a-c）、尖峰检测（T2a-b）和解剖定位（T3）六项任务，引入可靠性惩罚（工具轨迹一致性和矩阵方差）对智能体打分。
AI.result: 在fnirs_bench五轮重复实验中，AI Neuroscientist总体得分0.79±0.05，远超Claude-Sonnet-5沙箱代理（0.45±0.07）和GPT-5-nano沙箱代理（0.14±0.06）。在真实数据心跳质控（T1c）和真实运动尖峰检测（T2b）任务上，沙箱LLM接近0分，而专门智能体仍保持≈0.9。AI Neuroscientist还表现出更高的工具轨迹一致性和更低的token开销。端到端案例研究显示系统可自主完成数据发现、质控、阈值协商、GLM+FDR分析、交互式可视化及基于图像的神经科学解释。
AI.conclusion: 论文证明通过约束LLM调用经过精选的领域工具、强制阶段顺序和统计校正、保留每一步的人工可读产物，可以构建既易于使用又科学严谨的神经影像分析代理。AI Neuroscientist在fNIRS交互式探索场景中可行且优于通用代码沙箱代理。未来工作包括：构建自主QC闭环、扩展到fMRI/EEG/钙成像等多模态、扩充基准任务范围，并通过正式用户研究评估其对研究质量与速度的影响。

title: MedGate-Fusion: Integrating First-Encounter Semantic Narratives and Physiological Biomarkers for Prospective Stroke Risk Stratification
comment: 7 pages,2 tables, 2 figures. Submitted to EMBC 2026
summary: Prospective stroke risk stratification in primary care is challenging because early risk signals are distributed across routine biomarkers and unstructured clinical narratives. We propose MedGate-Fusion, a multi-modal gated architecture that integrates transformer-based embeddings of first-encounter narratives with ten routinely recorded risk markers. We used electronic medical record data from the Canadian Primary Care Sentinel Surveillance Network (CPCSSN). Starting from 808,921 encounter-level observations, we constructed a first-encounter cohort and retained 102,736 unique patient records with non-empty narratives and sufficient data to evaluate a five-year stroke outcome. To reduce explicit target leakage from diagnostic mentions in notes, we applied dictionary-based redaction of stroke-related terms prior to semantic encoding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MedGate-Fusion架构，通过门控多模态融合机制整合Transformer提取的首次就诊临床叙事语义嵌入与十项常规生理生物标志物，基于CPCSSN数据集（102,736名患者）实现5年卒中风险的预测性分层。核心创新在于前瞻性首次就诊设计、字典式术语屏蔽防标签泄漏以及上下文门控动态加权融合。Bio-Transformer单模态AUROC达0.842，融合后MedGate-Fusion达0.848（AUPRC 0.346），相比逻辑回归基线提升14.5%。前十分位筛选捕获5倍于随机筛查的卒中病例。
AI.motivation: 现有卒中风险评估工具主要依赖结构化生物标志物，忽视了电子病历中丰富的非结构化临床叙事信息；既往多模态融合研究多为回顾性设计或存在标签泄漏问题，无法实现真正意义上的前瞻性早期风险分层。
AI.method: 1) 数据来源：CPCSSN电子病历，从808,921条就诊记录构建首次就诊前瞻性队列（102,736例）。2) 防泄漏策略：采用时间锚点筛选+字典式术语屏蔽（如stroke/cva/infarct→[MASK]）。3) 语义编码：使用all-MiniLM-L6-v2 sentence-transformer生成384维嵌入。4) 双专家架构：梯度提升树处理数值特征+Transformer处理文本特征。5) 门控融合：sigmoid门控系数α_i动态加权两个分支的类概率预测。6) 加权二元交叉熵损失处理类别不平衡，分层5折交叉验证。
AI.result: MedGate-Fusion AUROC=0.848±0.016，AUPRC=0.346±0.054，Brier分数0.065，较逻辑回归基线提升14.5%（p<0.001）。Bio-Transformer单模态AUROC=0.842，显著优于HGBM数值基线（0.720）。前10%高风险患者捕获率为随机筛查的5倍。文本模态贡献主导，数值特征提供增量校准。
AI.conclusion: 首次就诊临床叙事含有可预测5年卒中风险的潜在语义信号；门控多模态融合有效整合文本与生理特征，提供前瞻性、低泄漏的初级保健风险分层工具。局限性包括CPCSSN区域文档模式泛化性、5年窗口较短及计算开销。未来将验证国际多族群数据集并探索轻量化Transformer架构。

title: When LLM Agents Fail to Read the Room: ReAdapt for Relational Social Reasoning
summary: A social agent's most basic decisions (should I react to this post? who should I reach out to?) are not purely content problems. The right action often hinges on the latent relationship between people -- tie strength, reciprocity, mutual connections -- rather than on which content is most salient. Standard LLM agent loops do not explicitly represent how new relational evidence should revise the agent's current social hypothesis, leaving them prone to surface-obvious choices when relational and content cues diverge. We formalize this failure mode with a relationship-reasoning benchmark: 500 synthetic social worlds with friendships, follows, reaction histories, and feeds, yielding 1,000 queries over two tasks, reaction selection and warm introduction (finding the best bridge to a target person). By construction, the surface-obvious candidate differs from the relationship-grounded oracle in about 53% of queries, forming an overturn subset where the agent must use relational evidence to revise an initially plausible choice. We propose ReAdapt (Relationship-Adaptive Agent with Policy-driven sTate), which augments the ReAct loop with an explicit structured social state z = (G, B, R, N, D) capturing goal, belief, relationship, norm, and disclosure. After each tool observation, ReAdapt runs a typed Adapt step that updates this state and emits a policy operation (continue, switch, abandon, or clarify) before choosing the next action. With Gemini-3-Flash on a stratified subset of n = 150 queries per task, ReAdapt improves warm-introduction accuracy from 37% to 51% (+14 points) and reaction-selection accuracy from 69% to 77% (+8 points). Oracle regret drops from 0.260 to 0.152 and from 0.095 to 0.053, respectively. Holding the model, tools, and environments fixed, these results suggest that explicit relational-state adaptation helps LLM agents turn retrieved social evidence into revised decisions.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出标准LLM智能体循环（如ReAct）存在"证据到决策耦合"的失败模式：当关系线索与内容线索冲突时，智能体虽能检索到关系证据，却无法据此修订初始假设。作者提出ReAdapt框架，在ReAct循环中引入显式结构化社交状态z=(G,B,R,N,D)和类型化Adapt步骤，将观察显式转化为状态变化并发出策略操作（continue/switch/abandon/clarify）。在500个合成社交世界、1000个查询的关系推理基准上，使用Gemini-3-Flash在300个分层查询子集上评估，ReAdapt将热介绍准确率从37%提升至51%（+14点），反应选择从69%提升至77%（+8点），在最具挑战性的热介绍overturn子集上提升16点。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体循环（如ReAct）将检索到的关系证据隐式地整合到语言模型上下文中，缺乏对"当前社交假设如何被新证据显式修订"的表示。当关系线索与表面显著性冲突时，智能体倾向于选择表面明显的候选，尽管证据已表明关系更优的候选存在。这被称为"证据到决策耦合失败"——信息已被获取，但未可靠地改变策略。论文将社交智能的核心从"理解说了什么"转向"理解关系使什么变得恰当"。
AI.method: ReAdapt（Relationship-Adaptive Agent with Policy-driven sTate）在ReAct循环中引入：(1) 结构化社交状态 z=(G, B, R, N, D)，分别表示目标、信念、关系、规范和披露；(2) 类型化Adapt步骤 z_{t+1}=Adapt_θ(z_t, o_t, x)，在每次工具观察后显式更新状态并发出策略操作 ω∈{continue, switch, abandon, clarify}；(3) 下一个动作条件化于更新后的状态和操作 a_{t+1}=π_θ(x, h_{t+1}, z_{t+1}, ω_{t+1})。基准包含500个合成社交世界（8-15个用户，含档案、友谊、关注、互动历史、群组成员和帖子），产生1000个查询覆盖两个任务：反应选择（直接关系评估）和热介绍（间接关系推理）。通过设计关系驱动oracle与表面启发式候选，约53%的查询构成"overturn"子集。
AI.result: 在Gemini-3-Flash上，使用分层300查询子集（每任务150个）评估：热介绍任务准确率从37%（ReAct）提升至51%（ReAdapt，+14点），overturn子集从33%提升至49%（+16点）；反应选择任务准确率从69%提升至77%（+8点），overturn子集从70%提升至76%（+6点）。Oracle遗憾在热介绍上从0.260降至0.152（-41.5%），反应选择上从0.095降至0.053（-44.2%）。ReAdapt平均使用9.4次工具调用，ReAct为8.2次（均远低于24次上限）。
AI.conclusion: ReAdapt通过显式关系状态适配机制，使LLM智能体能够将检索到的社交证据转化为修订后的决策。核心设计原则是：获取正确的社交证据并不充分，除非该证据能可靠地修订智能体的当前决策；社交相关的观察不应仅在上下文中累积，而应改变状态。实验支持这一假设，表明显式状态转换是提升社交智能体关系判断能力的一种轻量级机制。该方法在overturn诊断子集上提升最大，验证了"显式假设修订"对处理表面与关系线索冲突的关键作用。

title: Attention as a Routing Graph: Live Circuit Extraction from a Single Forward Pass
comment: 7 Pages, 5 Figures, 1 table, Code: this https URL
summary: Finding circuits in language models usually means running many careful interventions. We try something simpler: treat attention as a routing map from one forward pass, keep a small set of routes that point toward the answer, and ask whether those routes actually matter. They often do. On induction and IOI (tasks where the "right" circuit is already known), ablating our extracted edges hurts the model much more than ablating a random set of the same size. We evaluate n=100 prompts per cell on GPT-2 Small, GPT-2 Medium, and Pythia-410M, with paired gap tests and bootstrap confidence intervals. The extract step costs one forward; a head-by-head patch sweep costs about two orders of magnitude more. We are not claiming a complete circuit atlas. We are claiming a cheap sketch that carries real causal signal on known tasks, with clear failure modes when it does not. Code and evaluation artifacts are at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种轻量级的电路提取方法：从单次前向传播的注意力图中，沿答案位置反向走几步，保留一个小的路由子图 S，然后通过消融实验验证其因果性。在归纳(Induction)和IOI任务上，该子图比同等规模的随机边集对模型性能的影响更大，且成本比逐头patch扫描低约两个数量级。
AI.motivation: 现有电路发现方法（如activation patching、ACDC、attribution graphs）成本高昂，需要大量干预；而原始注意力权重单独使用又太弱。本文旨在填补两者之间的空白：能否用一次前向传播构建路由图，从中提取指向答案的子图，并验证其因果性。
AI.method: 方法包含四步：(1) 将注意力读为路由图，节点为token位置，边表示(层,头,key→query)；(2) 边评分 s = A[ℓ,h,i,j] · ‖V[ℓ,h,j]‖₂（注意力权重乘以value范数），并忽略BOS sink和自环；(3) 从答案位置 t⋆ 出发，取top-k入边(k=15)，反向走4跳得到子图S；(4) 消融S中的注意力权重并重归一化，与10组同等规模的随机边集对比，以任务分数下降程度衡量因果性。使用GPT-2 Small/Medium和Pythia-410M，每格n=100，配对gap检验+bootstrap CI+Wilcoxon符号秩检验。
AI.result: 全部6个实验格(3模型×2任务)中，配对gap的95% bootstrap CI均不包含0，Wilcoxon p < 10⁻¹⁰。GPT-2 Small上归纳任务gap为+4.33(0/100失败)，IOI为+5.16(0/100失败)；Pythia IOI gap +5.63(0/100失败)。Medium和Pythia归纳有部分失败(11-19/100)。提取仅需1次前向传播(含验证约十几次)，而逐头patch扫描需145次前向传播，成本约低两个数量级。提取的子图常包含已知induction head(如L4H11, L5H5, L5H8)，但并不覆盖完整标准电路。
AI.conclusion: 注意力本身已勾勒出信息流动的路线图，从中提取的小子图在因果消融中往往显著优于随机边集。作者明确声明这不是完整的电路地图，而是一个"廉价的草图"加上因果检验；当需要完备性时，仍应使用更重的电路发现工具。失败模式包括：路径被高分干扰项捕获、跳数预算不足、注意力质量与因果性不等价等。此外，S移除的注意力质量多于随机集，部分gap可能源自质量效应而非纯路由效应，这一偏差尚未量化。

title: Learned Enterprise Data Comprehension: Compression and Routing for Data Agents
summary: Structured-data agents in enterprise settings must reason over complex data environments whose relevant evidence is distributed across schemas, relationships, policies, and recurring business roles. Modern agentic systems often address this burden through reusable markdown-style memory or skill files that preserve previously discovered information for later queries, reducing the need to rediscover the same structure repeatedly. This is useful, but it obscures a natural division of labor: agents are well suited to semantic reasoning, while learned systems are well suited to predicting and organizing recurring structure. We introduce latent equivalence learning to bridge this gap. The framework separates persistent task-relevant identities from their dataset-relative realizations. In our realization, supporting and opposing evidence shape support-realized Gaussian prototypes that learn how those identities are expressed in a particular data environment, while soft-membership profiles retain distinctions lost under a hard assignment. A separate learned query-prototype system represents recurring evidential requirements and maps them through a learned compatibility function into the same persistent identity structure. This identity-factorized, query-conditioned routing materializes the relevant dataset-specific evidence for downstream reasoning, allowing the agent to operate over an already organized evidential state rather than reconstructing cross-schema structure at every query. On the Data Agent Benchmark, spanning 54 queries across 12 heterogeneous datasets, our full implementation achieves 94.67% dataset-macro stratified Pass@1 over five complete trials and 258/270 successful raw query attempts, compared with 55.51% for the benchmark's Claude Opus 4.6 reference agent, ranking first among 40 leaderboard entries at submission.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"潜在等价学习"(Latent Equivalence Learning)框架,将企业数据代理的证据组织问题分解为持久任务相关身份与其数据集相对实现两部分,通过支持-实现的高斯原型和查询-原型路由系统,在下游推理前预先组织和路由证据,在Data Agent Benchmark上达到94.67%的SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有数据代理在企业异构数据环境中面临"三个C"挑战:计算(定位相关证据的工作)、成本(训练与推理资源)和上下文(可同时暴露给语言模型的证据)。当前方法要么依赖代理在每个查询中重新发现模式(如markdown记忆),要么要求单一学习模型编码所有语义。这种职责划分错配导致前沿代理在异构数据问题上表现仍不理想,简单的代理分解和增加交互步骤并不能有效组织证据。
AI.method: 提出潜在等价学习框架:1) 通过支持/反对证据接口将证据对象映射到持久身份集合的软成员分布;2) 用支持实现的高斯原型(基于原型网络的精度加权支持聚合)学习每个数据集的身份实现;3) 独立的查询-原型系统通过学习的兼容性矩阵将查询需求映射到相同身份空间的激活分布;4) 基于预算的证据视图物化将相关支持、反对、竞争证据有界地暴露给"仲裁器"(LLM)再交由数据代理执行。理论分析包括局部分配稳定性证书和符号证据损失到稳定性边界的条件性联系。
AI.result: 在Data Agent Benchmark(54查询、12异构数据集、5次完整试验)上:Permute EQ架构达到94.67%数据集宏分层Pass@1(258/270原始查询成功),而Permute Core(无学习表示)为84.13%,DAB Claude Opus 4.6参考代理为55.51%,在40个排行榜条目中排名第一。逐数据集分析显示在GitHub(50%→100%)、PanCancer(67%→100%)和Deps.dev(60%→90%)上提升最大。代价方面,Opus 5配置下平均每次试验成本$82.82,Sonnet 5配置下$41.10对应82.9%性能。
AI.conclusion: 数据代理性能关键依赖于证据在到达语言模型之前如何被组织。在异构环境中,额外的搜索和代理分解可能扩展探索而不解决核心问题——哪些证据应被比较、保留或暴露。潜在等价学习将组织前置:通过持久任务相关身份表示证据,并物化有界、查询条件化的支持/反对/竞争证据视图。该框架形式上分离了可重用查询需求与数据集特定证据实现,并提供了固定原型库下的局部稳定性边界,共同支撑学习结构跨环境与扰动的可控重用。研究的限制在于需要有限持久身份清单覆盖部署域,以及证据质量与物化预算对性能的影响。

title: Making Agents More Consistent: Skills Should Form Habits for Repeat Tasks
summary: On repeated work, agents are inconsistent. We ran 42 tasks three times each and found that, depending on the model, 38% to 74% returned answers that did not agree. Consistency is what a buyer, an auditor, or a regulator requires, and agents do not have it. They are wasteful too: 95.3% to 97.2% of what an agent generates goes to re-deriving a plan the system already knows. We propose skill habit formation. An agent mines its own execution history for candidate skills, deterministic variants that compete against the incumbent rather than replacing it. A candidate declares the region of input space it claims, so the common case runs as a script and the rest falls through to reasoning. Four gates of ascending cost admit candidates; the central one tests a candidate's execution trace against a retained reference, within a tolerance measured from that reference's own run-to-run variability. On text-to-SQL, three of four reasoning arms reproduced their own output on 11 to 13 of 42 repeated questions and the fourth on 26 of 42, while a habit-formed variant reproduced on all 456 dispatches we repeated and was non-inferior to every arm it replaced (p<0.0001). It also used 14% to 56% fewer tokens, turning net positive after 7 to 53 reuses. We measured what this costs in accuracy. The guard admitted work it should have deferred on 2.6% of natural paraphrases and 26% of inputs near its boundary, and 11 of 13 such failures were invisible to the trace-conformance gate at any threshold. Deterministic errors repeat exactly: a bad habit is as reliable as a good one, and that is the price of the property that makes the system auditable. Separating routing from parameter extraction raised end-to-end accuracy from 0.888 to 0.952 at 43% of the cost.

AI.tldr: 针对大语言模型智能体在重复任务上的不一致性与高昂推理开销问题，本文提出"技能习惯形成（skill habit formation）"架构。其核心思想是将智能体执行历史中可复用的部分提取为确定性的候选脚本，通过覆盖谓词门控（coverage predicate guard）进行调度——已覆盖输入直接走脚本（脚本路径），未覆盖输入则回落至推理路径（推理路径）。候选脚本通过四道成本递增的门槛（C0可恢复性、C1治理合规、C2轨迹一致性、C3生产A/B）才能被接纳，且永不能覆盖其祖先，从而支持指针式回滚。其中C2门借鉴Weyuker伪预言机思想，将候选轨迹与保留参考轨迹进行比对，其容差由参考自身的运行间变异性校准，因此无需人工声明等价关系。文本到SQL实验显示，习惯形成变体在456次重复派发中实现了完全可复现（而四个推理臂仅在11-26/42题上自洽），并将每次服务的token消耗降低14%-56%，在7-53次复用后转为净收益。在检索路由任务上的复制实验亦证实了该机制可迁移。然而，代价是覆盖守卫的错纳率（false admission rate）：在自然改写下为2.6%，在边界输入上达26%，其中11/13例无法被C2门检出（因为一致性检验比较的是参数模式而非参数值）。将路由与参数抽取解耦后，端到端准确率从0.888提升至0.952，成本降至43%。
AI.motivation: 当代智能体系统在重复任务上存在两类根本缺陷：（1）不一致性——四个推理臂在重复任务上有38%-74%无法自洽；（2）算力浪费——推理token中95.3%-97.2%用于重新推导已经掌握的规划流程。前者使系统难以被审计与问责，后者造成大量冗余计算。现有应对方案（评估流水线、提示词优化、护栏）既不记录产出路径，也无法提供"与历史行为比对"这种最廉价的保障。
AI.method:
核心方法为"技能习惯形成"架构，包含以下几个关键设计：
1. **血统模型**：技能被建模为实现同一能力契约的有序变体集合（variant lineage），锚点（最慢的祖先）为不可裁剪的兜底参考。
2. **覆盖门控调度**：每变体附带覆盖谓词 χ_v 与守卫；调度沿血统自下而上，首个接受输入的变体提供服务，锚点兜底全部。
3. **候选生成**：从执行历史中通过回放、反事实扰回放与有界仿真挖掘高确定性子结构。
4. **四道接纳门（C0–C3）**：C0可恢复性探针 → C1治理护栏子集检查 → C2轨迹一致性（与保留参考在consequential/procedural符号上的比对，容差以参考自变异性D_self校准，并通过D_forge/D_sealed划分以防过拟合） → C3生产A/B与人类授权。
5. **守卫设计**：高精度、低召回（偏向拒绝而非错纳）；并分离路由决策与参数提取两个子任务。
AI.result:
主要实验结果：
1. **可复现性**：text-to-SQL上习惯形成变体在所有456次重复派发中输出与参数均完全一致，而四个推理臂仅在11-26/42题上自洽。
2. **非劣性**：习惯形成候选在一次单边非劣性检验中对所有四臂均p<0.0001，pass³=1（推理臂0.76–0.86）。
3. **token节省**：每次服务减少14%–56% token；形成成本7,691 token/模板；在7（Kimi）至53（Sonnet）次复用后转净正。
4. **第二个域（检索路由）**：nine次运行上自冷启动至200条轨迹增益+0.157 [0.116, 0.198]，且在训练时未见过的意图上也得到+0.132 [0.082, 0.182]的增益。
5. **代价**：守卫在自然改写下错纳率2.6%（1/39），在边界压力集上错纳率26%（13/50）；其中11/13例错误对C2门在任何阈值下不可见——因为读查询的Σ_c为空，且Σ_n仅记录参数模式而非参数值。
6. **路由/抽取解耦**：端到端准确率0.888→0.952，成本降至43%；确定性抽取器单独达到0.925，零边际成本。
7. **催化剂失效**：当模板邻接且bundle≥20同时存在时，错纳率达18.8%；单独任一条件均不触发。
8. **架构性教训**：基于纯记忆的守卫被非劣性门完全拒纳，形成平直曲线——非劣性门在证据最少时最严苛，可能死锁学习器。
AI.conclusion: 习惯形成可让智能体在重复任务上获得与底层推理臂相当甚至更优的准确率，同时消除运行间不一致并节省14%–56%的token。其主要代价是覆盖守卫的错纳风险：在自然语言改写下2.6%、在边界条件下26%的输入会被错误地送入确定性脚本而非回落至推理；其中绝大多数对核心一致性门不可见，因为该门比较的是参数模式而非参数值。三条普适教训：（1）路由与参数抽取应解耦为两个独立机制；（2）风险按链累积，而证据按候选评估，需设置最小覆盖底线与重新接纳触发；（3）非劣性接纳门对小而静默的缺陷过于宽松，对初学者又过于严苛，需报告其阻断精度与召回而非仅报告阻断率。生产部署仍需设计并实证评估检测错误习惯与纠正习惯的机制。

title: Potential for Enhanced Learning in Machine Learning Classes by Using Wiki LLM Indexing
summary: Large language models are increasingly deployed as course-specific tutors, but their usefulness depends on grounding in vetted instructional materials that are often revised mid-semester. Our prior work built a multimodal retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) system over an authentic machine learning course corpus (Foundations of Machine Learning) and found that retrieval improved contextual grounding, but that fixed retrieval strategies were suboptimal. That motivates a different question: whether how a corpus is structured at ingest time matters more than how much is retrieved at query time. We present a controlled head-to-head comparison of two knowledge representations over an identical classroom corpus: (A) vector RAG, replicating the best-performing configuration from our prior study, and (B) an LLM-compiled wiki (Karpathy framework), in which the corpus is synthesized at ingest into linked concept pages with explicit cross-references and citations back to source materials. We evaluate 59 questions spanning single-fact recall, cross-unit concept linking, synthesis and explanation, and currency after a syllabus revision, scored by an LLM judge against a human-authored rubric. Both representations answered single-fact questions about equally well (9.33 vs. 9.96 of 10), but diverged sharply on questions requiring links across course units. The compiled wiki remained accurate and grounded (9.93; 100% grounded in cited sources), while retrieval scored lower and was markedly less grounded (8.14; 64%). The wiki's citations let students and instructors trace any claim back to the lecture that introduced it, adding a layer of dynamic retrieval that machine learning courses require. While further testing is needed, instructors using AI to support learning in ML courses should consider wiki-based structure for its potential to support foundational elements of best practice.

AI.tldr: 本文在一门真实机器学习课程语料上对向量RAG与LLM编译Wiki两种知识表示进行头对头对比，发现Wiki在跨页面/综合类问题上显著优于RAG，且能减少生成阶段的"无依据补充"现象，对课堂教学中AI辅导工具的可追溯性与学习效果具有积极意义。
AI.motivation: LLM作为课程专属辅导工具时，必须依赖可信课程材料做接地（grounding）以避免与课程大纲冲突。前期研究发现向量RAG虽改善了上下文接地，但固定检索策略并非最优，且没有单一检索配置能服务所有问题类型。由此重新提出核心问题：语料在入库时的结构化方式，是否比查询时检索多少内容更关键？尤其在内容快速迭代、跨单元概念联系紧密的ML课程中，知识表示本身可能比检索策略更具决定性意义。
AI.method: 在DS3001/DS3021课程的同一语料上构建两种表示并对比：(A) 向量RAG——文本分块（1500 token，100重叠）、all-mpnet-base-v2嵌入、Pinecone索引，top-k=5，复用前期最优配置；(B) LLM编译Wiki（Karpathy框架）——入库时由LLM将语料综合为带交叉引用与源材料引用的概念页面，查询时由LLM导航阅读。控制变量：生成器（Claude Opus 5）、系统提示、上下文预算、问题集、解码参数。问题集从145题筛选到59题，按"topic-page（45题）/cross-page（14题）"与"factual/conceptual/synthesis/sensitivity"四类标注。评测：GPT-5 mini作为独立评判（避免自评），给出1–10整体分与二元groundedness标记；以20000次bootstrap估计问题采样误差的95% CI；用四个已知质量答案对评判器做了校准验证。
AI.result: 整体上Wiki优于RAG：平均分9.95 vs 9.05（差距CI [0.42, 1.44]），接地率98% vs 81%（差距CI [7, 27]个百分比），两CI均不跨零。按问题类型分：topic-page题上Wiki 9.96/98% vs RAG 9.33/87%，分差CI [0.16, 1.18]、接地率差11pp（CI [0,22]刚好触零，是研究中唯一未达95%显著性的对比）；cross-page题上Wiki 9.93/100% vs RAG 8.14/64%，分差1.79（CI [0.57, 3.14]）、接地率差36pp（CI [14,64]）。机制层面：RAG的11个未接地答案中仅2个为检索失败，其余9个虽检索到正确页面仍补充了原文不支持的细节——说明部分接地差距源于生成阶段而非检索阶段，结构化表示同时约束了内容获取与生成外推。
AI.conclusion: 在该语料规模上，Wiki在两类问题上均领先RAG，跨页综合类问题的优势约为单页查找类的三倍，这与Cochran (2026)在研究语料上的发现方向一致；但作者强调这是方向性证据而非普适结论，因为Wiki组因固定索引覆盖所有目标页面而没有"上下文选择失败"环节，RAG组则在21向量的小索引上承受检索失败风险。核心机制发现是：结构化表示不仅帮助检索，还抑制了生成器对检索片段的过度外推，这挑战了将RAG短板归因于检索质量的常规叙事。对教学实践，Wiki的引用可追溯性使学生能沿任一论断回溯到原始讲义/幻灯片/阅读材料，这与间隔复习、检索练习、跨情境提取等促进持久学习的学习科学原理一致；在内容快速迭代的ML课程中，Wiki的"原始材料+综合概念页"结构天然契合按周推进的课程组织方式。建议未来工作：课堂实证、混合架构（RAG+Wiki）、更大语料、图RAG对照、更难题集以及零基线模型对照。

title: Clarification Is Not Correction: LLMs Fail to Let Go
summary: Dialogue failures in language models are usually framed as memory failures: context too long, summaries lossy, a constraint forgotten. We argue this misses a deeper problem: in many conversations the model does not forget, it commits too early. An ambiguous early turn collapses into a single hidden interpretation, and later clarification is filtered through that commitment. We call this early posterior collapse: unresolved user intent collapsing into a committed task state before ambiguity is resolved. We study it with controlled dialogue tasks in writing, planning, and coding using Gemini-2.5-Pro and Gemini-2.5-Flash. Across thousands of trials, the same information in different orders yields different outcomes, even when the final dialogue contains equivalent task-relevant information. This order effect suggests later clarification is treated as extra context rather than a corrective signal: it refines a stale task state without invalidating it. Coding tasks are especially vulnerable, suggesting early assumptions get embedded in structured artifacts such as interfaces and control flow. Standard prompting and memory strategies do not reliably help: summaries can collapse ambiguity, and chain-of-thought can reduce explicit wrong commitment in reasoning traces without improving final task success. These findings motivate uncertainty-preserving state management. If assistants cannot let go of early interpretations, robustness cannot rely on post hoc correction alone; it must keep ambiguous early turns from hardening into one task state. Assistants should hold tentative hypotheses while ambiguity remains, ask before executing when high-impact ambiguity persists, and rebuild from a revised state when later evidence invalidates an earlier reading. Rather than one prompting fix, we aim to redirect research for interactive LLMs from retaining more context toward preserving uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"早期后验坍缩"概念,指出LLM在多轮对话中的核心失败模式是过早将模糊用户意图坍缩为单一任务状态,后续澄清被视为对旧假设的"补丁"而非真正校正,导致"旧假设污染"。通过写作、规划、编程三类任务的对照实验,验证了信息呈现顺序影响结果,编程任务最易受影响,标准提示与记忆策略均无效,并据此提出"保留不确定性的状态管理"研究方向。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多将LLM对话失败归因于"记忆失败"(上下文过长、摘要丢失、约束遗忘),但作者认为这忽略了更深层问题:许多对话中模型并未遗忘,而是过早承诺,导致后续澄清无法真正修正已硬化的早期任务状态。需要一种新的诊断与研究框架来刻画这一失败模式。
AI.method: 1. 理论框架:将对话建模为开放潜变量上的增量贝叶斯推断,定义"早期后验坍缩"与"旧假设污染"。2. 诊断实验套件:290个生成任务+20个手工试点+30个对抗任务,覆盖写作、规划、编程,用Gemini-2.5-Pro/Flash评估,约7160次试验、13900次API调用。3. 对照条件:完整/先澄清/先模糊三种信息顺序;4种基线方法(原始历史、摘要记忆、CoT、单状态账本);K假设消融;回滚与两阶段响应策略等机制性干预。4. 关键评估指标:旧假设污染、确认-修订差距、错误承诺率等。
AI.result: 1. 路径依赖:先模糊条件下成功率下降(Pro从50.0%→42.8%,Flash从55.4%→45.7%)。2. 任务脆弱性差异显著:编程任务成功率最低(24.4%)、污染最高(0.256),约为写作的两倍。3. 确认-修订缺口:编程+7.1%,模型口头承认修正但未实质修订。4. 常规策略失败:摘要记忆增加污染(0.177→0.228),单状态账本更高(0.295),CoT不提升任务成功率。5. 62.5%的摘要坍缩了不确定性。6. 机制干预有效:显式回滚将污染降至0,两阶段策略同时消除错误承诺与污染;但仅作机制验证,非通用解。
AI.conclusion: 对话鲁棒性应从"记住更多内容"转向"保留假设的认识论状态"。模型即使收到、承认了澄清,仍可能因未真正失效旧假设而输出受污染的结果。需构建不确定性保留的状态管理:维护候选假设集合、追踪高影响未解决槽位、在澄清到达时显式作废被否定的假设,并从修正后的状态重新生成而非对旧输出打补丁。论文定位为研究方向的重定向,而非单一提示技巧的解决方案,未来工作应在更多模型族、更强记忆/工具智能体、人类评估下复现并形式化。

title: From Decorative to Load-Bearing: Task Difficulty Shapes the Causal Role of Chain-of-Thought
comment: Accepted to Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR), September 2026. Code/ dataset available at the project repository and huggingface
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring is only meaningful if written reasoning causally constrains the answer. We introduce continuation-based causal testing, an ablation-patch intervention that perturbs one reasoning step, truncates the chain, and forces the model to continue from the corrupted prefix. It measures how load-bearing a CoT is for the final answer, a behavioral notion distinct from mechanistic faithfulness. Across Gemma-2-9B-IT, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B on GSM8K, MMLU, and BIG-Bench Hard, CoT load-bearingness tracks model-relative task difficulty: on easy tasks models silently bypass their own reasoning; on hard tasks they follow corrupted steps and propagate errors. A matched 2x2 analysis shows task difficulty dominates perturbation type: error propagation rises 16x from GSM8K to BBH multistep arithmetic, and a variance partition over 28,584 continuations attributes 98.8% of explained deviance to task difficulty versus 0.8% to perturbation type. Reasoning-specific RL suppresses error propagation and compresses the gradient. A four-variant judge-sensitivity analysis and blind two-annotator study (n=500) show the error-propagation vs. non-propagation label is invariant to judge prompt, with perfect inter-annotator agreement (Cohen's kappa = 1.00). This gradient creates a structural problem for CoT-based oversight and AI safety monitoring: where the trace is easy to read it carries little signal, and where it matters errors propagate before a monitor can intervene. Linear probes on hidden states separate silent bypass, self-correction, and error propagation, but additive activation steering provides limited causal control, flipping only about 25% of error-propagation cases at best. Behavioral mode is readable but not reliably controllable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"基于续写的因果测试"(continuation-based causal testing)方法，通过扰动单个推理步骤并强制模型从被破坏的前缀继续生成，衡量思维链(CoT)对最终答案的因果约束力（"负载承载性"）。核心发现是CoT的因果作用随模型相对任务难度从"装饰性"过渡到"负载承载性"：在简单任务上模型静默绕过自己的推理，在困难任务上则严格遵循被破坏的步骤并传播错误。变差分解表明任务难度解释了98.8%的偏差，扰动类型仅解释0.8%。这给基于CoT的监控带来了结构性困境。
AI.motivation: Chain-of-thought prompting常被提议作为监控语言模型推理过程的基础设施，但监控的有效性前提是书写的推理链确实因果性地约束最终答案。先前行为研究发现CoT经常不忠实（rationalization、提示依赖等），但这些研究难以大规模区分是计算忠实还是行为忠实。本文旨在通过受控因果干预量化CoT→答案这一因果链接的强度。
AI.method: 1. 基于续写的因果测试：对模型已正确回答的多步推理题，解析CoT为步骤，随机扰动其中一个步骤，截断后强制模型从被破坏的前缀继续生成。2. 七种扰动策略（两类数学+五类概念），三种位置（早/中/晚），三种强度。3. 三分类行为标注：Type A（静默绕过）、Type B（自我纠正）、Type C（错误传播）。4. LLM judge（Claude Haiku）+ 四种prompt变体进行鲁棒性验证，n=500双盲人工标注作为金标准。5. 隐藏状态线性/MLP探针（42层Gemma、PCA降维到128维）。6. 激活加法干预（单方向+多方向8向量基）。7. 匹配2×2设计分离扰动类型与任务难度的混淆。
AI.result: 1. 21,238条Gemma-2-9B-IT续写中错误传播率随难度上升：GSM8K 3.9% → MMLU 22.3% → BBH 40.9%。2. MMLU 29个学科在固定格式下错误传播率跨度7倍（7.5%-53.7%）。3. 匹配2×2 + 变差分解（n=28,584）：任务难度98.8%，扰动类型0.8%，交互0.4%。4. 在同一数值扰动下，错误传播从GSM8K到BBH多步算术上升16倍。5. Llama-3.1-8B完整复现难度梯度（6倍上升）；DeepSeek-R1-Distill因推理RL训练广泛抑制错误传播并压缩梯度。6. 探针可检测行为类型（3类MLP 75.3%，错误传播MLP 86.2%），但激活加法干预仅能翻转约25%错误传播案例（A类几乎无法移动）。7. C-vs-non-C标注对judge prompt不变（四个变体完全一致），双标注员完全一致（κ=1.00）。8. 位置梯度：扰动越靠后错误传播越低（33.5%→27.4%→22.5%），但主要由难度驱动。
AI.conclusion: CoT→答案链接的因果负载承载性是模型相对任务难度的连续函数，从装饰性过渡到负载承载性。任务难度主导扰动类型约两个数量级。这给基于CoT的AI安全监控造成结构性两难：易读时无信号，关键时错误在监控干预前已传播完成。隐藏状态探针可读出行为模式但加法激活干预无法可靠控制，意味着该梯度目前是只读不可写的。推理专用RL后训练（DeepSeek-R1-Distill）部分抑制错误传播并压缩梯度。方法论上，基于规则标签的探针99.9%准确率在改用judge标签后降至75%，是关于标签质量上限的一般性警示。

title: Robust Failure, Conservative Repair: Textual Knowledge Distillation from Cross-Model Failures
comment: 16 pages, 2 figures. Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Main track)
summary: Failure-based textual knowledge distillation aims to discover gaps in a model's knowledge by examining its task errors. The distilled knowledge can be useful for the reasoning of both this model ("source model") and other models. However, this transfer of knowledge may not be stable. We define a rule atom to be a standalone rule injected into a model's textual input at inference time. A rule atom can encode transferable task knowledge or model-specific reasoning patches that can confuse other models. Also, the injected rule atoms can be misapplied to unrelated cases, causing the model to incorrectly flip its answer based on irrelevant information. Building on a pipeline that distills training examples into task-specific cheat sheets that aid model reasoning, we examine when failure-derived rules can improve these cheat sheets. Our early experiment shows rule distillation from a single model's failures underperforms the baseline cheat sheet on non-source model families. This motivates Robust Failure, Conservative Repair (RFCR), a textual distillation procedure that derives rules from failures shared across models, sharpens their application boundaries using boundary cases, and abstains when no useful rule is found. On a 400-item BIG-Bench Hard task set, RFCR improves the baseline cheat sheets from 68.50% to 71.25% (+2.75 pp; 95% CI [+1.25,+4.50]) without performance degradation on previously correct cases. Ablations and cross-model diagnostics support that accuracy gains come from both new knowledge injection and strict rule-application control.

AI.tldr: RFCR 是一种保守的文本知识蒸馏方法，通过从多模型共享失败中提取规则原子（rule atoms），利用边界样例精确化触发条件，并在无有效规则时弃权（passthrough），在 BBH 400 项任务上将 CS-ICL 基线从 68.50% 提升到 71.25%（+2.75 pp），且对原本正确的样本无性能回退。
AI.motivation: 基于失败（failure-based）的文本知识蒸馏存在不稳定性：从源模型错误中学到的"补丁"可能帮助源模型但伤害其他模型，且注入的规则可能在无关样本上被误激活，导致正确样本被错误翻转。因此需要一种保守的、跨模型可迁移的蒸馏方法。
AI.method: 1) 提出 RFR 诊断方法，揭示单模型失败精炼对非源模型有害（所有非源模型家族性能均下降）。2) 提出形式化框架，定义 rule atom 为三元组 (规则文本, 激活谓词, 激活边界谓词)，并引入激活精度（activation precision）衡量规则是否仅在目标样本上触发。3) 给出 4 个命题（如 Source acceptance is not enough 等）刻画跨模型迁移失败的理论条件。4) 提出 RFCR 流程：从共享失败生成候选原子，使用源私有失败（source-private）作为边界负样本，使用 easy 样本检测性能回退，使用 Wilson score 上下界构造保守效用函数 U(m)，仅在 U(m)>0 且对原本正确样本零回退时接受原子；并对激活谓词做边界修复。5) 推理时采用路由模式：仅在激活条件触发且边界条件不触发时注入原子，否则直接返回 CS-ICL 锚点输出。
AI.result: 在 400 项 BBH 主任务集（消歧 QA、形式谬误、几何形状、对象计数）上，RFCR 将 CS-ICL 基线从 68.50% 提升至 71.25%（+11 项，+2.75 pp，95% CI [+1.25, +4.50]），对原本正确样本零回退；在 295 项官方 BIG-Bench 保留样本上提升 +1.36 pp；在全 18 项 BBH 上由 75.58% 提升至 76.22%。跨模型重运行中 Claude Haiku、Mistral-7B、Qwen2.5-7B 取得正向迁移（分别 +0.75、+4.00、+2.75 pp），Gemini Flash Lite 略负（-0.50 pp）。消融表明：生成-仅版本修复 14 项但回退 5 项；加入 ULCB 过滤后回退归零；进一步做激活边界修复后修复增至 11 项且激活数从 79 降至 39。任务级贡献主要来自几何形状（+7）和消歧 QA（+4）。相比 ProTeGi（32 fix / 24 reg）和 GEPA（16 fix / 28 reg），RFCR 在零回退下实现更高净增益。
AI.conclusion: 从单一模型失败中提炼的规则可能是模型特有的"补丁"，源模型上的收益并不保证跨模型迁移。激活精度（activation precision）是判断规则价值的关键指标——高激活精度配合高边界修复精度可同时实现新知识注入与严格的应用控制。RFCR 通过共享失败构造、边界修复和保守接受门，将失败驱动的文本蒸馏转化为一种稀疏、零回退、可路由的修复机制。局限性：增益集中在几何形状和消歧 QA；零回退保证仅对锁定源模型协议成立（Gemini 等仍有回退）；主结果是受控开发结果而非严格的留出测试；未来工作包括留出整个目标家族做端到端生成与门控。

title: Efficient Iterative Retrieval with Heterogeneous Batching
comment: 15 pages, 8 figures, Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (main conference)
summary: Modern information retrieval increasingly employs both embedding and generative models to handle complex queries. However, current serving systems suffer from low throughput and poor GPU utilization because they execute these models in isolation. Coarse-grained partitioning, such as dedicating GPUs to specific tasks, fails to adapt to dynamic workloads and creates computational "bubbles". To address these, we present Orthrus, a serving system that performs heterogeneous batching within a unified inference loop. The primary challenge lies in unifying embedding and generation workloads with conflicting computational patterns while optimizing batch composition for high performance. Orthrus addresses these challenges through chunked embedding with incremental pooling and by adjusting batch composition in a workload-aware manner. Evaluation on four A100 GPUs shows that, relative to baseline deployments, Orthrus achieves 1.28$\times$--4.52$\times$ higher throughput on controlled workloads and up to 55.8% lower end-to-end p99 latency on an iterative-RAG benchmark. We release our code at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出Orthrus,一种统一的推理服务系统,通过异构批处理将嵌入模型和生成模型合并到同一推理循环中,显著提升了检索增强生成(RAG)系统的吞吐量和延迟性能。
AI.motivation: 现代信息检索系统(如RAG)同时使用嵌入模型和生成模型,但现有服务系统将两类模型独立部署在不同GPU上,导致GPU利用率低、吞吐量差,且粗粒度分区无法适应动态工作负载,产生计算"气泡"。
AI.method: Orthrus通过两项核心技术创新:(1)分块嵌入与增量池化(chunked embedding with incremental pooling),以统一嵌入和生成的不同计算模式;(2)工作负载感知的批次组成调整(workload-aware batch composition),动态优化批次构成以提高性能。整个系统基于统一的推理循环,在4块A100 GPU上部署。
AI.result: 在受控工作负载下,Orthrus相对基线部署实现了1.28×至4.52倍的吞吐量提升;在迭代RAG基准测试上,端到端p99延迟最多降低55.8%。
AI.conclusion: Orthrus通过将异构批处理引入统一推理循环,有效解决了嵌入与生成模型协同部署的计算模式冲突和批次优化难题,为现代RAG等检索系统提供了高性能的推理服务方案,具有重要的实用价值。

title: From Offline Proxies to Online Decisions: A Layered Engagement Evaluation Framework for Conversational AI
comment: 11 pages main text, 9 pages supplementary material; 2 figures, 25 tables
summary: Online A/B experiments are the decision standard for user engagement, but traffic and readout time limit how many conversational-AI changes can be tested. We ask whether an offline signal designed to be computable without treatment-arm user exposure agrees with the outcomes of those experiments. We contribute a reusable construction and diagnosis checklist that treats an offline proxy as a chain of three alignments: behavioral label to product outcome, learned classifier to candidate-assistant behavior, and aggregated offline signal to experiment effect. A companion evaluation protocol audits the whole composite by interval-aware decision agreement, which compares offline and online confidence intervals instead of point estimates, and by within-experiment ranking. The instantiation we evaluate comprises a fixed evaluation suite on which candidate behavior is scored, an engagement classifier trained to predict session/prompt level engagements, and a calibration layer mapping sample-level score differences to online model-level engagement deltas. We then report the audit: 489 paired offline-online contrasts (one candidate arm against its control) from 27 experiments on a deployed multi-turn assistant, spanning model checkpoints to system-prompt tuning. Our primary test uses the 113 contrasts from eight experiments that ran after the map was frozen: on these the composite reaches 81.1% F1, against 34.3% for the raw classifier score it is built on, and makes no wrong-direction calls where that raw score makes 31. Every offline prediction was computed before its experiment ran to prevent overfitting. The evidence supports using the composite to prioritize candidates before scarce experiment traffic is allocated---in our deployment of the experiment, selecting among training checkpoints and tuning system prompts.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对对话式AI中线上A/B实验资源稀缺的问题，提出了一套"分层对齐"的离线代理评估框架，用于在候选模型上线实验前预测其参与度效果。核心贡献包括：(1)三层对齐检查清单（标签-结果、分类器-行为、套件-实验）；(2)基于置信区间的"区间感知"决策一致性评估协议；(3)固定（frozen）合成评估器的实证验证。在已部署的多轮助手的113个后冻结对比中，该合成评估器达到81.1%的对比级F1（原始分类器仅34.3%），且无方向性错误调用（原始有31个）。
AI.motivation: 线上A/B随机实验是衡量用户参与度的决策金标准，但受限于流量和读出周期（每次需7天），无法测试所有候选AI变更（特别是训练检查点和系统提示调优产生的大量候选）。核心动机是：能否在候选尚未接触用户前，通过离线信号预测其在随机实验中的方向与排序效果，从而辅助稀缺实验流量的优先级分配。
AI.method: 方法由三部分组成：(1) 三层对齐检查清单：将离线-在线预测分解为标签-结果对齐（行为标签能否代表产品结果）、分类器-行为对齐（分类器能否响应候选助手的行为差异）、套件-实验对齐（案例分布、交互深度、聚合、校准能否保留组间差异）；(2) 区间感知决策一致性协议：基于在线置信区间定义真实决策，基于离线评分稳定性自助区间定义预测决策，使用对比级F1和实验级F1进行评估，并显式统计方向错误调用；(3) 实例化组件：训练参与度分类器（预测6小时内会话是否回归的二分类头）、关键轮次选择与多轮rollout的固定评估套件（4832个固定示例）、将离线信号映射到在线参与度增量的校准层（无截距加权回归，含4个特征）。
AI.result: 主要结果：在113个后冻结复制队列对比中，合成评估器达到81.1%对比级F1和63.0%实验级F1，原始EC分别为34.3%和16.0%；方向错误调用从31次降为0次。跨能力层级（cross-tier）效果最显著（F1达97.1% vs 3.0%），同层级（same-tier）提升不明确（F1 66.7% vs 63.0%，95%百分位范围[0, +11.1]）。在84个冻结保留对比中，合成评估器达到87.3% F1；在157个对比的共享切片上，比该项目中部署的5个其他离线评估器中最强者高25.7分。所有离线预测均在其实验开始前完成。消融实验表明：各组件单独使用较弱，组合使用效果显著；测试时回归（abstention）机制去除大部分方向错误调用；在固定评分预算下，对交互深度的投入优于对更多单响应案例的投入（250个3轮rollout案例达79.8% F1，优于5000个单次评分的77.6%）。
AI.conclusion: 论文得出三个核心结论：(1) 离线-在线一致性是分层的链条式问题（标签→分类器→套件与校准），不可通过后层修复前层失败；(2) 区间感知协议配合置信区间对齐，能显著降低方向错误调用率，可作为稀缺A/B实验流量的优先级排序工具；(3) 实际部署用于选择训练检查点和系统提示变体，但同层级比较中的增量收益尚未明确。论文明确局限：分析计划（包含层级划分）系在结果已知后选定而非预先固定；证据不测量全漏斗筛选能力、流量节省、未来覆盖或子群组泛化性；参与度非用户福利，不应作为自动启动标准。下一阶段需要预先固定分析计划、更广泛的同层级证据、以及按工作流进行的层级分层。

title: ZeroGate: Trust-Preserving Fast Paths for Governed AI Agent Runtimes
comment: 47 pages, 11 figures, 13 tables. Full research report with an ancillary archive containing reference code, raw experimental records, and offline verification tools
summary: Moving authorization earlier can shorten an agent's dispatch boundary without removing authorization work. It can also admit an action whose payload, authority, or relevant state has changed. ZeroGate separates exact-action approval from durable local admission: an issuer signs a short-lived ActionPass, and a trusted runtime adapter reconstructs the final action before a local gate checks its binding and consumes its nonce. A SQLite transaction couples nonce consumption, applicable quota updates, and an admission receipt. We state a conditional decision-preservation proposition: successful local admission implies that a specified synchronous policy would authorize the same action at the admission point, provided approval is sound, all policy dependencies are represented and current, observations are faithful, and consumption is atomic. The implementation alone establishes neither current-world freshness nor exactly-once remote effects. Evaluation separates authored semantic fixtures, controlled concurrency and crash experiments, and an Azure Blob study comparing synchronous and prepared execution through the same issuer and gate. Both modes mint an exact-action pass; lifecycle latency includes preparation and prepared-batch dwell. Across 4800 cloud attempts, prepared worker-admission-to-dispatch p95 ranges from 9.802 to 11.374 ms, versus 25.018 to 334.000 ms synchronously, across the tested concurrency levels. Prepared mean complete lifecycle is longer at every level: the boundary improvement is not a net speedup. The contribution is an explicit revalidation contract, a durable reference boundary, and an auditable comparison of where authorization cost is paid, not a new cryptographic primitive or a universal performance frontier.

AI.tldr: ZeroGate提出了一种面向AI智能体运行时的授权准入架构，将"精确动作审批"与"持久本地准入"解耦：签发方签发短期的ActionPass，由受信运行时适配器重建最终动作，本地网关在SQLite事务中原子性地完成nonce消费、配额更新和准入凭证记录。文章给出了条件性决策保留命题，并基于Azure Blob存储的4800次实测表明：prepared模式将dispatch边界延迟显著降低（p95从334ms降至9.8ms），但完整生命周期均值更长——边界改善并非净加速。
AI.motivation: 智能体在调度最终动作前需重复昂贵的授权审查，而工具使用权限并不等于对该工具具体请求的执行许可。若简单缓存审批结果，可能放过payload、权限或状态已变化的请求；反之，每次重新审查又会浪费时间。文章旨在研究如何在不削弱授权义务的前提下，让审批的最终检查变得更快更小。
AI.method: 核心方法包括：(1)签发方签发Ed25519签名、短期、精确动作、一次性的ActionPass，绑定持有者、会话、有效期、策略/状态摘要、nonce和配额；(2)受信适配器在dispatch前从最终字节重建canonical action并重新计算指纹；(3)本地网关在一个SQLite WAL+synchronous=FULL的BEGIN IMMEDIATE事务内验证签名、检查snapshot、冻结依赖值、消费nonce、更新配额并写入绑定receipt；(4)形式化为"条件决策保留"命题（Proposition 1），需满足A1–A6六个前提（声音签发、依赖完整、忠实观测、当前证据、剩余检查可靠、原子持久准入）；(5)评估分三类：73个作者语义场景×4领域×5重复×7方法、Azure Blob 4800次控制实验（同步vs prepared，1/8/32并发）、10个控制故障案例。
AI.result: 云端实测（4800/4800成功）：prepared模式dispatch边界p95随并发从11.374ms(1)降至9.802ms(32)，同步模式从25.018ms升至334.000ms，边界缩减54.5%–97.1%；但prepared模式完整生命周期均值更长（同步53.4–483.9ms vs prepared 1577–4257ms）。语义测试核心评估器与作者预期完全一致（0/1360误放行、0/100误拒绝），省略检查的变体出现大量误放行证明各检查的必要性。故障实验验证了同pass竞态仅1/8准入、配额竞态3/8准入、commit后崩溃可恢复但需保留intent等。直接Azure回读验证全部4800个对象内容匹配。
AI.conclusion: ZeroGate的核心贡献是显式的"再验证契约"、持久的参考边界以及可审计的授权成本支付位置比较——而非新密码学原语或通用性能边界。其条件性安全论断明确区分了本地快照一致性与外部世界新鲜性，并列举了多处反例（如离线撤销、适配器哈希与发送字节不符、跨区域独立nonce库）。prepared模式的dispatch边界缩短是以更长的准备时间和批量驻留为代价的成本转移，不是净端到端加速。部署决策应基于工作流特定的事实早期性、证据新鲜性和成本权衡，而非普适性能优势。

title: Rollout Efficiency in Reinforcement Learning for Reasoning Large Language Models: A Taxonomy and Future Directions
summary: Reasoning-oriented reinforcement learning enables large language models to solve mathematical, coding, and other multi-step tasks, but shifts a substantial portion of the training cost to rollout, where trajectories are generated for policy updates. Efficient rollout mechanisms are therefore essential to reduce this cost while maintaining the freshness, consistency, and statistical validity of training data. This survey provides a systematic taxonomy of recent research on rollout efficiency for reasoning-oriented reinforcement learning, classifying existing approaches from both mechanism and bottleneck perspectives. Based on this taxonomy, we analyze how different technique families address distinct sources of rollout inefficiency, examine opportunities and potential conflicts for combining them, identify gaps in the evaluation and reporting of efficiency gains, and discuss open challenges and future research directions.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇系统综述，聚焦于推理大语言模型强化学习（RL）中"rollout（轨迹生成）"环节的效率问题。作者将现有方法按"机制"（系统杠杆 vs. 算法杠杆）和"瓶颈"（A/B/C/D 四类）建立双重分类法，分析了 80 个方法的组合兼容性、评估可比性，并提出未来研究方向。
AI.motivation: 在面向推理的 RL 训练中，轨迹生成（rollout）已成为主导性计算开销（占总步时 70%–90%+），且现有研究分散于系统与算法社区，缺乏对"以目标质量为目标的成本"这一统一视角的综述。
AI.method: 提出双重分类法：（1）机制分类——按"系统杠杆"（pipeline 解耦、资源感知执行、调度与负载均衡、部分/提前停止 rollout、推测解码）与"算法杠杆"（rollout 选择、prompt 过滤与选择）划分 7 个家族；（2）瓶颈分类——按浪费来源划分为四类（同步气泡、长尾延迟、无信息 rollout、无信息 prompt）。同时给出组合兼容性表（21 对家族配对），并提出统一评估指标 C(q)（达到目标质量 q 的成本）和五项诊断协议。
AI.result: 通过搜索 4 个数据库 2024.1–2026.9 间文献，筛选出 86 篇（其中 80 个方法进入主表）。三项核心发现：（1）67/80 的方法只量化单一杠杆（50 系统、17 算法）；（2）基线选择、阶段边界、吞吐单位、聚合统计、规模配置这 5 个维度造成报告增益不可比；（3）算法杠杆几乎只在单轮可验证任务上评估（仅 6/29 在交互式 rollout 上测试）。在组合兼容性上，21 对家族配对中仅 2 对有实测增量增益，3 对共实现但无隔离测量，其余 16 对为机制推导假设。
AI.conclusion: rollout 效率应被定义为"达到目标策略质量 Q* 所需的成本"，系统杠杆加速执行给定 workload，算法杠杆减少学习所需 work。研究者应：①将 rollout 选择建模为在线学习问题并处理非平稳性；②将生成计算转化为可复用计算（含演/测试数据、KV 状态、推测前缀）；③构建自适应长尾管理而非被动响应；④建立 workload-aware rollout 控制器以统一两个杠杆；⑤将 rollout 效率从单轮轨迹扩展到多轮交互 agent 场景；⑥为多模态异构推理重新设计 rollout 流水线。

title: Real-Time Hand Gesture Recognition for OpenXR Using Transformer-Based Machine Learning
summary: Hand gesture recognition is a key component in human-computer interaction (HCI), enabling intuitive interfaces for applications in gaming, virtual reality (VR), robotics, and more. This study integrates transformer-based machine-learning models for real-time hand gesture recognition, using hand-tracking data captured through the OpenXR standard in Unity. We leverage positional data of hand joints and wrist rotation angles to train a custom gesture recognition system. By utilizing the sequential modeling capabilities of transformers, the system captures temporal dependencies within short gesture windows and classifies gestures robustly across hand orientations and sizes. The results show a significant improvement in gesture classification accuracy. Building on this, we outline how the approach can be extended toward detecting the flow of movement, i.e., the transitions between gestures, as future work.

AI.tldr: 本文研究基于Transformer模型的手势识别系统，利用Unity中OpenXR标准捕获的手部追踪数据，实现实时手势分类。
AI.motivation: 手势识别是人机交互（HCI）的关键技术，在游戏、VR、机器人等领域有广泛应用。传统手势识别方法在鲁棒性（特别是面对不同手部朝向和尺寸时）方面存在不足，需要引入能够捕捉时序依赖性的深度学习方法来提升系统识别性能。
AI.method: 方法采用基于Transformer的机器学习模型，结合OpenXR标准在Unity环境中采集手部关节的位置数据和腕部旋转角度作为输入特征。利用Transformer的序列建模能力捕捉短时手势窗口内的时序依赖关系，实现跨不同手部朝向和尺寸的鲁棒手势分类。
AI.result: 研究结果显示，该方法在手势分类精度方面取得了显著提升，验证了基于Transformer的序列建模对手势识别任务的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明Transformer模型可有效用于实时手势识别任务，并在精度上实现了明显改进。未来工作将致力于将该方法扩展到手势间的过渡检测，即识别和理解连续手势的动作流。

title: ShowTellArena: Evaluating Business Workflow Understanding from Demonstrations
comment: 6 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. Code and dataset linked in the paper
summary: We often teach a colleague by showing the work and explaining the decisions as we go. How can we check what an agent understood from the same lesson? We introduce ShowTellArena, a benchmark protocol and public dataset for comprehension after narrated business demonstrations. The v1.0 release contains 50 business workflow tasks, with recordings, screenshots, narration, fixture seeds, and 502 questions. Tasks span finance, hiring, procurement, customer decisions, inventory, and logistics.
