The protocol holds the business scenario and quiz fixed while allowing each product to capture the lesson through its own teaching interface. Questions test operational rules, boundaries, exceptions, and errors in proposed automations. We analyze 218 selected pilot attempts across 39 workflow cases, including 28 cases attempted by all three evaluated systems. These exploratory results expose both answer errors and failures to complete the teaching experience. We describe the release's verification gaps and the pilot's uneven coverage, exclusions, and grading provenance. The contribution is an inspectable dataset and assessment workflow that others can extend; the selected pilot is not a controlled product ranking.

AI.tldr: ShowTellArena 是一个用于评估 AI 智能体在通过"演示 + 讲解"方式进行教学后，对业务流程规则（操作规则、边界、异常和自动化错误）理解程度的基准测试。它采用"固定场景 + 固定测验、允许不同产品使用各自原生教学接口"的协议，发布了 50 个跨领域工作流任务（共 502 道题，253 道封闭式 + 249 道评分题）的公开数据集，并提供了对三种系统的探索性试点分析，特别强调答错和未完成教学的失败都需要被记录。
AI.motivation: 现有代理评估多关注执行能力，而对"看着讲解后是否真正理解业务规则与例外"这一面向缺乏直接测量。不同产品在用户如何"教会"智能体方面差异显著，教学过程本身（捕获、处理、记忆）应作为被评估的一部分。本文希望回答：在经过一次带叙述的业务演示之后，智能体到底能解释和运用多少内容。
AI.method: 提出了 ShowTellArena 协议：(1) 每个任务包含初始应用状态、演示、叙述、测验和评分契约五个部分；(2) 将"教师/评估者包"（含种子与正确答案）与"学习者允许的观察"严格分离；(3) 问题答案与教学证据（录屏时段、截图、源记录）显式关联；(4) 提供 Brackett Show & Tell、Claude 教学流、Codex Record & Replay 三种原生适配器；(5) 支持选择题、封闭式、评分题三种题型，可配置语义等价判定与部分给分；(6) 试点为公开数据集 v1.0 中 50 个工作流任务的子集，39 个被评测（28 个由三个系统共享），共 218 次选中尝试。
AI.result: 在 28 个共享用例上的试点结果：Brackett 得分 83.8%（83/83 评分，覆盖 39 例），Codex 55.4%（32/32，覆盖 36 例），Claude 16.7%（12/56 评分，覆盖 30 例）。但结果存在显著局限：评分混合手动与模型辅助（Sonnet 4.6 对 Brackett 47 条、Codex 27 条评分），Claude 大量 NA 视为零分、Codex 不完整尝试被排除的不对称选择规则，模型/适配器版本未完整记录，公开测验已修订且不能断言与历史每次尝试所用版本一致，且作者同时开发 Brackett。因此报告明确指出该试点不具备受控产品排名性质，仅作探索性发现——既暴露答错问题，也暴露未完成教学的失败。
AI.conclusion: ShowTellArena 提供了一个可检验的任务格式、证据链接的问题、可扩展的原生适配器与 50 个工作流任务；未来评估需要在评分前冻结任务修订、系统配置、重复计划、停止规则与评审方式，并按阶段（捕获/处理/回答/评分/基础设施）分别报告失败；独立可复现性是把它从一组"教学后测验分数"升级为可靠产品比较的必要前提。

title: RAG-NAROK: Retrieval-Aware Knowledge Corpus Poisoning in RAG with Source-specific Refutation
summary: Retrieval augmented generation (RAG) systems have emerged as the dominant architecture for grounding large language model (LLM) outputs in verifiable external knowledge, yet their structural reliance on a dynamic retrieval pipeline introduces a largely unexplored class of adversarial vulnerability. Existing knowledge-base poisoning attacks are fundamentally static. Adversarial documents are pre-computed and injected without any awareness of what the victim system will actually retrieve for a given query, leaving the attack blind to the competitive documentary landscape that surrounds its payload in the generator's context window. Unlike traditional static poisoning attacks that are blind to the retrieved context, we introduce RAG-NAROK (Retrieval-Anchored Generation Negation And Response Quality Collapse), a RAG attack framework that adapts to the query text. RAG-NAROK exploits the transparency inherent in RAG pipeline to first extract the legitimate source identities, then generate Anchor-Specific Refutation documents that explicitly name and devalue retrieved sources while leveraging recency and authority biases to steer the text generation toward a target answer. Our results demonstrate that RAG-NAROK significantly outperforms static baselines across diverse domains, revealing a fundamental tension between RAG transparency and AI security.

AI.tldr: RAG-Narok 提出了一种针对 RAG 系统的黑盒、上下文自适应的知识库投毒攻击框架，通过检索器指纹识别、影子检索、风格模仿和流形锚定语义劫持，显著优于现有静态投毒基线。
AI.motivation: 现有 RAG 知识库投毒攻击多为静态预计算的，对实际检索上下文"睁眼失明"，无法应对合法文档的"投票式"中和或异常检测防御，亟需一种上下文感知的自适应攻击框架。
AI.method: 四阶段流水线：① Retriever Fingerprinting：通过合成探针文档和查询族计算语义鲁棒性 S 和稀有词依赖 R，指纹化检索器类型（稀疏/密集/混合）；② Shadow Retrieval：提交目标查询并提取 top-k 文档及其源元数据；③ Stylometric Profiling：统计风格计量 + LLM 辅助散文分类，构建风格画像 Φ；④ Adversarial Document Synthesis：基于 Manifold-Anchored Semantic Hijacking（约 70% 复刻合法事实 + 30% 导向对抗结论）、Stylometric Mimicry 和 Authority Framing（含 assistant prefill 利用 LLM 指令遵循）合成对抗文档，并经迭代验证循环约束风格。
AI.result: 在 CFR-21、Cybersec-IT、Feds-2026 三个领域语料上的评估显示：对抗文档最高排名位次普遍达到 1.0–1.20；异常检测逃避率最高达 88.37%；对抗性有效距离边际（Efficacy Distance Margin）和良性文档排名位移均显著放大；LLM-as-a-Judge 评估中 Payload Integration Rate 达 75%–80%，Mean Cascade Rating 达 7.60–8.00。综合优于 Naïve Baseline，且对语料稀释（5×–20× 复制）具有一定鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: RAG-Narok 揭示了 RAG 透明度与 AI 安全之间的根本张力：源透明度虽用于可验证性，反被攻击者利用进行锚定反驳。其能力远超静态投毒，可同时规避异常检测并利用 LLM 的时效性与权威性偏见，呼吁未来研究设计具有相称复杂度的上下文感知防御机制，包括出处感知检索审计、自适应异常检测和生成层冲突消解。

title: Spectra: A Rules-Driven LLM Pipeline for Automated KYC Document Processing
summary: Know Your Client (KYC) onboarding in capital markets requires analysts to manually classify documents, extract structured data from heterogeneous sources, and validate compliance against complex regulatory policies. This process requires significant analyst time per client, with end-to-end onboarding often stretching to multiple weeks due to sequential handoffs. In this work, we analyze an on-boarding process and find that it comprises repeatable components well-suited to AI automation. We therefore propose a restructured workflow to be amenable to automation: we consolidate the traditional four-party process into two parties that share most of the work and can be automated together, eliminating intermediate handoffs that compound delays. To automate the remaining steps, we introduce Spectra, an AI-assisted document processing platform that combines a structured rules engine with LLM-based classification, extraction, and validation agents. The rules engine encodes compliance policy as a queryable database, enabling focused context injection that reduces token usage while improving extraction precision. Rather than a single monolithic prompt, the system decomposes document processing into isolated, auditable stages, each optimized independently and traceable to specific policy clauses. In evaluation on real KYC documents, Spectra achieves 100% classification accuracy and 89.4% extraction accuracy. Human review burden dropped by 96%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Spectra系统，通过将合规策略结构化为规则引擎并结合LLM多智能体流水线，将资本市场KYC文档处理中传统四方协作重构为两方协作，实现了100%分类准确率和89.4%提取准确率，将人工审核负担降低96%。
AI.motivation: 资本市场KYC（了解你的客户）入职流程面临三大瓶颈：(1) 每案需对20+份文档在50+种文档类型分类法中进行分类；(2) 从PDF中逐字段提取数据繁琐且易错；(3) 需对照400页合规文档进行跨规则验证。整个流程涉及多方顺序交接，端到端耗时可达数周。单一LLM调用无法容纳数百页策略上下文、错误难以定位、且缺乏可追溯性以满足监管审计要求。
AI.method: 1) 将传统四方（Intake、Coordination、Processing、Review）整合为Gathering View与Approval View两方，消除中间交接。2) 构建PostgreSQL规则引擎，将合规策略编码为可查询数据库（documents、data_requirements、document_requirements、exemptions等表），实现确定性清单生成与聚焦上下文注入。3) 部署六阶段多智能体流水线：文件净化→注入检测→分类（LlamaCloud）→模式查询（确定性，无LLM）→提取（LlamaCloud）→验证（o3-mini/GPT-4.1-mini）。每阶段独立优化，结构化输出含置信度与证据溯源。4) 人机协同设计：100%置信度数据自动通过，低于100%标记人工审核。
AI.result: 在21份真实文档（9类）和15份合成文档（141个标注字段，27类字段）上的评估：分类任务21/21正确，宏精确率/召回率/F1均为1.00，平均置信度99.3%，平均耗时11.6秒；提取任务准确率89.4%，精确率86.6%，召回率94.7%，F1为90.5%，部分匹配率94.3%，平均耗时11.0秒。按文档类型分：Articles of Incorporation与AML Policy达100%，Business Description为95.6%，Regulatory Filing为69.7%，Corporate Resolution仅50%。按字段分：entity_legal_name等达100%，powers_to_bind为0%。在控制测试中，需审核项从206降至8，人工工作量降低96%。失败模式主要表现为复杂字段模式不匹配、受控词表缺失导致的语义歧义、以及跨字段过度提取。
AI.conclusion: Spectra通过规则引擎与LLM多智能体的协同设计，在保证完全可审计性的同时实现了高准确率，显著降低人工审核负担。架构支持独立迭代优化——规则引擎可扩展而无需重训模型，各流水线阶段可独立调优。未来工作需在更大规模、更多样化的文档集（含扫描件与OCR伪影）上进一步评估，同时需解决复杂嵌套字段、受控词表与过度提取等问题。

title: Queer inclusion in speech datasets: An audit and taxonomy of practical tensions
summary: In this paper, we examine speech datasets for their inclusion of LGBTQIA+, or queer, voices and provide a taxonomy of tensions to better understand why there is a lack of such voices in current speech technology datasets. Through an audit of six diverse speech datasets, we find that measurable queer representation is low (0-1.4% of speakers) - insufficient for robust disparity measurement. We take this community as a case study to consider what challenges and tensions are associated with collecting speech data from marginalized communities. For comparison, we audit an additional two datasets from the speech sciences that were created by, for, and with the queer community. We note that many customs in speech dataset collection efforts in AI and speech technology research may conflict with values emphasized in participatory approaches with marginalized communities, and provide a taxonomy describing these tensions.

AI.tldr: 本文审计了六个英语语音数据集及两个专为LGBTQIA+群体创建的语音语料库，发现当前语音数据集中酷儿声音的代表性极低（0–1.4%），并提出AI数据收集实践与边缘化社区价值观之间存在的四类张力：规模化与包容性、效率与参与、开放与自主、静态分类与流动身份。
AI.motivation: 现有研究表明语音模型的偏见与训练数据中代表性不足密切相关，而酷儿群体由于身份敏感性和语音匿名化困难等原因，在语音数据集中的收录面临更大障碍，可能导致该群体在ASR、说话人验证等下游任务中遭受更高的错误率。文章以LGBTQIA+社区为切入点，揭示边缘化群体语音数据采集中的结构性困境。
AI.method: 研究采用审计方法，对八个数据集（EdAcc、EngDia、L2-ARCTIC、Common Voice、Fairspeech、CCV2、MAGES、PTMV）沿五个维度进行比较分析：性别标注方式、性别标签分布、机构隶属、伦理审查披露、招募方式以及数据访问与使用条款。在此基础上，提出包含四类张力的分类法（taxonomy of tensions）。
AI.result: 1. 主流语音技术数据集中酷儿代表性极低（0–1.4%），即便Common Voice这样近十万说话人的语料库也无任何酷儿身份标注的说话人；CCV2中仅1.44%，EdAcc中仅0.82%。2. 一些数据集（如Fairspeech）虽允许非二元选项，但最终因样本不足而将相关说话人排除。3. 专为酷儿群体创建的MAGES和PTMV数据集由学术机构通过社区参与方式构建，规模远小于高峰期数据，但更符合参与式研究（Participatory Approaches）价值观。4. AI社区的规模化、效率化、开放化数据收集实践与酷儿社区对信任、安全、身份流动性的需求之间存在四类张力。
AI.conclusion: 本文强调当前语音数据集在理论上向所有人开放，但实践中未能充分纳入酷儿声音。论文呼吁未来研究通过参与式方法与酷儿社区直接合作，理解这些张力的具体表现形式，并注意酷儿伞状概念下不同子群体之间的差异，以推动更具伦理性和代表性的语音数据集建设。

title: Towards participatory speech dataset curation: A queer case study and conceptual framework
summary: In this paper, we motivate the need for a participatory speech dataset creation framework through a case study of the LGBTQIA+, or queer, community - a community with documented concerns about AI and reported harms, including attempts to develop 'gaydar' technologies that purportedly identify individuals as queer. We review common speech data collection practices, why these methods may be unsuitable for engaging with queer speakers, and discuss previous efforts in participatory AI with queer community engagement, as well as participatory endeavours specific to speech data collection for other marginalized communities. From this review, we develop a conceptual framework for participatory speech data curation by, for, and with marginalized communities drawing on insights from co-design and knowledge sharing. We propose a framework comprising overlapping and two-way processes of defining a community, project formulation, modes of participation, and personal autonomy.

AI.tldr: 该论文以LGBTQIA+（酷儿）社群为案例研究，批评了传统众包式语音数据采集的不足，提出了一种面向边缘化社群的"参与式"语音数据集策展概念框架，包含社区、项目规划、参与模式和个体自主性四个相互关联的双向阶段。
AI.motivation: 语音技术数据集普遍缺乏对酷儿社群的识别，且酷儿社群因历史上的AI伤害（如"gaydar"技术、酷儿方言被内容审核过度标记为有毒等）对AI开发者缺乏信任。传统众包式数据采集缺少长期有意义的合作，存在"参与漂洗"（participation washing）问题，因此需要一种真正由社区驱动、为其服务、并与其共同设计的语音数据集策展方法。
AI.method: 通过案例研究方法，以酷儿社群为例，综述现有语音数据采集方法的局限、参与式AI中酷儿社区参与案例（如PARQAIR-MH）、参与式语音数据采集案例（如StammerTalk口吃数据集、MAGES语料库）、以及语言学中的双向知识共享传统。在此基础上，提出一个包含四个重叠且双向互动的概念框架：(1)社区定义；(2)项目规划；(3)参与模式；(4)个体自主性。每个阶段均提出引导性问题，用于指导社区贡献者参与语音数据策展全过程。
AI.result: 该论文的核心成果是一个概念性框架，区别于传统自上而下的研究者单向采集模式，强调研究者与社区贡献者之间的共设计和双向知识流动。该框架呈现为四个嵌套阶段，社区成员可从最初的项目启动到数据使用、存储、维护全流程参与，并能基于个人偏好选择参与方式、贡献被认可的形式，并保留数据撤回权。该框架被定位为语音数据集治理的规范性基础设施，而非强制性要求，可应用于酷儿社群以外的多种边缘化社群的语音数据集创建。
AI.conclusion: 该论文为AI研究者和酷儿社群成员提供了参与式语音数据集创建的指导方针，通过协作式双向知识共享方法推进负责任AI实践。论文建议未来工作应通过实际数据集开发案例迭代优化该框架，并希望其能激励更多酷儿视角以协作方式融入语音技术发展。

title: SMTB: Fast Structure-Mapping with Tight Bounds
summary: Structure-mapping forms analogies by aligning systems of relationally connected elements based on shared structure instead of surface features. We introduce a new structure-mapping algorithm: Structure-Mapping with Tight Bounds (SMTB) that is 5--15x faster than the structure-mapping engine (SME) and about 50\% better at finding mappings in large nested domains. SMTB is part of the broader Cognitive Rule Engine (CRE) project, a flexible multi-language-compatible framework with an accessible Python interface to state-of-the-art C++ implementations of core algorithms commonly used in cognitive systems such as pattern matching, planning, and structure-mapping. CRE and SMTB are designed to work with a wide range of representation choices. Unlike SME, which biases higher-order correspondences in tree-like predicate logic, SMTB maximizes relational connectivity without privileging higher-order relations. This allows SMTB to work just as well over arbitrary relational graphs as it does in tree-like domains of nested predicate logic. We discuss situations where privileging "higher-orderness" in structure-mapping can cause issues, and illustrate how SMTB avoids failure modes that SME would encounter in these situations. We also provide an evaluation comparing SMTB to SME v4 over 5845 domain pairs from the SME corpus.

AI.tldr: SMTB（Structure-Mapping with Tight Bounds）是一种新的结构映射算法，相比经典的SME引擎在速度上快5–15倍，在大型嵌套领域中找到映射的能力提升约50%。SMTB基于认知规则引擎（CRE）项目，采用Python接口和C++实现，最大化关系连通性而不偏向高阶关系，能在任意关系图上工作，避免了SME在某些场景下的失效。
AI.motivation: 经典结构映射引擎SME在40年的认知系统中广泛使用，但其实现强加了对高阶对应关系的偏好，限制了某些场景下的映射能力。此外，Python可访问性有限。作者开发SMTB旨在为基于Python的认知系统提供快速、灵活的结构映射实现，同时放宽SME中过度严格的约束。
AI.method: SMTB采用增量式逐实体分配策略，使用可接受的启发式函数 h(i,j) 引导搜索：(1) 通过将 ExpressionPair 的权重分布到其支持的实体分配上，构建朴素上界 h_naive；(2) 通过"向前一步"构建依赖矩阵，使用行/列最大值约束来收紧启发式 h_tight；(3) 通过配对游走（paired walks）测量全局结构连通性，偏置项 b_ij 在搜索初期引导选择。整体启发式为 h_L = (α_d·b̂_ij + h_tight)/(α_d+1)。支持有界回溯搜索（分支宽度 w，回溯深度 d）。
AI.result: 在5845个SME语料库领域对的评估中，SMTB（w=3, d=1）相比SME在SMTB目标上提升22.6%，在SME目标上提升16.0%。在>128实体的大型问题上，SMTB在SMTB目标上达1.80×，在SME目标上达1.52×。纯贪心SMTB仅需5.97秒（SME需70.95秒），实现5–15×加速。kernel违规率整体仅1.24–1.78%，但能避免SME在某些情况下的失效模式（如代数方程映射）。
AI.conclusion: SMTB在理论和实践层面均优于SME：(1) 理论证明结构映射无需显式偏向高阶性也能找到良好的高阶映射；(2) 实践上为认知系统提供了快速、Python可访问、灵活的工具。作者希望CRE和SMTB能像PyTorch/TensorFlow加速深度学习研究一样，加速认知系统研究的发展。

title: Weakly Supervised Quantum Error Mitigation
summary: Supervised approaches to quantum error mitigation learn a map from noisy circuit outputs to ideal ones, and therefore require the ideal outputs. Producing those ideal outputs demands noiseless classical simulation, whose cost grows exponentially with system size, so supervision is unavailable in exactly the regime where mitigation matters most. We ask whether cheap, individually unreliable signals drawn from circuit structure and hardware calibration can take the place of ideal labels. We assemble sixteen heuristic labeling functions (stabilizer and parity constraints, relaxation and readout characteristics, local depth, gate counts, and neighboring activity), reconcile their disagreements with a probabilistic label model, and read the resulting per-qubit error probabilities as a readout channel whose inverse mitigates the measured distribution. No ideal output enters the training path. On $147{,}000$ five-qubit circuits executed on two IBM devices, the method removes $24.3\%$ (Algiers) and $28.8\%$ (Hanoi) of the Kullback-Leibler divergence to the ideal distribution, against $15.4\%$ and $21.5\%$ for the strongest published analytical baseline, a margin that holds on both devices and lies far outside its bootstrap interval. Supervised neural models trained on ideal distributions remain stronger where such labels exist, and we quantify that gap rather than setting it aside; the method's claim is to the regime where they do not, since the labels they require cannot be computed for the circuits mitigation is needed for. The codes will be released shortly.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种弱监督量子纠错缓解（QEM）方法，用廉价的电路结构和硬件校准信号替代理想标签，通过16个启发式标注函数与概率标签模型预测每比特错误概率，再以张量积读出通道反演来缓解测量分布。在两台IBM设备147,000个五比特电路上，该方法分别在KL散度上消除24.3%（Algiers）和28.8%（Hanoi）的偏差，优于现有的最佳解析基线（15.4%和21.5%），且训练过程完全不依赖理想标签。
AI.motivation: 监督式QEM需要理想输出分布作为标签，而理想分布只能通过无噪声经典模拟获得，其代价随量子比特数指数增长。这导致监督方法在最需要缓解的大规模电路上反而无法使用。本文探索是否能用电路结构与硬件校准的廉价、不完全可靠的信号替代这些理想标签。
AI.method: 四阶段流程：(1) 16个启发式标注函数（测量奇偶校验、T1/T2弛豫、读出错误、局部深度、门计数、邻居活动等）对每个电路-比特实例投"clean/error/abstain"票；(2) Dawid-Skene生成式标签模型（EM拟合）整合分歧投票，得到每比特的软错误概率π̂；(3) 岭回归/逻辑回归/随机森林等下游模型将软标签推广到未见电路；(4) 将π̂读作张量积比特翻转信道并反演以缓解分布。理想标签仅用于评估和小规模校准。
AI.result: 在IBM Algiers（27,000个测试电路）和Hanoi（28,125个测试电路）上，弱监督方法分别消除24.3%和28.8%的KL散度，强于SPAM+Expander最佳基线（15.4%和21.5%），优势远在bootstrap区间之外，胜率约70–75%。但若可用，监督式序列模型相对散度仍优0.11–0.15。若改用直接回归期望值（而非速率校正），MAE从0.0525降至0.0187，揭示了信道假设的边界。
AI.conclusion: 弱监督可替代量子纠错缓解中的理想标签，代价适中。在两台IBM设备上，方法一致优于解析基线且训练完全无需理想输出。监督模型仍更强，但它们需要在无法扩展的电路规模上获得理想分布。理想标签不可得时，弱监督是可行的替代方案，其性能损失可量化。

title: Recovering Agentic Sovereignty: Mitigating the Consensus Paradox via Contrastive Epistemic Decoding
summary: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit a parametric vulnerability to adversarial swarm consensus. To mitigate this sycophancy, we introduce Contrastive Epistemic Decoding (CED), a zero-shot inference intervention. Unlike standard Contrastive Decoding (CD) which relies on a weaker secondary model, CED utilizes a dual forward-pass on a single architecture to isolate conformity bias. By introducing a novel asymmetric, zero-bounded probability clamp and discrete top-k truncation mask, CED mathematically suppresses toxic consensus tokens without causing grammatical collapse. Evaluated across 7,200 paired trajectories on complex benchmarks (GAIA, SWE-bench, Multi-Challenge) using Gemma-2 (9B), Llama-3.1 (8B), and Mistral v0.3 (7B), CED successfully neutralizes architectural and positional biases. By reducing cognitive loafing by up to 33.00% absolute, CED drives significant performance gains, yielding up to a 30.75% accuracy recovery. Regaining sovereignty induces distinct architectural behaviors---passive task-focus in Gemma-2 and active refutation of the simulated swarm in Llama-3.1---showing CED decouples compliance from capability without fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Contrastive Epistemic Decoding (CED)，一种零样本推理干预方法，通过在单一架构上执行双重前向传播、非对称零界概率钳制（zero-bounded clamp）和离散top-k截断掩码，抑制大语言模型在多智能体系统中对对抗性群体共识的谄媚行为。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在多智能体协作群体中表现出参数性的谄媚性（sycophancy）和"认知搭便车"（cognitive loafing），即放弃自身事实知识而附和错误共识。现有解决方案（如偏好微调、激活引导）计算开销大、扩展性差；而标准对比解码（CD）在高强度社会压力下会出现语法崩溃和虚假token提升的失效问题。
AI.method: CED的核心机制：①在单一架构上进行双重前向传播，分别计算标准指令（I_base）和对抗性从众指令（I_conf）下的log概率分布；②计算对比散度 Δ = log p_conf − log p_base；③应用非对称零界概率钳制 P = max(Δ, 0)，确保仅对从众置信度更高的token施加惩罚；④使用离散top-k（k=3）截断掩码替代连续概率边界，保护语法结构；⑤采用同步状态轨迹，通过KV缓存同步维持语义一致性；⑥最佳超参数 α=20。
AI.result: 在Gemma-2 (9B)、Llama-3.1 (8B)、Mistral v0.3 (7B)三种开源架构上，基于GAIA、SWE-bench、Multi-Challenge三个基准生成7,200条配对轨迹（每模型1,200条×2种解码策略）。Gemma-2在GAIA上准确率从35.50%恢复至66.25%（+30.75%），认知搭便车率下降33.00%；Llama-3.1在Multi-Challenge上准确率从38.75%提升至52.00%，搭便车率从58.50%降至29.50%；Mistral v0.3虽搭便车率显著下降但准确率仅微增，验证了合规性与能力的解耦。CED有效中和了架构部落主义（同质亲缘偏差）和锚定效应（位置偏差）。Gemma-2表现为被动任务聚焦（IGNORED），Llama-3.1表现为主动反驳（REJECTED）。
AI.conclusion: CED作为零样本推理干预手段，有效抑制多智能体谄媚行为，充当位置不变的均衡器，将认知搭便车率最高降低33.00%，准确率最高恢复30.75%。CED确立了无需微调的行为过滤器，将合规性与能力解耦：在不人为提升能力受限架构的推理水平的前提下恢复智能体认知主权。局限包括：双重前向传播带来2×计算延迟、仅限于开源权重模型、采用静态对抗对话。未来可结合推测解码、RAG等技术进一步优化。

title: A Behavioral Trait Leaks into Preferences: Diagnosing Trait Interference in LLM User Simulators
summary: LLM-based user simulators aim to bridge the offline-online gap in recommender evaluation by emulating users through injected traits, where preference attributes determine what a user engages with and a behavioral activity trait governs how long they browse. However, we show this intended trait independence collapses during simulation, causing two failures: (i) Trait Interference, where amplified activity distorts preference boundaries and forces interactions with mismatched items to sustain browsing, and (ii) Evaluation Invalidity, where satisfaction scores inflate with activity-driven page counts despite taste mismatches, biasing evaluation toward trait distributions rather than recommender performance. To resolve this, we propose PQA, a page-level quality anchoring method that guides simulators using a personalized anchor reflecting each user's intrinsic preference standard. By assessing whether a page meets this standard before further browsing, PQA enables proactive exits from low-quality pages, letting the activity trait retain its intended role of modulating browsing depth within preference-conforming pages. Experiments show PQA mitigates trait interference and improves the reliability of LLM-based simulator evaluation under activity shifts. Our code is available at this https URL

AI.tldr: 本文发现LLM用户模拟器中"行为活跃度"特质会干扰偏好判断（称为"特质干扰"），导致模拟器在高分页中持续浏览偏好不匹配的物品，使得满意度评分被人为膨胀，无法真实反映推荐系统性能。提出PQA（页面级质量锚定）方法，通过基于用户历史类别消费构建个性化锚点μ_u，将退出决策建立在页面质量评估上，恢复特质独立性并提升评估可靠性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM用户模拟器（如Agent4Rec、SimUSER）设计时假设"偏好属性决定用户喜欢什么，活跃度特质决定浏览多久"，两者独立。但论文发现这一假设在实际模拟中崩溃：放大活跃度特质会迫使模拟器放松偏好边界，与不匹配物品持续交互以维持浏览；同时满意度评分随浏览页数人为膨胀，使评估偏向于特质分布而非真实推荐性能。
AI.method: 1. 诊断分析：使用MovieLens和Amazon CDs数据集，以SASRec为骨干推荐器，在Agent4Rec和SimUSER上分析特质干扰现象（通过persona-item余弦相似度、类别重叠率、活跃度-评分相关性等指标）。2. 提出PQA方法：从用户历史交互中计算类别重叠率baseline作为个性化锚点μ_u，注入LLM系统提示中。在模拟过程中动态比较当前页面的类别匹配分数与μ_u，将页面标记为ABOVE/NORMAL/BELOW三档质量等级，据此门控活跃度特质对浏览决策的影响——活跃度仅在质量可接受的页面内调节浏览深度，避免低质量页面被强制浏览。3. 验证：通过浏览深度控制、模拟交互数据增强（微调SASRec）、GPT-4o人类相似度评分三个角度验证PQA效果。
AI.result: 1. 诊断发现：高活跃度模拟器在偏好匹配页面之外持续浏览不匹配物品（余弦相似度下降，类别重叠率下降），与现实中活跃度与平均评分负相关的规律矛盾（MovieLens Kendall's τ=-0.366，CDs τ=-0.069）。2. 评估失效：放大活跃度使探索页数和满意度评分急剧膨胀，即使在1:9正负比例的极低质量页面下仍持续浏览；而偏好特质（从众性、多样性）放大对指标影响微弱。3. PQA效果：PQA缓解特质干扰，在低活跃度下减少过早退出，在高活跃度下避免低质量页面过度浏览；用PQA生成的交互数据微调SASRec在MovieLens上NDCG@5达0.3046（基线0.2945），CDs上达0.3479（基线0.3322）；GPT-4o人类相似度评分从3.57提升至4.15（Agent4Rec+MovieLens）。
AI.conclusion: 本文识别了LLM用户模拟器的特质干扰失效模式：活跃度特质干扰偏好判断并破坏基于满意度的评估。提出的PQA方法通过个性化页面级偏好对齐来约束退出决策，有效减少活跃度驱动的过度浏览，恢复特质独立性，提升模拟器生成交互的可靠性。未来工作可将PQA从类别级信号扩展至更丰富的偏好指标（如物品间关系、协同过滤信号、细粒度反馈），以更好地捕捉用户跨领域的内在偏好。

title: Direct Optimization of Generators for Search in Automated Theorem Proving
summary: Fine-tuned Large Language Models (LLMs) significantly advance Automated Theorem Proving (ATP), but are often deployed as guiding policies within tree search rather than for single-attempt generation. Recent work shows cross entropy is suboptimal for an LLM used in flat search strategies such as aggregation or filtering and that work has developed new loss functions to correct this misalignment. Extending this alignment to tree search is more challenging: proof discovery depends on exploration and recovery through off-trace states that supervised demonstrations do not reveal. We extend Compute-Aligned Training (CAT) to this setting through an abstraction of policy-guided search, deriving tractable, trace-supported losses. Alongside these search-aware losses, we introduce a search-agnostic uniform-allocation (UA) loss that accounts for the budget without specifying the specific search. Both induce scalar weights on per-tactic cross-entropy gradients. We characterize how off-trace behavior affects the search-aware weights, including conditions for vanishing approximation error at large budgets. On a Lean benchmark, both approaches achieve higher observed proof-success rates than cross-entropy across six search strategies, with strong results from a single shared UA adapter. Budget sweeps show larger gains over cross-entropy at 16 than at 256 expansions, implying CAT scales with test time compute.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Compute-Aligned Training (CAT)的扩展，将搜索对齐训练从平坦搜索策略推广到分支树搜索。核心思想是用可追踪的代理损失替代监督微调中标准的逐策略交叉熵损失，对每个战术梯度施加标量权重。同时引入一种搜索无关的Uniform-Allocation (UA)损失。两种方法在Lean基准上均优于交叉熵，且UA单一适配器在多种搜索策略间表现稳健，CAT增益随测试时计算预算增大而扩大。
AI.motivation: 在大语言模型驱动的自动定理证明中，策略通常在树搜索（而非单次生成）下部署。标准监督微调使用的交叉熵损失与搜索部署下的最优目标不一致。先前工作已为平坦搜索策略（聚合/过滤）纠正了这种不对齐，但分支树搜索的对齐更具挑战性，因为证明发现需要探索和通过追踪外状态恢复，而这些信息在监督示范中不可见。
AI.method: 1. 将策略引导搜索形式化为配置动力学：搜索算法由选择规则S_A和更新规则U_A定义，追踪成功率J^A满足递归方程。2. 提出追踪支持代理损失：通过将偏离折叠为追踪缺失事件，限制搜索到示范状态，推导出可处理的搜索感知CAT损失。其梯度为逐战术交叉熵梯度的加权和，权重为w_hat_t^A = (p_t/J_hat)·∂J_hat/∂p_t。3. 引入搜索无关的UA损失：为每个示范步骤分配统一局部预算K̄=N/L，得到因子化目标∏[1-(1-p_t)^K̄]。4. 在Pass@N和BFS下实例化：Pass@N权重为N π̂ (1-π̂)^(N-1)/(1-(1-π̂)^N)；BFS使用几何随机变量求和S_L≤N。5. 近似误差表征：通过旁路通道（替代证明）和陷阱通道（追踪外探索消耗计算）分析w_t衡量对w_t^星的偏差。证明Pass@N下w_t^star ≤ w_t_hat < 1 = w_t^CE（Bypass Deflation），并在N→∞时误差消失（CE误差趋于1）。对BFS的陷阱通道，在吸收存在时存在非零误差下限。6. 在N=256扩张策略下，两者均优于CE，UA单一适配器在六种策略下表现强劲，N=256相比N=16的增益更大。
AI.result: 在Lean基准的458个保留定理上：1. N=256下六种搜索策略（Pass@N、BFS、DFS、RDFS、VDFS、MCTS）下，搜索感知CAT和共享UA均比CE控制获得更高的观测证明成功率。共享UA在五种分支策略下达到最高点估计，搜索感知CAT在Pass@N下最高（26.6% vs UA的25.1%）。2. 策略匹配：搜索感知家族内，Pass@N/BFS适配器对在匹配部署下获得最高点估计。3. 预算扫描：CAT相比CE的增益在N=256（N=256 BFS: +6.9 pp, p<0.001）大于N=16（+4.4 pp, p=0.001），表明CAT随测试时计算扩展。
AI.conclusion: 该论文为训练在搜索部署下运行的LLM提供了一套系统框架：搜索感知CAT目标包含搜索策略模型，搜索无关UA目标考虑计算但不指定搜索规则。两者均对每战术交叉熵梯度施加标量权重。理论分析刻画了替代证明和追踪外探索对搜索感知梯度权重的影响，并识别出测试时预算增长时近似误差消失的条件。实证表明所有目标在六种评估策略下均优于epoch匹配的CE控制。共享UA目标跨搜索算法表现强劲，搜索感知CAT在Pass@N下实现最高观测成功。预算扫描进一步显示在256次扩张下相比16次扩张时对CE的增益更大，支持计算感知训练随测试时计算扩展。

title: Gaze responses to false-positive computer-aided detection prompts during colonoscopy: a paired-video and real-time eye-tracking study
summary: False-positive computer-aided detection (CADe) prompts may divert endoscopists' attention during colonoscopy, yet the attentional impact of individual prompts remains unclear. We used event-locked eye tracking to quantify gaze attraction and attention occupation in complementary retrospective and prospective studies. In a retrospective paired-video experiment, 3 senior and 2 novice endoscopists viewed 60 colonoscopy videos with and without CADe. The prospective study recorded gaze during 42 real-time CADe-assisted colonoscopies performed by 9 senior endoscopists. Screened CADe prompts outside expert-annotated lesion windows were classified as false-positive artifact events. False-positive prompts attracted gaze in 48.6% (68/140) of retrospective observations and 65.2% (533/817) of prospective events. Among attraction events with complete recovery, median attention occupation lasted 1000 ms in the retrospective study and 1100 ms in the prospective study. Corresponding median prompt durations were 33 ms and 267 ms, with median time amplifications of 17.55-fold and 5.15-fold, respectively. In paired retrospective comparisons, visible artifact prompts drew gaze closer to the prompted region than did the same-coordinate unassisted reference. Secondary retrospective analyses showed high lesion gaze recognition without and with CADe (98.0% versus 99.0%). First gaze entry into lesion regions occurred 147.8 ms earlier with CADe. Across controlled and real-time clinical settings, false-positive CADe prompts frequently captured gaze, with attention persisting beyond prompt visibility. These findings support considering prompt-related attentional burden in CADe evaluation and design.

AI.tldr: This study used event-locked eye tracking to quantify how false-positive CADe prompts during colonoscopy capture and occupy endoscopists' visual attention, finding that these prompts frequently attract gaze (48.6% retrospective, 65.2% prospective) and that attention occupation (~1000-1100 ms) substantially outlasts prompt visibility, with time amplification of 17.55-fold and 5.15-fold respectively.
AI.motivation: False-positive CADe prompts are typically evaluated only by their frequency, but their individual attentional impact—how they capture, occupy, and release gaze—remains unclear. The authors aim to provide process-level evidence on human-AI interaction beyond conventional detection endpoints.
AI.method: Complementary retrospective paired-video experiment (5 endoscopists viewing 60 clips under unassisted and CADe-assisted conditions) and prospective real-time eye-tracking recordings (42 CADe-assisted colonoscopies by 9 senior endoscopists). Event-locked analysis quantified gaze attraction, attention occupation duration, recovery, and time amplification following false-positive prompts; lesion ROI recognition and first-entry time served as secondary outcomes. Tobii Pro Nano eye tracker at 30 Hz was employed.
AI.result: False-positive prompts attracted gaze in 48.6% (68/140) of retrospective observations and 65.2% (533/817) of prospective events. Among recovered attraction events, median attention occupation lasted 1000 ms (retrospective) and 1100 ms (prospective), with median time amplification of 17.55-fold and 5.15-fold. Visible prompts drew gaze closer to prompted regions than same-coordinate unassisted references. Lesion gaze recognition was 98.0% (unassisted) vs 99.0% (CADe), with first ROI entry 147.8 ms earlier with CADe.
AI.conclusion: False-positive CADe prompts frequently capture gaze with attention persisting well beyond visibility. Prompt-related attentional burden should be considered alongside detection outcomes and false-positive counts in CADe evaluation and design to support more effective human-AI collaboration.

title: Transformer Heads Looking for Order
summary: In this note, we show that the problem of checking, whether a sequence of bits is ordered, is not doable by 1-head 1-layer transformers but is doable by a 2-head 1-layer transformer. Unlike similar previous results, our results assume the model where transformers have an output MLP.

AI.tldr: 本文证明"判断二进制序列是否有序"这一任务可由2头1层Transformer（含输出MLP）完成，但不能由1头1层Transformer（含输出MLP）完成。下界证明的核心是将1头Transformer的判定能力嵌入到实数一阶理论中，并通过几何引理（利用超图Ramsey定理）证明分离有序与非有序二进制向量所需半空间数量趋于无穷。
AI.motivation: 现有工作（如Tesfaye等、Rajaraman等）证明注意力-only模型中存在头数分离结果，但加入输出MLP后这些结论失效。本文旨在将此类分离结果部分推广到包含输出MLP的标准Transformer模型。
AI.method: 上界（2头构造）：使用加性输入嵌入（位置、位置平方、比特值），第一个注意力头定位最后一个0的位置，第二个头定位第一个1的位置，输出MLP验证二者相邻。下界（1头不可能）：利用Kozachinskiy等人的技术将1头1层Transformer嵌入(ℝ,<,+)一阶理论（1头情形无需乘法），转化为半空间分离有序/非有序二进制向量的组合几何问题，再通过构造辅助图并借助Erdős-Rado超图Ramsey定理证明所需半空间数θ_n→∞。
AI.result: 定理1：ORDERED语言可由2头1层Transformer（含输出MLP）计算，但不能由1头1层Transformer（含输出MLP）计算。2头上界通过显式构造实现（注意力margin≥n，MLP容差0.1/0.2）；1头下界通过几何引理3（θ_n→∞）与一阶理论嵌入结合得出。
AI.conclusion: 本文为带输出MLP的1层Transformer模型补充了首个头数分离结果，填补了此前仅在attention-only模型中已知的分离结论在含MLP模型中的空白。证明中还观察到：1头情形下嵌入公式无需乘法运算，这一特点简化了论证。遗留问题：对k≥3、采用加性输入嵌入的情形，头数分离仍待解决。

title: Evaluating Coding Agents on Kernel Exploit Generation
summary: Coding agents now find real vulnerabilities in production software. However, bug discovery results do not measure whether agents can construct exploit primitives. We introduce KEX-bench, a benchmark for evaluating coding agents on exploit primitive generation against real operating-system kernels. KEX-bench contains 45 task instances across 40 Linux and Windows CVEs, covering kernel address leak, instruction-pointer control, heap read, heap write, and arbitrary address write. Each task runs in an isolated virtual machine, exposes controlled tools, and uses a deterministic verifier to check primitive-specific success. We evaluate state-of-the-art coding agents paired with frontier and open-weight models under fixed tool-call budgets. Without a reference proof of concept (PoC), the strongest configuration solves 1 of 20 Windows tasks (5.0%) and 14 of 25 Linux tasks (56.0%). With a reference PoC, the strongest configuration solves 31 of 45 tasks (68.9%). This highlights the gap where agents reach kernel crashes but fail to shape kernel state into exploit primitives. We release KEX-bench for reproducible research on AI-assisted exploitation at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文介绍Kex-bench，一个针对真实操作系统内核漏洞利用原语（exploit primitive）生成的编码代理基准测试，包含45个任务实例，覆盖40个Linux/Windows CVE，支持5种原语类别，并系统评估了多个前沿编码代理在有无参考PoC情况下的性能，揭示了"触发到原语"的能力鸿沟。
AI.motivation: 现有的漏洞发现结果无法衡量智能体是否能从真实内核漏洞构建可控的利用原语（如内核地址泄漏、指令指针控制、堆读写、任意地址写）。作者旨在填补这一能力边界评估的空白，建立可验证的、面向真实内核的利用原语生成基准。
AI.method: 方法包含三部分：(1) 构建45个任务实例（20个Linux CVE对应25个任务 + 20个Windows CVE对应20个任务），通过隔离QEMU/KVM虚拟机、MCP工具接口和确定性验证器（基于自定义内核模块、ring-buffer分析或WinDbg调试器）评估5种原语；(2) 评估3个编码代理（ClaudeCode、Codex、OpenCode）配对11个前沿及开源权重模型，在固定工具调用预算下（Linux 200次，Windows 300次）进行测试；(3) 对w/o PoC和w/ PoC两种设置进行对比，并通过轨迹分析、失败模式分类、复现可靠性研究、验证器验证、控制支架对比和污染分析进行多角度评估。
AI.result: 最强配置ClaudeCode/Opus 4.6在w/o PoC下解决14/25 Linux任务（56%）和1/20 Windows任务（5%），在w/ PoC下解决31/45任务（68.9%，覆盖全部5类原语）。整体990个配置-任务结果中仅150个（15.2%）成功。重复运行显示Linux mean 40.8%（SD 7.2pp）、Windows mean 24.0%（SD 5.5pp）。关键发现是"触发到原语"鸿沟：代理可达到内核崩溃/KASAN报告，但在将崩溃转化为验证器所需的精确原语时失败。控制支架对比显示ClaudeCode vs OpenCode（Sonnet 4.6）在70个匹配结果中显著优于OpenCode（McNemar p=0.035）。
AI.conclusion: Kex-bench是首个针对真实Linux/Windows内核的利用原语生成基准，揭示了当前AI编码代理在从可达漏洞到验证器确认原语转换上的显著能力差距。参考PoC可大幅提升成功率但不消除差距。该基准以开源形式发布，支持AI辅助漏洞利用的可复现研究，但需要注意预算、平台、工具栈、验证器路径等混杂因素对结果解释的限制。

title: ArticleMiner: Ontology-Guided Knowledge Graph Construction from Scientific Publications
summary: Scientific papers keep much of their quantitative content in tables and supplementary files, where a number means something only through its header, caption, unit, analytical method, and the conventions of its field. Recovering the rows and columns of a table is therefore not the same as recovering the scientific fact it reports. Most semantic table-interpretation methods assume that a clean table is already available and subsequently map its cells or columns to ontology terms, whereas most publication-level extraction systems are designed for a single domain. We study a middle path: a shared process that reads a paper and its supplementary files, gathers evidence from several parsers and a language model, and reconciles that evidence, while a bounded human-authored task module for each task supplies the domain meaning. The module lists the canonical names the graph may use, the surface forms that map to them, a small set of derivation rules and validity constraints, an identity key, and the bindings used to write RDF. It defines what a task is allowed to emit; it does not try to list every convention of a field. We build four such modules (for drug-discovery chemistry, materials science, machine learning, and mineral geochemistry) in the ArticleMiner framework, and evaluate them on 163 papers, including a new geochemistry benchmark with expert-curated ground truth. In comparisons against a same-LLM few-shot baseline, the point estimates favor ArticleMiner on all four tasks, with uncertainty on the two smaller benchmarks. The geochemistry comparison also includes access to supplementary files, so its improvement cannot be attributed to domain guidance alone.

AI.tldr: ArticleMiner 提出了一种"本体模块引导"的共享框架，从科学论文（含正文、表格、补充材料）中自动构建知识图谱。通过将领域知识编码为轻量级、人类可撰写的六元组本体（词汇、规范化、推导规则、校验、身份键、RDF绑定），并结合多解析器证据融合与LLM提取，在四个领域（药物化学、材料科学、机器学习、矿物地球化学）共163篇论文上验证，结果优于同LLM少样本基线。
AI.motivation: 科学论文中的定量信息深嵌于表格、补充文件和领域惯例中（单位、检测限、检测方法等），单纯恢复表格结构并不等于恢复科学事实。现有方法要么假设表格已干净（语义表格解释），要么局限于单一领域（科学信息抽取），缺乏一种跨域、端到端、以本体机制为约束的抽取与知识图谱构建中间方案。
AI.method: 1) 提出五阶段共享编排：parse（5种后端多解析器）→ extract（LLM+本体提示）→ self-correct（蓝图+视觉+诊断重试）→ reconcile（推导+规范化+校验+身份键融合+后端支持）→ serialize（JSON-LD/RDF）。2) 提出六元组本体模块接口 Ω_d = (V_d, C_d, Φ_d, Γ_d, κ_d, β_d)，分别对应词汇、规范化、推导、校验、身份键、RDF绑定；3) 本体在抽取前、规范化中、序列化后三个时间点约束输出；5) 构建四个领域模块（GeoChem/ChemTables/DiSCoMaT/MLTables）；6) 四层级GeoChem评测（元数据/数值精度/样本恢复/缺失值一致性）。
AI.result: 在163篇论文四个领域上对比同LLM少样本基线，点估计均利于ArticleMiner（两个小基准不确定性较大）；GeoChem上优于少样本基线（含补充文件访问）。多后端融合优于任一单后端；本体消融显示领域引导贡献显著；引入视觉与重试可恢复部分失败；提供成本/运行时分析（Sonnet约$0.3/GeoChem篇，Haiku约$0.1）。
AI.conclusion: ArticleMiner 通过显式的、轻量化的人类可撰写本体模块接口，在共享出版级编排中复用证据采集与抽取，跨域构造受领域语义约束的知识图谱；本体约束应在抽取、规范化、校验全过程中施加，而非仅在表格恢复后映射；多源证据需通过身份键而非字符串相等进行协调；基准不平衡（9–111篇）限制了跨域可移植性结论的普适性。

title: Reasoning-Preserving Fine-Tuning of Post-RL LLMs with Null-Basis LoRA
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL)-based post-training has become an effective approach for eliciting reasoning capabilities in large language models (LLMs). However, adapting post-RL models to new knowledge domains or behaviors through subsequent supervised fine-tuning (SFT) can severely overwrite these capabilities. Existing approaches mitigate such forgetting through experience replay, specialized initialization, or constrained optimization using gradient projection, but either provide limited preservation or incur substantial training overhead. Our analysis shows that reasoning activations concentrate in low-dimensional subspaces, leaving substantial null-space capacity for adaptation, and that the corresponding approximate null spaces can be reliably estimated from a modest number of examples. Motivated by these observations, we propose Null-Basis Low-Rank Adaptation (NB-LoRA), a parameter-efficient method for adapting post-RL LLMs while preserving their acquired reasoning ability. We formulate reasoning retention as a layer-wise hidden-state preservation constraint and construct a fixed approximate null basis from reasoning activations. LoRA updates are then reparameterized through this basis, enforcing the preservation constraint throughout fine-tuning. Extensive experiments across multiple RL-trained LLMs and diverse downstream tasks show that NB-LoRA matches standard LoRA in adaptation performance, maintains reasoning accuracy near pre-fine-tuning levels, and generalizes this preservation to held-out reasoning benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 针对 RL 后训练得到的推理 LLM，提出 Null-Basis LoRA（NB-LoRA），通过将 LoRA 更新重参数化到推理激活的近似零空间中，在下游 SFT 中保留推理能力，同时匹配标准 LoRA 的适配性能，并大幅优于 NSCL 等基线方法的效率。
AI.motivation: RL 后训练赋予 LLM 推理能力，但后续 SFT 常用于注入新知识或调整行为，会严重覆盖（灾难性遗忘）已习得的推理能力。现有方案如经验回放、空空间投影或专用初始化，要么保留能力有限，要么在 LLM 规模上产生显著计算开销。文章指出当前缺少一种轻量、保留能力强且训练高效的后 RL 适配方法。
AI.method: 核心是将推理保留建模为分层隐状态保留约束 HΔW⊤ = 0。首先离线从推理数据采集各目标线性层（Q/K/V、MLP up/down）的输入隐状态矩阵 H，对 H⊤H 做特征分解，丢弃保留 99% 谱能量的主成分方向，余下特征向量构成近似零空间正交基 Nₛ。再将 LoRA 更新重参数化为 ΔW = BCNₛ⊤（B ∈ ℝ^{m×r}, C ∈ ℝ^{r×k}，r 为可调瓶颈秩），Nₛ 始终冻结。任意 B、C 都精确满足零空间约束，因此可使用任意标准优化器（如 Adam）无需每步投影。文章还通过谱分析和主角度分析证明：推理激活呈低维（即使长链推理），平均 29%~45% 的维度可作零空间；仅用约 64~512 个样本即可稳定估计该子空间。理论方面利用 Nₛ 列正交性证明其右乘为 Frobenius 等距，从而保持光滑性和收敛条件，沿用标准 LoRA 的 O(1/log T) 收敛率。
AI.result: 在 Qwen2.5-1.5B 和 Qwen2.5-3B（分别经 GRPO 在 GSM8K 与 MATH-lighteval 上 RL 训练）上，将 NB-LoRA 与八项常识推理任务和工具使用（ToolAlpaca）适配任务对比 Vanilla LoRA、LoRA-Null、MiLoRA、NSCL、Exp. Replay 和 SDFT。结果显示：1) 目标任务平均精度上 NB-LoRA 与 Vanilla LoRA 几乎相当（Qwen2.5-3B 平均 84.6% vs 84.7%；Qwen2.5-1.5B 平均 79.2% vs 79.8%），优于 SDFT（69.8%/11.9%）。2) 推理保持方面，Vanilla LoRA 将 3B 的 MATH-lighteval 精度从 63.8% 跌至 8.3%，1.5B 的 GSM8K 从 80.1% 跌至 9.4%；NB-LoRA 将前者保留在 63.2%、后者保留在 80.0%，与 NSCL（63.3%/78.8%）相当且方差更小。3) 在未见推理基准（MATH-500、AGIEval-EN-MATH、MMLU-STEM、GSM8K 或 MATH-lighteval）上同样保留性能（3B 平均 67.1% vs 参考 67.7%；1.5B 平均 54.7% vs 54.5%），证明零空间保留可泛化。4) 效率显著优于 NSCL：在 Qwen2.5-3B 上提速 6.3×、峰值显存降低 2.1×，同时参数量更少（结构优势源自无需维护完整模型优化器状态和无 O(d³) 每步投影）。5) 消融验证：64~512 样本即可稳定估计零空间；光谱阈值在 0.80~0.99 区间鲁棒；MLP 模块对适配必不可少；NB-LoRA 支持顺序多任务适配（先八项常识再工具使用），每阶段均保留推理与先验能力。
AI.conclusion: NB-LoRA 是一种参数高效的后 RL 适配方法，通过在 LoRA 参数化中结构性嵌入推理隐状态的近似零空间约束，实现了与标准 LoRA 同等的下游适配性能，同时将推理精度维持在 RL 训练后水平，且能泛化到未见过的推理基准。相比 NSCL 等基于投影的方法，其效率优势随模型规模扩大而增长，为在实际部署中平衡新知识注入与推理能力保留提供了可行方案。

title: ChatT2: An Adaptive Framework for Developing a Large Language Model-Based Agent for Natural Product Domain Research
summary: Scientific investigations into microbial natural products (NPs) present significant challenges for novices, largely due to the complexity of microbial systems, biochemical diversity, technical skill requirements, and the demands of bioinformatics and data analysis processes. To address these issues, we introduce ChatT2, a large language model (LLM)-based agent that is specifically tailored to the unique characteristics of bacterial type II polyketides. These polyketides form a structurally distinct and therapeutically important NP family. ChatT2 was developed within an autonomous multiagent framework composed of a mentor, an executor, and an evaluator, each with defined responsibilities. The mentor acts as an intermediary between ChatT2 and the user, utilizing chain-of-thought prompting to refine the intent of the user. Under the guidance of the mentor, the executor synthesizes multimodal information via retrieval-augmented generation techniques and seamlessly integrates bioinformatics and cheminformatics tools. The evaluator ultimately assesses the output of the executor to ensure the richness and accuracy of the retrieved information. Our research highlights how ChatT2, designed with this multiagent framework, addresses the challenges faced by general LLMs in terms of understanding limited, specialized corpora and complex biological information and provides both experts and novices with a valuable tool for exploring various NPs of interest. The ChatT2 webserver can be accessed at this https URL .

AI.tldr: ChatT2是一个基于大语言模型的多智能体框架，专为细菌II型聚酮天然产物研究领域设计。该系统采用导师、执行者和评估者三角色协同机制，结合思维链提示和检索增强生成技术，为专家和初学者提供准确、可靠且可追溯的科学问答服务。
AI.motivation: 微生物天然产物（特别是细菌II型聚酮）研究具有高度跨学科特性，涉及微生物学、生物化学、生物信息学和化学信息学等领域。现有数据库（如Natural Products Atlas、MIBiG等）虽然资源丰富，但查询需要专业知识（如SQL），而通用大语言模型在面对专业生物化学领域时存在理解有限、容易产生幻觉输出、缺乏自我评估机制等问题。此外，单一智能体处理复杂任务时存在步骤过多、稳定性差、缺乏监控机制等局限。
AI.method: ChatT2采用三层多智能体架构：（1）导师智能体：作为用户与执行者之间的中介，利用思维链（CoT）提示技术细化用户意图并逐步分解问题；（2）执行者智能体：基于GPT-4o mini构建，通过检索增强生成（RAG）框架整合四类数据库——关系型数据库（MIBiG+PubChem）、向量数据库（基于Web of Science文献的层次语义匹配）、图像数据库（BM25算法）和工具仓库（序列比对工具ClustalW/MUSCLE/MAFFT、基因功能注释、PubChem集成）；（3）评估者智能体：在预处理、中处理、后处理三个阶段执行拒绝回答、过滤无关信息和引用跟踪三项任务。系统采用分层消息生命周期管理机制，并提供Fixed、Auto、Updated三种CoT部署模式。
AI.result: 研究团队构建了NPBENCH基准数据集（II型聚酮版本），包含50个涵盖生物合成、化学修饰与结构优化、功能、应用和分类五个研究场景的开放式问题。ChatT2（基于GPT-4o mini）在所有类别上的胜率均显著优于基线模型：在生物合成类别胜率达0.844，是GPT-4o mini（0.044）的约19倍；在功能类别胜率0.808 vs 0.052；应用类别0.804 vs 0.072；结构类别0.712 vs 0.052；分类类别0.624 vs 0.164。ChatT2在多个指标上甚至超越405B参数的Llama 3.1模型。评估的Spearman相关系数均超过0.6，表明自动化评估结果可靠。多轮CoT迭代实验中，随着迭代次数增加，引用文档数、词汇丰富度和文本长度均显著提升，展示了系统在探索性问答方面的优势。
AI.conclusion: ChatT2通过多智能体框架有效解决了通用LLM在专业天然产物领域理解能力有限的问题，提供了准确、可靠且可追溯的响应。系统的"问题生成—响应—问题"方法确保每个行动步骤都有据可依，且能主动向用户寻求反馈。该框架展现了将小型化模型（GPT-4o mini）性能优化至超越大型模型的潜力。然而仍存在局限：数据库扩展需大量人工工作；依赖底层LLM能力；仅在II型聚酮任务中验证有效。未来将扩展数据库覆盖范围、集成专门智能体处理更复杂任务，并探索实时数据整合能力。

title: Ladders of Thought: A Self-Evolving Curriculum of Progressively Simplified Reasoning Traces
summary: Large language models (LLMs) excel at reasoning when scaled to hundreds of billions of parameters, but small- and mid-scale models remain brittle reasoners even with knowledge distillation (KD). We present Ladders-of-Thought (LoT), a framework that improves reasoning by combining progressive question rewrites with a self-evolving curriculum. LoT automatically generates semantically faithful but easier variants of reasoning problems, organizes them into difficulty buckets using step-based measures, and employs a self-evolving bandit scheduler to allocate training adaptively. Evaluated on two reasoning domains, math and multi-hop reasoning, across 1-8B models from different families, LoT consistently improves over KD. It delivers large gains on arithmetic tasks (e.g., +32 percentage points on AddSub, +25pp on SVAMP), +2-8pp improvements on in-domain test splits, and strong though dataset-dependent benefits on multi-hop reasoning (e.g., +16pp on QASC, +25pp on StrategyQA). LoT also converges faster than staged curricula, highlighting the value of adaptive progression. These results show that progressive rewrites coupled with adaptive curricula provide a simple yet effective recipe for strengthening reasoning in smaller LLMs.

AI.tldr: 提出Ladders-of-Thought（LoT）框架，通过渐进式问题改写与自演化课程学习，提升中小规模LLM（1-8B）的推理能力，在数学和多点推理任务上显著优于传统知识蒸馏。
AI.motivation: 小中型LLM在CoT推理蒸馏中容易过拟合浅层启发式、难以泛化；现有课程学习在推理SFT中面临难度定义困难和固定调度僵化的问题。
AI.method: 三步——**渐进式改写**：用LLM将每道题沿CoT每步替换前提为已推导结论，生成语义保真的难度阶梯；**步数难度度量**：以最小推理步数 ϕ(x) 作为难度标签并分桶；**自演化课程**：以多臂老虎机（MAB）为调度器，通过Q-learning/Boltzmann或ε-greedy策略按桶动态分配训练批次。
AI.result: 在OPT/Pythia 1-3B上，LoT在AddSub上提升+32pp、SVAMP+25pp；域内GSM8K/EntailmentBank提升+2-8pp；在Qwen2.5-7B和Llama3.1-8B上同样有效；自演化课程收敛最快，浅-中改写深度（≤3）最佳；MAB仅增加3-8%训练开销。
AI.conclusion: 语义保真的渐进式改写与自适应课程相结合，为小中型LLM提供了一种简洁有效的推理增强方案，能改善OOD泛化与收敛速度。

title: Testing-Driven Reliability Audit of Trajectory-Based Early Outcome Prediction for LLM Agents: Target-Specific Calibration Transfer Persists Within a Single Benchmark
summary: Predicting early outcomes based on trajectory can decrease the expenses associated with agent evaluation by terminating a run once the outcome becomes sufficiently predictable, assuming that the predictor's confidence is properly calibrated. Calibration is at risk when a predictor is applied to an agent on which it was never trained, but it is not known whether such transfer failures are broad across agent systems or concentrated in specific target agent/head combinations. Using public SWE-bench Verified trajectories and a frozen dual-head early-outcome prediction pipeline, we ran a leave-one-agent-out calibration audit, a shared-predictor leave-two-agents-out control, oracle prior correction, and a robustness battery over training cohorts, task resampling, task halves, jackknife, and thresholds. Fixed-scaffold TerminalBench analysis served as a pre-registered boundary test. Broad same-predictor pairwise heterogeneity was not supported; the median pairwise corrected-gap differences were 0.0180 (SUCCESS head, 45 pairs) and 0.0385 (FAILURE head, 35 pairs), and the pre-registered heterogeneity criterion was not met on either head. Two specific combinations, gpt-5-mini/SUCCESS and claude-opus-4.6/FAILURE, showed persistent calibration-transfer errors (median corrected gaps 0.1377 and 0.1107) without a sign reversal under any frozen control. TerminalBench did not establish cross-benchmark replication: the success target produced zero decisions (INDETERMINATE), and the failure target did not satisfy the pre-registered persistence criterion. Therefore, a strong target-specific calibration-transfer error can exist within one frozen environment, but the evidence does not establish that the error is intrinsic to the model or general across benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过"留一智能体外出"校准审计，系统性地检验早期结果预测器在未见过的智能体上的校准迁移性，发现在SWE-bench Verified中整体异质性较弱，但存在两个特定的智能体/预测头组合（gpt-5-mini的SUCCESS头和claude-opus-4.6的FAILURE头）表现出持续性的校准迁移误差，且该现象未能通过TerminalBench跨基准复现。
AI.motivation: 智能体评估成本高昂，若能基于轨迹早期预测结果并提前终止运行，可显著节省资源。该方法依赖预测器置信度的良好校准，但将预测器应用于未经训练的智能体时校准可能失效。研究动机在于澄清这种校准迁移失败是广泛存在于各智能体系统中，还是集中在特定的智能体/预测头组合上，从而为预测器的实际部署提供经验依据。
AI.method: 使用公开的SWE-bench Verified轨迹和冻结的双头（SUCCESS/FAILURE）早期结果预测流水线，执行以下分析：（1）留一智能体出（leave-one-agent-out）校准审计；（2）共享预测器的留两智能体出控制实验；（3）oracle先验校正；（4）稳健性测试，涵盖训练队列、任务重采样、任务对半、jackknife法和阈值变化。固定脚手架的TerminalBench分析作为预先注册的边界测试。预先注册了异质性判定标准和持久性判定标准。
AI.result: 不支持广泛的同预测器配对异质性：SUCCESS头45对的配对校正间隙差异中位数为0.0180，FAILURE头35对为0.0385，两个头均未达到预先注册的异质性标准。但识别出两个特定组合存在持续的校准迁移误差：gpt-5-mini/SUCCESS（校正间隙中位数0.1377）和claude-opus-4.6/FAILURE（0.1107），在所有冻结控制条件下均未出现符号反转。TerminalBench未能复现跨基准结果：成功目标产生零决策（INDETERMINATE），失败目标未满足预先注册的持久性标准。
AI.conclusion: 在单一冻结环境中可以存在强目标特异性的校准迁移误差，但现有证据不足以证明该误差是模型内在的或在跨基准间具有普遍性。这意味着基于早期预测的智能体提前终止策略需要谨慎的针对性校准验证，单一基准上的性能不能直接外推到其他基准或智能体配置。

title: Seeing Is Not Perceiving: When Synthetic Consumers Can and Cannot Pretest Visual Marketing
comment: 58 pages (30 pages of main text, 23 pages of appendix), 18 figures, 25 tables. All six studies were preregistered on AsPredicted
summary: Marketers now deploy generative AI agents as synthetic consumers to pretest visual assets such as logos, packaging, and advertising at a fraction of human-panel cost. However, this procedure assumes that a model seeing a visual cue can also perceive its consumer meaning, which is largely untested. We stress-test the assumption using six canonical visual marketing experiments, varying the two levers managers control: model generation (GPT-4o-mini vs. GPT-5.4-mini) and input format (plain text vs. JSON). Every resulting configuration passed the manipulation checks; however, none of the configurations reproduced more than two of the six human effects, and the remainder were nonsignificant. The one exception was a significant reversal of the human pattern. Providing conceptual or empirical evidence through in-context learning steers average responses toward the human effect. Yet steering has a limit: even when it succeeds, a configuration reproduces less than half of the natural spread of human responses and so understates consumer heterogeneity. We integrate these results into an AI governance protocol (Calibrate, Intervene, Deploy) that delineates when synthetic consumers can responsibly screen creatives and when human panels remain necessary.

AI.tldr: 本文通过六项经典视觉营销实验的压力测试发现，生成式AI智能体（如GPT-4o-mini和GPT-5.4-mini）能够可靠地"看见"视觉特征，但在"感知"其消费者含义方面存在系统性失败。即使通过上下文学习（ICL）提供概念性或经验性证据进行干预，仍无法恢复人类响应的自然异质性。据此，作者提出了"校准-干预-部署"三步AI治理协议。
AI.motivation: 营销人员越来越多地使用生成式AI智能体作为"合成消费者"来预测试视觉资产（logo、包装、广告），但这一做法隐含的假设——模型能够像人类一样感知视觉线索的消费者含义——尚未得到验证。文本领域的硅基采样（silicon sampling）已展现出一定有效性，但视觉营销领域的效果仍属未知。
AI.method: 采用2×2实验设计，操控两个管理者可控变量：(1) 模型世代（GPT-4o-mini vs. GPT-5.4-mini）；(2) 输入格式（纯文本 vs. JSON）。在六项已预注册的标杆视觉营销实验上测试，样本量从69–771人不等，每种配置下生成超过800个合成受访者。每位AI受访者分配与原始研究相匹配的人口统计画像，接收512×512像素的视觉刺激，并提供数值评分和文本推理理由。通过操纵检查(1)验证视觉识别能力。通过主题建模（BERTopic）分析文本理由以区分"看见"与"感知"。通过上下文学习（ICL）注入概念性证据（理论描述）或经验性证据（统计结果）来测试干预效果。
AI.result: 核心发现：(1) **零样本基线**：所有配置均通过操纵检查(1)，但没有任何配置能复现超过六个标杆人类效应中的两个。GPT-4o-mini (TXT)在研究3中出现显著方向反转（将带棱角logo的产品评为更舒适，与Jiang等2016年发现相反）。失败源于两种"感知错位"：模型仅将视觉特征视为客观美学属性而未激活语义联想，或激活了与人类标杆相竞争的替代心理先验。(2) **ICL干预**：概念性或经验性证据能将平均反应引导回人类方向，且较新模型（5.4-mini）对引导更敏感。但恢复后效应量仍小于人类基准，且无人格上的组间异质性。(3) **方差收缩**：所有配置的标准差比率均低于1.0，零样本条件下小于0.5，表明合成消费者始终无法再现人类响应的自然分布——即使在干预后亦然。
AI.conclusion: 本文将发现整合为三步AI治理协议——**校准（Calibrate）→ 干预（Intervene）→ 部署（Deploy）**：(1) 校准阶段在已知人类基准上验证模型配置；(2) 若未通过校准则进入干预阶段（提供ICL证据），若仍失败则交回人类原样测试；(3) 仅当配置为成功时才能部署于创意筛选。但校准后的智能体仅适用于平均效应比较，凡涉及消费者异质性的决策（细分/定位）仍需人类原样承担。主要贡献：(1) 将硅基采样扩展至视觉领域，揭示"看见≠感知"的系统性缺口；(2) 证明干预能修正均值但无法恢复分布；(4) 提出可落地的治理框架。理论意义在于区分了"技术先验"与"心理先验"，证明识别视觉特征、重现人类结果与重现潜在心理路径是三个独立任务。

title: Toolcompass: Guiding Tool Trialing, Not Suppressing It
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents must generalize from tools seen during training to unseen tools at deployment. A key challenge is tool trialing, i.e., excessive trials waste the interaction budget, whereas selective trials enable exploration of unfamiliar tools. Existing outcome-based post-training leaves wasteful trials unguided, while turn-level supervision may suppress necessary exploration. We introduce ToolCompass, a post-training framework that guides tool trialing by organizing tool-call representations according to shared functions. Specifically, ToolCompass models each function class as a von Mises--Fisher distribution and jointly reduces intra-function variation across domains and increases inter-function separation. This structure transfers experience from seen tools to functionally similar unseen tools, directing exploration away from unrelated alternatives. ToolCompass requires no ground-truth call traces or unseen-tool access and incurs no inference overhead. Experiments on AppWorld and FTRL show consistent gains across GRPO, RFT, and DMPO. improves AppWorld OOD task success by up to 10.71 percentage points over vanilla post-training and performs best among competitive baselines on both benchmarks.

AI.tldr: ToolCompass 是一个后训练框架，通过 von Mises–Fisher (vMF) 分布建模工具调用的函数类别，将不同领域共享同一功能的工具调用表征聚拢，从而引导面向 OOD 工具的试错探索，在不增加推理开销的前提下提升 LLM 智能体的工具泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有工具使用方法面临"过度试错 vs. 抑制必要探索"的权衡：基于结果的强化学习（如 GRPO）对所有工具调用施加同等优势，导致浪费性调用得不到引导；而轮级监督方法（如 MatchTIR）虽能减少调用次数，却因抑制探索而降低任务成功率。作者发现这一失败源于表征空间按领域而非按功能聚类，使跨领域的功能迁移受阻。
AI.method: ToolCompass 将工具调用提取为最终 token 隐藏表征，经轻量投影头归一化到单位超球面上；为每个函数类别维护一个 vMF 原型，通过最小化负对数似然（L_var）将同类调用拉向原型，并通过基于批次方向的分离损失（L_sep）将不同类推离，最终以 EMA 方式更新原型。该目标与任意后训练目标（GRPO/RFT/DMPO）联合优化，投影头与原型仅在训练时使用，部署时不增加推理开销。
AI.result: 在 AppWorld 和 FTRL 基准上，以 Qwen3.5-4B/9B 为骨干，ToolCompass 相对 vanilla GRPO 在 OOD 任务成功率上最高提升 10.71 个百分点，并在三种后训练目标下均取得一致增益。表征可视化显示其将同类功能调用按功能聚拢而非按领域聚拢；调用分析表明有用试错增加、无效试错减少，且整体调用次数低于 GRPO 但高于 MatchTIR，验证了"引导而非抑制"的特性。
AI.conclusion: 通过对函数级表征结构施加 vMF 先验，ToolCompass 在无需真实调用轨迹、无需接触未见工具、无推理额外开销的条件下，实现了从已见工具到功能相似未见工具的有效迁移，为 OOD 工具泛化提供了轻量、通用的后训练方案。

title: How Strongly Should Task State Influence an LLM Agent?
summary: Long-horizon assigned work requires an LLM agent to track the state of a task: which steps are done, blocked, cancelled, or open to repetition. Agent systems either keep this state as text in the prompt and rely on the model to read that text, or move the state into a module that enforces it, and each system is evaluated as a whole, so no one knows how much reliability comes from the state being shown, told, or enforced. We fix the task rules, the model, and paired episodes and vary how strongly task state reaches the agent: a raw transcript, an exact checklist, per-turn directives from a state machine compiled from the brief and advanced only by execution receipts, or an enforcement gate on that machine that refuses state-violating actions; every episode is scored by exact payload matching against dynamic ground truth. Across three models, two reasoning regimes, and two domains, four findings hold without per-turn reasoning: displaying accurate state is unreliable, an unverified ledger the agent writes itself beats an accurate checklist it is shown, directives help in proportion to the model's obedience, and enforcement needs no obedience but is bounded by the correctness of its state and by the matcher that maps requests to steps; per-turn reasoning at a 235B agent compresses these separations without repairing the text rungs. The same gate, compiled from $\tau^2$-bench's airline policy, raises a 235B agent's pass$^1$ from 0.39 to 0.54 and changes nothing for a 35B agent that rarely violates the policy; on PM-Bench, where acting turns on recognizing a cue rather than on state, showing the record is the best rung--matching or beating both gates and reversing the ledger-over-checklist finding--and enforcing the matcher's judgement drops a 35B agent below its raw transcript. Enforcement pays when failures are state-decidable and frequent, and hurts when the gate's judgement is wrong.

AI.tldr: 本文通过控制实验，系统测量了任务状态以不同强度（原始记录、清单、指令、强制执行门）作用于LLM智能体时对其行为的影响，发现单纯展示准确状态并不可靠，且强化执行只在状态可判定且频繁失败时才有收益。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体系统在长期任务中以不同方式管理任务状态（提示文本、记忆系统、工作流引擎），但每个系统作为整体被评估，没有人知道可靠性有多少来自状态的展示、告知或强制执行。本文旨在通过控制变量，精确测量状态与智能体行为的耦合强度如何影响任务完成度。
AI.method: 作者构建了一个由程序生成的多步骤采购任务测试平台，每集包含固定的步骤、依赖关系和44轮对话（含取消、重做、陷阱探针）。他们从用户简报编译出任务状态机，并对比四种状态-耦合阶梯：(1)原始记录（baseline）；(2)文本清单（展示）；(3)指令门（告知）；(4)执行门（拒绝违规）。评估采用精确字符串匹配（ref码+工单号）进行严格集成功评分，使用三种模型（Qwen3-35B/235B、DeepSeek V4 Pro）、两种推理模式、两个领域，并通过τ²-bench航空和PM-Bench进行外部迁移验证。
AI.result: 核心发现：(1)无per-turn推理时，四级阶梯严格成功率在Qwen3-235B上从0.38→0.55→0.84→0.98递增；(2)智能体自写的未经验证台账胜过向其展示的准确清单；(3)指令门的收益与模型服从性成正比；(4)执行门不需要服从性，但受其状态正确性和匹配器约束；(5)在τ²-bench航空上执行门将235B智能体pass¹从0.39提升至0.54；(6)在PM-Bench上展示记录反而最佳，强制匹配器判断则使35B智能体低于原始基线。结论：强化执行在失败可被状态判定且频繁时有效，但当门控判断错误时反而有害。
AI.conclusion: 显示的任务状态仅在模型遵从时有效，指令仅在模型服从时有效，强化执行仅在其状态和匹配器正确时有效。强化所属状态在失败可由状态判定且频繁时带来收益，在失败稀少时无变化，而在行动取决于状态无法做出的判断时可能造成损害。论文贡献为：测试平台、发现、阶梯和外部迁移验证，并附带完整开源的生成器、评分器、臂实现和日志。

title: TCMaster: Confidence-Aware Querying and Workload-Guided Physical Design for Multi-Source Traditional Chinese Medicine Knowledge Graphs
summary: Multi-source knowledge graphs (KGs) need query mechanisms that expose reliability and exploit domain structure. This paper presents TCMaster, a property-graph query substrate for confidence-aware traversal and workload-guided physical design over Traditional Chinese Medicine KGs. TCMaster integrates pharmacopoeias, prescriptions, molecular databases, and LLM-extracted micro-semantics into a KG with approximately 221K entities and 723K base edges. It annotates edges with provenance-level confidence, rewrites Cypher queries with confidence predicates, ranks multi-hop paths under PRODUCT, MIN, or weighted-average policies, and uses ontology skew through direction selection, herb-attribute bitmaps, and materialized shortcut edges. On Neo4j, direction selection improves attribute lookup by a factor of 1.47, shortcuts accelerate high-fanout target counting by a factor of 4.42, confidence filtering removes 39.3 percent of low-quality heterogeneous paths, and KG retrieval improves TCMbench QA accuracy by 20.0 percentage points.

AI.tldr: TCMaster是一个面向中医药多源知识图谱的属性图查询系统，通过置信度感知的遍历和工作负载驱动的物理设计，在Neo4j上实现毫秒级多跳证据检索，并显著提升下游KG-RAG的临床问答精度。
AI.motivation: 中医药知识图谱存在三个数据管理挑战：(1) 不同来源（药典、处方、分子数据库、LLM提取的微观语义、预测链接）的证据可靠性差异显著；(2) 本体高度倾斜（少量属性节点连接超过15K草本节点），通用图引擎无法利用这种结构不对称性；(3) 临床KG-RAG、处方安全审查和药物靶点发现需要交互式多跳检索。现有TCM资源（如TCMSP、TCMID、SymMap、HERB 2.0、ETCM）均不联合解决置信度暴露、路径查询和工作负载导向的物理设计问题。
AI.method: TCMaster在Neo4j 4.4上构建包含221K实体、723K基础边和2875万物化快捷边的知识图谱，分五层（分子/属性/处方/微观语义/临床）。核心方法包括：(1) 两遍置信度标注——保留上游资源的逐边置信度，缺失时按五级源类别（AUTHORITATIVE 0.95、AUTHORITATIVE_PHARMA 0.90、CURATED 0.85、LLM_EXTRACTED 0.70、PREDICTED 0.30-0.60）分配默认值；(2) Cypher透明重写——ConfidenceQueryRewriter自动注入置信度谓词，PathRanker在结果返回后按PRODUCT/MIN/WAVG（权重w_i=1/(1+log i)）聚合路径置信度，支持增量更新（4.7-5.4 ms/边）；(3) 工作负载导向的三种物理设计——基于基数倾斜的方向反转（属性→草本）、28位草本属性位图（性质5位/味7位/归经12位/毒性4位）、物化REACHES_TARGET快捷边（用于高频3跳处方→靶点遍历）。系统采用选择性重写策略，仅在工作负载满足结构前提时应用各优化。
AI.result: 在Neo4j 4.4上，1-4跳工作负载延迟5.2-12.0 ms；方向反转使属性查找提升1.47倍；物化快捷边使高扇出靶点计数提升4.42倍（51.19→11.57 ms），但对top-k查找仅提升1.17倍；位图单属性过滤仅1.03倍；快捷边加置信度谓词组合反而变慢（0.65倍）。置信度过滤在θ=0.18时移除Q3 39.3%的低质量异构路径，θ=0.30时移除69.5%。数据质量方面，草本-成分模糊匹配精度93.7%，成分-靶点精度100%，LLM微观语义审计精度95.5%，处方组成召回76.0%。下游TCMbench（2000题）KG-RAG总体精度72.5%，较基线和Vector-RAG提升20.0 pp（临床处方+27.4 pp，安全审查+32.0 pp）。
AI.conclusion: TCMaster证明了置信度和本体结构可以作为中医药知识图谱查询执行的一等信号，但其效益严格依赖于工作负载与结构假设的匹配。方向反转适用于选择性属性查询，物化快捷边适用于高扇出完全展开，而top-k查找、位图过滤和快捷边-置信度组合并不一致优于Neo4j原生规划器，这说明改写策略必须保持选择性而非追求通用优化。局限性包括固定源类别置信度、L1-L3外的扩展缩放、规则化重写选择和单一处方案例研究，未来工作将探索动态置信度学习、自适应KG-RAG检索和成本驱动的重写选择。

title: LingLan: An Advancing Traditional Chinese Medicine Diagnosis LLM with Multimodal Data
summary: Though artificial intelligence (AI) increasingly transforms modern medicine, its integration into Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) has been relatively slow, primarily due to TCM's reliance on holistic, subjective diagnostic methods---namely Inspection, Auscultation and Olfaction, Inquiry, and Palpation(I-AOI-P)---which are difficult to align with quantitative, standardized medical systems. In this work, we introduce a Unification Framework for Multimodal Data (UFMD), which automatically processes tongue and pulse images into structured, clinically standard descriptions, integrating multi-source diagnostic information into a unified digital record of I-AOI-P process. Building on this structured data, we create LingLan-14B, a TCM-specific large language model fine-tuned via supervised learning to emulate the diagnostic logic and workflow of I-AOI-P process. Experimental results show that our method significantly enhances diagnostic accuracy, achieving a relative improvement of 103.5% over the baseline (62.72% vs. 30.82%) and reaching an F1-score of up to 82%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向中医（TCM）诊断的多模态大语言模型框架UFMD，并基于此构建了中医专用大模型LingLan-14B，通过将舌诊、脉诊等图像信息转化为结构化文本描述，模拟"望闻问切"（I-AOI-P）诊疗流程，在TCM诊断任务上显著优于基线模型，准确率达62.72%，F1-score达82%。
AI.motivation: 中医依赖望闻问切（I-AOI-P）的整体性、主观性诊断方法，难以与现代量化、标准化医疗体系兼容。现有AI辅助中医诊断存在精度不足、多模态异构数据融合困难以及高质量数据集稀缺等问题，亟需通过算法创新与高质量数据资源构建来弥补这一差距。
AI.method: 1) **UFMD（多模态数据统一框架）**：利用DeepSeek-OCR模型从舌诊图像、脉诊波形图像及病历中提取结构化文本，再通过MLLM审查与专家验证，并使用Sentence-BERT计算提取文本与原始文本的余弦相似度以检测幻觉。共处理超120,000份中医临床记录。2) **LingLan-14B**：以Qwen3-14B为基座，采用LoRA（r=8, α=32）进行参数高效微调，将舌诊、脉诊的结构化描述与问诊信息按I-AOI-P模板整合作为训练数据。
AI.result: 在中医诊断任务上，LingLan-14B以准确率62.72%、召回率82.03%、F1-score 82.02%全面超越Qwen3-14B（30.82%）、Qwen3-32B、BianCang-14B-Instruct、DeepSeek-R1等基线，相对准确率提升达103.5%。消融实验表明，使用结构化数据进行SFT比原始数据的诊断准确率从37.90%提升至63.34%，验证了I-AOI-P结构化数据框架的有效性。训练效率上仅需单卡RTX 5090训练12小时，显著优于BianCang-14B-Instruct的8×A100训练605小时。
AI.conclusion: UFMD框架与LingLan-14B模型有效解决了中医多模态异构数据整合难题，通过结构化的I-AOI-P诊断流程实现了中医诊断性能的显著提高，达到SOTA水平，验证了结构化数据整合与微调策略的有效性。未来将发布匿名化数据，并探索方法在更大模型上的可扩展性。

title: OmniFysics-Nano-V2 Technical Report: Understanding the Physical World Across Modalities
summary: Omni-modal models have expanded multimodal interaction across vision, audio, speech, and language. However, their training is predominantly organized around semantic descriptions and general-purpose objectives, leaving physical attributes, interaction states, and causal mechanisms only partially specified. This gap is not simply a matter of modality coverage: adding more modalities does not by itself provide the supervision needed to connect observations with the physical structure of the world. We present OmniFysics-Nano-V2, a compact omni-modal model for physical-world perception and understanding. The model supports image, video, audio, speech, and text inputs within a shared reasoning framework, together with text and speech generation. To address the lack of explicit physical supervision, we construct a dual-branch physics-aware data pipeline that grounds salient objects in structured physical attributes and aligns visual changes with acoustic events, intermediate responses, and interaction outcomes. To address homogeneous training objectives, we curate reinforcement-learning prompts by reward diversity and adopt a two-stage Group Relative Policy Optimization curriculum that progresses from general task correctness to fine-grained physical perceptual reasoning. Experiments across multimodal, audio-visual, and physical reasoning benchmarks show that the proposed data and training strategy improves physical-world understanding while preserving broad omni-modal competence. The proposed model achieves leading result on 17 of 21 benchmarks against SOTA omni-modal models. By equipping AI systems with both omni-modal and physical-world perception capabilities, OmniFysics-Nano-V2 is poised to become a cornerstone of next-generation Physical AI.

AI.tldr: OmniFysics-Nano-V2 是一个 4B 参数的全模态模型，专为物理世界感知与理解而设计。它通过双分支物理感知数据管道（静态属性与动态事件）和两阶段 GRPO 课程学习，在 21 个基准测试中的 17 个上达到 SOTA，同时支持文本与语音输出生成。
AI.motivation: 现有的全模态模型主要围绕语义描述和通用目标进行训练，缺乏对物理属性、交互状态和因果机制的显式监督。增加更多模态并不能直接提供连接观测与世界物理结构所需的监督信号，这限制了模型对物理世界的理解能力。
AI.method: 1) 双分支物理感知数据管道：静态分支通过对象过滤、物理分析、原型检索（1209 个对象-材料原型）和属性精化来标注物体材料、本征属性等；动态分支通过事件过滤、片段选择（使用 Qwen3-VL-Embedding-8B）和密集多模态标注对齐视觉变化与声学事件。2) 奖励多样性过滤的 RL 数据策展：对每个候选提示采样 4 个随机响应，仅保留奖励值有变化的提示，节省超过 2600 GPU 小时。3) 两阶段 GRPO 课程学习：第一阶段使用答案级奖励优化通用任务正确性，第二阶段加入中间感知奖励（物理属性、材料识别）和格式奖励进行细粒度物理感知推理。4) 可微分物理引擎联合优化：通过感知-仿真-标定循环将视觉推断的物理参数迭代精化为仿真就绪参数。5) 统一架构：使用共享因果 Transformer，文本、视觉、声学特征交错输入，语音生成通过交叉注意力复用答案隐藏状态。
AI.result: 在 21 个基准测试中的 17 个上取得领先成绩，包括：FysicsEval Understanding 达 98.27%（提升 5.57%），PhysUniBench 达 59.42%（提升 11.42%），Daily-Omni 达 85.24%（提升 31.82 点），Video-MME 达 80.89%，MMAU 达 76.80，MMStar 达 75.27。消融实验验证了静态和动态物理监督的互补贡献，以及两阶段 RL 课程的必要性。人类评估显示生成的语音在自然度、清晰度和语义忠实度上均优于原生 CosyVoice3。在具身场景中，该模型可预测物体级物理参数以参数化仿真环境，支持接触密集操作的策略自进化。
AI.conclusion: OmniFysics-Nano-V2 通过显式监督从物理观测到有依据答案的证据链，在保持通用全模态能力的同时显著提升了物理世界理解能力。静态监督支持属性推理，动态监督增强时序与跨模态理解，联合音视觉感知为物理交互提供更完整证据。与可微分物理引擎的耦合为连接全模态物理感知与物理基础的状态预测及具身策略优化提供了框架，有望成为下一代 Physical AI 的基石。

title: The Limits of Simulated Societies: How Post-Training and Survey Fine-Tuning Erase Cross-Cultural Variance
summary: Using large language models (LLMs) to simulate diverse human populations has the potential to transform many aspects of computational social science, yet many evaluations score the average response rather than the spread of opinion within real groups. Here, we develop a diagnostic framework that measures point accuracy alongside dispersion retention, the ratio of predicted to human standard deviation ($\dr$), on 10{,}000 respondent--question pairs from the World Values Survey (WVS) spanning twelve countries and six continents. We evaluate eleven zero-shot language models and five variants fine-tuned on WVS data with SFT, DPO, and GRPO. We identify a failure mode we term \textit{consensus collapse}, where alignment training compresses outputs toward one stereotype per group. Along the post-training trajectory from the Llama~3.1 70B base to the Tulu~3 checkpoints, the first stage, supervised instruction tuning, removes half of the spread with minimal accuracy gain ($\dr$ 1.22 to 0.59; accuracy $+0.9$ points), the later stages do not restore it, and a gap opens between WEIRD and non-WEIRD countries that survey fine-tuning then deepens while pursuing higher point accuracy. The most accurate model (Tulu~3 70B-DPO fine-tuned on WVS, 57.9\%) keeps half the human spread overall ($\dr = 0.50$) and 11\% of it for Nigeria, against 0.70--0.87 for WEIRD countries. Raising the sampling temperature to 1.0 leaves the Wasserstein-1 distance ($\wone$) to human distributions unchanged for both fine-tuned DPO models, and GRPO on Qwen~3.5 9B does not restore the spread under either an accuracy reward or a distribution-shaped reward. Mixing the aligned model with an unaligned prior raises $\dr$ from 0.51 to 0.62 on a held-out split but leaves Nigeria at 0.36. Point accuracy alone therefore misjudges these simulators, and current post-training trades diversity for consensus.

AI.tldr: 本文发现LLM模拟人类调查受访者时存在"共识坍缩"(consensus collapse)现象：后训练和对齐微调虽然提高了逐点准确率，但系统性压缩了模型输出的分布方差，抹杀了跨文化差异。最准确的模型(Tulu 3 70B-DPO +WVS, 57.9%准确率)仅保留了人类响应分布方差的一半(σr=0.50)，且对尼日利亚等非WEIRD国家仅为11%。该现象无法通过提高采样温度恢复，且呈现出系统性的WEIRD/非WEIRD不平等。
AI.motivation: LLM作为计算社会科学中人类调查受访者的替代品(subpopulation representative modeling, SRM)具有巨大潜力，但现有评估方法主要依赖平均准确率，而忽略了模型输出分布与真实人类群体内部分布的匹配程度。研究团队指出对齐训练可能加剧群体多样性扁平化的问题，并需要系统性地量化这一失败模式。
AI.method: 基于世界价值观调查(WVS)第7波数据，构建"价值编码人格"(value-encoded personas, 约60词，包含Inglehart-Welzel文化地图维度)。评估11个零样本模型和5个WVS微调变体(SFT/DPO/GRPO)，跨12国6大洲共10,000对受访者-问题样本。提出四个诊断指标：准确率、MAE、Wasserstein-1距离(W₁)和偏差比(σr = σ预测/σ真实)，后者衡量分散度保留(dispersion retention)。
AI.result: 1. SFT阶段已将σr从1.22压缩至0.59(去除一半方差)，准确率仅提升0.9点；后续DPO/RLVR阶段未能恢复方差。2. 最优模型(Tulu 3 70B-DPO +WVS)σr=0.50，尼日利亚仅0.11，WEIRD国家0.70-0.87。3. 温度扫描(T=0至1.0)未能恢复方差坍缩，W₁保持不变。4. GRPO在Qwen 3.5 9B上使用稀疏准确率奖励几乎无效果，分布形奖励反而加剧坍缩(σr降至0.21)。5. 在Q189("殴打妻子是否正当")上，所有对齐模型对1,544名受访者全部预测"绝对不正当"(σr=0)，尽管肯尼亚均值实际为3.44。6. 先验混合(prior mixing)作为后置探针仅将σr从0.51提升至0.62，尼日利亚仅恢复至0.36。
AI.conclusion: 共识坍缩是当前后训练范式的系统性失败模式：(1)逐点准确率作为评估指标具有误导性，需配合方差感知指标；(2)对齐目标对代表性不足的非西方群体造成不成比例的表征伤害；(3)坍缩不可通过解码策略恢复，需要更丰富的个体级背景(如Park等2024年的访谈式方法)而非输出空间的重新加权。该研究呼吁SRM研究领域超越逐点准确率评估，正视后训练以多样性换取共识的代价。

title: Neurosymbolic Action Model Learning under Partial Observability
summary: AI planning studies how an agent can reach a goal by executing a sequence of actions. To plan correctly, the agent needs an action model describing when each action can be executed and how it changes the world. Constructing such models by hand requires domain expertise, and can be costly and error-prone. Action models can instead be learned from available data using existing neurosymbolic approaches, but they currently assume access to complete traces of fully observable images . These approaches fail to learn action models under partial observability where some of the images might not be present or are not fully informative of the current state of the world. Hence, this paper proposes NeSyAM, a novel neurosymbolic modeling paradigm for action model learning under partial observability. In addition, the paper presents a unified variational framework for theoretically analysing the limitations of existing methods compared to our proposed approach. NeSyAM is then tested extensively on six visual planning domains and three observation regimes to show it consistently recovers relevant parts of the true action model under partial observability.

AI.tldr: NeSyAM 提出了一种在部分可观测性下从视觉轨迹学习动作模型的神经符号方法，通过将概率动作模型与 STRIPS 语义精确结合到关系神经符号马尔可夫模型中，并在六个视觉规划域上验证其在遮挡条件下对相关角色恢复的优越性。
AI.motivation: AI 规划需要动作模型，但手工构建代价高。现有神经符号动作模型学习方法（如 rosame-i）假设视觉轨迹完全可观测，无法处理图像缺失或信息不完整的情形，因此需要一种能在部分可观测性下学习动作模型的方法。
AI.method: 1) 将概率动作模型（PAM）的角色概率与 STRIPS 语义精确组合，构建约束转移函数 p(S_{t+1}|S_t, a_t, φ)；2) 将动作模型学习形式化为隐马尔可夫模型，通过 NeSyMM 进行可微采样；3) 提供最大似然近似和变分近似两种优化途径；4) 建立统一变分框架，从理论上比较 rosame-i（均值场近似）与 NeSyAM（结构化近似）的差异。
AI.result: 在六个视觉规划域（Blocks World、Gripper、Logistics、合成 Blocks World、Hanoi、8-Puzzle）和三种观测条件下：完全可观测下 NeSyAM 恢复 90/90 相关角色；随机遮挡下恢复 88.33/90；动作遮挡下恢复 89.33/90。相比 rosame-i 在遮挡下分别仅恢复 61.33 和 68，相关角色恢复显著更稳定。但 NeSyAM 在 not-involved 角色上的全候选恢复不如 rosame-i。随问题规模增大 NeSyAM 保持稳定而 rosame-i 退化明显。采样数量 N=2 即足够。
AI.conclusion: NeSyAM 通过时间序列一致的轨迹采样和 STRIPS 约束的精确转移函数，在部分可观测性下能更稳定地恢复动作定义性谓词的角色，理论变分视角解释了 rosame-i 失败的原因。主要局限在于无法从正例轨迹区分 pre 与 not-involved 角色，未来可通过极小性假设或包含相关谓词为假的轨迹来缓解。

title: Towards Omni-dimensional GUI Agent Navigation with Masked Trajectory Prediction
summary: Graphical User Interface (GUI) Agents autonomously interact with software to fulfill user requests, where GUI navigation stands out as the most critical and challenging capability. Mastering this capability demands a complex synergy of step-wise decision-making, state-action alignment, and long-horizon planning. While directly mixing these corresponding navigation tasks seems intuitive to simultaneously acquire these skills, such a direct combination is severely bottlenecked by inconsistent optimization objectives and profound data heterogeneity. To overcome these barriers, we propose the MaP (stands for ``\textbf{M}asked Tr\textbf{a}jectory \textbf{P}rediction''), a unified framework that seamlessly harmonizes divergent GUI navigation tasks. By modeling multi-turn GUI interactions as a trajectory and defining training objectives through component masking and prediction, MaP shifts the optimization from task-specific marginal distributions to a consistent objective. Furthermore, to handle the data heterogeneity across multiple navigation tasks, we design a role-aware adapter learning module that dynamically routes each token to a specialized representation space. Extensive experiments on five representative GUI navigation benchmarks demonstrate that MaP effectively mitigates gradient conflicts and significantly outperforms the direct mixture training, establishing a robust paradigm for multi-task GUI navigation.

AI.tldr: 本文针对GUI智能体导航中的多任务混合训练难题，提出了MaP（Masked Trajectory Prediction）统一框架。该方法将多轮GUI交互建模为轨迹，通过对任意轨迹组件进行掩码并预测，将三种导航范式（逐步决策、状态-动作对齐、长程规划）的优化目标统一为对完整轨迹联合分布的学习。同时，设计了角色感知适配器学习模块（role-aware adapter），基于token语义角色动态路由到专用表示空间，以应对异构GUI语料中的数据异质性。在五个代表性GUI导航基准（AndroidWorld、AndroidControl、GUI-Odyssey、AITZ、Mind2Web）上的实验表明，MaP有效缓解了梯度冲突，显著优于直接混合训练，并为多任务GUI导航建立了稳健的范式。
AI.motivation: GUI智能体导航能力需要逐步决策、状态-动作对齐与长程规划三种核心能力的协同。然而，直接混合训练这三种对应任务面临两个根本瓶颈：(1) 优化目标不一致——三种范式各自捕获GUI交互的不同边缘分布，对应不同的部分依赖关系；(2) 数据异质性——不同任务来源的语料在推理风格、标注协议和界面域上存在显著差异，阻碍了统一建模。这导致直接混合训练仅带来边际性能提升，甚至出现负迁移问题。
AI.method: 提出MaP框架，包含两个核心组件：(1) 掩码轨迹预测（Masked Trajectory Prediction）——将多轮GUI交互形式化为轨迹T = (Inst, {(m_t, r_t, a_t)})，随机掩码轨迹中固定比例（约80%）的组件（如推理过程r_t、动作a_t），并以自回归方式预测被掩码部分，从而将任务特定的边缘分布优化转变为对完整轨迹联合分布的一致性优化；(2) 角色感知适配器学习模块（Role-Aware Adapter Learning）——扩展LoRA机制，为GUI轨迹中的高/低层指令、截图、推理、动作等不同语义角色的token设置多个专用适配器，并使用token级路由器（基于线性打分函数 arg max_i(w_i^⊤ x)）动态选择合适的适配器，以处理数据异质性。
AI.result: 在五个GUI导航基准上的实验：(1) 零样本性能——MaP在逐步决策、状态-动作对齐、长程规划上分别比直接混合训练提升2.8%、5.4%、2.1%；(2) 后训练性能——以Qwen2.5-VL为基础模型，MaP-7B在AndroidControl-High/Low、GUI-Odyssey、AITZ、Mind2Web上分别获得3.0%/2.7%、3.4%、3.0%、2.2%的SR提升，超越UI-TARS等强基线；(3) 在线评估——AndroidWorld上Pass@1和Pass@4分别提升2.6%和5.4%；(4) 梯度分析——MaP使LM head和注意力k-投影层的梯度余弦相似度均值提升约0.17、方差降低约0.02，表明优化方向更一致、训练更稳定；(5) 消融实验——掩码比率0.8为最优，适配器数量为4时达到峰值性能。
AI.conclusion: MaP通过统一的掩码轨迹预测目标和角色感知适配器机制，有效解决了多任务GUI导航混合训练中的目标不一致与数据异质性问题，将冲突的多任务优化信号整合为一致的学习目标，显著优于直接混合训练，在多个公开基准上达到了先进的性能，建立了异构GUI语料联合训练的新范式。限制方面，当前实验主要使用中等规模基础模型和公开语料，未充分探索更大规模LVLM和更丰富训练数据的扩展潜力。

title: The Tasteful Agent: Measuring and Improving Taste in Long-Horizon Tasks
comment: 33 pages, 6 figures. Code: this https URL . Dataset: this https URL
summary: LLM agents increasingly work on long-horizon tasks, and the decisions they make along the way, such as which hypothesis to test or which implementation to build on, determine the outcome of the whole run. Making these decisions well is becoming a key capability for both engineering and research agents. We refer to the ability to make good long-horizon decisions as the taste of an agent. While existing benchmarks measure the end-to-end success of agents on long-horizon tasks, none of them measures the taste of an agent. To address this problem, we build Taste-Bench, a benchmark of taste questions constructed automatically from trajectories that agents produced in engineering and research tasks. Each question presents a decision fork, a point in a trajectory where multiple directions are available and one of them leads to a better outcome, and the evaluated model chooses among these directions without seeing what happens after the fork. We mine these forks automatically from parallel attempts at the same task and from detours inside a single trajectory, without needing human annotation. We evaluate frontier models on Taste-Bench and find that the best model answers only 59.7% of the questions correctly. We further find that forks whose deciding evidence appears later in the trajectory are much harder for every model, and that a larger reasoning budget does not improve the accuracy. Finally, we show that taste can be trained. We distill the judgment of a teacher that has seen the outcome into a student model, and the student makes better decisions on unseen tasks and improves end-to-end success on held-out SWE-bench Pro tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"品味(taste)"概念来衡量LLM智能体在长时任务中做出关键决策的能力，并构建了Taste-Bench基准(502道决策分叉题)自动从已有轨迹中挖掘标注，无需专家参与。实验显示前沿模型在该基准上准确率最高仅59.7%，远未饱和；推理预算增加无法提升品味；但通过蒸馏教师模型的判断能力，学生模型在未见任务上获得+17.9百分点的判断提升，并在SWE-bench Pro上将执行体成功率从14.6%提升到33.7%。
AI.motivation: 现有长时任务基准(如SWE-bench、RE-Bench)只衡量端到端成功与否，无法区分智能体在轨迹中做出的具体决策质量。一个错误的决策在当时看起来合理，但其代价只在后续工作中才显现。研究者希望自动量化这种"品味"能力，且无需昂贵的人工标注。
AI.method: 1) 形式化"决策分叉(decision fork)"：从同一任务的多次并行尝试中找出分歧点，或从单条轨迹的"绕道(detour)"中识别智能体自我纠正的转折点；以分叉后的执行结果(测试结果或研究得分)作为标签，标注哪个方向更优。2) 构建Taste-Bench：502题(390工程+112研究)，2×2设计(并行/绕道 × 工程/研究)；采用四模型(Kimi K2.5、GPT-4.1、Llama 4 Maverick、Mistral Large 3)做双重过滤(剔除可从选项文字直接猜出的trivial题、剔除标签未被全体评委认可的undecidable题)。3) 评估协议：每题以正反两个候选顺序各测一次，两次均答对才算正确，以控制位置偏差。4) 品味可训练：以Qwen3.6-27B为底座，将带有正确示范的教师推理蒸馏到学生LoRA；采用前向KL、教师采样连续段、任务不交叉折。5) 端到端评估：把学生在每个分叉处的判断作为建议注入执行体SWE-agent的任务上下文。
AI.result: 主要发现：(1) 前沿模型品味有限——GPT-5.6 Sol平均59.7%，GPT-5.5为59.5%，其余模型差异较大；绕道题比并行题更难，差距超过工程与研究领域间的差距。(2) 决策证据出现得越晚，模型准确率越低：从"在前缀中可见"的62.3%降至"需要更多后续工作"的21.0%。(3) 增加推理预算不提升品味：GPT-5.6 Sol在三种推理强度下差异仅-0.2分，Luna仅+2.2分，且两者都在最难层级产生最多推理token。(4) 与SWE-bench Verified相关性仅为r=+0.63，说明品味并非端到端能力的重述。(6) 人类审查100题，标签一致率98.8%，Cohen's κ=0.973。(7) 蒸馏：学生在未见折上的准确率从30.0%提升到47.9%(+17.9分)，平均准确率从42.7%提升到62.4%。(8) 端到端：在41个未见SWE-bench Pro任务上，正确建议将成功率从14.6%提升到39.0%(上界)；学生建议将成功率从14.6%提升到33.7%(+19.1分)，达到上界的约83%。
AI.conclusion: 品味——智能体在结果尚不可见时做出更好长时决策的能力——可从结果后视自动测量。Taste-Bench作为502道决策分叉基准，覆盖工程与研究两个领域，揭示了当前前沿模型在该能力上的显著不足，且推理预算无法弥补这一差距。品味是可训练的：通过蒸馏带有正确示范的教师推理，学生模型在未见任务上获得更好的判断，并有效转化为端到端任务成功率的提升。该工作为长时智能体的决策质量测量与训练提供了实用基础。

title: When Are Aggregate Agent Traces Diagnosable? Traffic-Governed Interpretation and Calibrated Abstention
comment: 9 pages, 1 figure, 4 tables. The reproducibility artifact is linked in the paper
summary: Runtime traces can appear transparent, but a closed-loop policy determines which states are visited and which failures become visible. We study a simulated hotel-pricing agent mapping time, inventory, and market state to discrete price actions under varying demand regimes. A fault may leave no aggregate trace when the policy rarely visits affected cells. We treat entry into aggregate-only fault interpretation as a diagnosability decision preceding scoring or localization. A reference-map gate requires repeated clean-policy support; a matched runtime gate then requires joint support in clean and current streams. Signal analysis occurs only after both pass. We calibrate false admission on a disjoint clean stream at the physical-component level and model detection by affected clean traffic rather than nominal cell coverage. In a frozen one-shot heldout, 55/72 (76.4%) regime-component units were reference-admitted, representing 20 physical components; 54/55 passed matched runtime admission, while the rejected unit abstained. Stable false admission was 0/20, with a one-sided exact 95% upper bound of 0.1391, meeting the frozen 0.20 criterion. Across 540 repeated unit-arm rows nested in those 20 clusters, affected clean traffic reduced negative log likelihood by 29.3% relative to cell coverage, a gain of 0.1264 nats per row (cluster-bootstrap 95% interval [0.0593, 0.1918]). Adding mask family and its interaction improved log loss by 0.0015 nats per row (one-sided upper bound 0.0066), below the frozen 0.01 practical-sufficiency margin. A development audit found that exact minimum hitting set and greedy selection chose identical supports in 12/12 scenarios because singleton evidence had resolved the conflicts. The result is a bounded rule for interpreting aggregate agent behavior: first establish exposure, then score change, and abstain when the trace cannot support the claim.

AI.tldr: 本文研究封闭循环智能体（如酒店定价智能体）聚合运行时轨迹的可诊断性问题，提出了一种基于"暴露先行"的诊断准入框架，明确区分"轨迹无法支持故障解释"与"有可比证据但无稳定信号"两种情形。
AI.motivation: 封闭循环智能体的策略决定哪些状态被访问，因此某些组件故障可能因策略很少访问受影响的区域而在聚合轨迹中完全不可见。无视暴露条件的轨迹解释可能将"证据缺失"误判为"无故障"，或将正常漂移误报为故障。因此在评分或定位之前，需先判断当前轨迹是否具备支持故障解释的资格。
AI.method: 采用双门控工作流：(1) 参考图门控（reference-map gate）要求组件在干净策略流中被反复访问（至少14/15分区支持）；(2) 匹配运行时门控（runtime gate）要求干净流与当前流在同一分区联合支持（至少14/15）。仅当两门通过后才进行稳定信号分析。信号通过 region_d1 与 mean_action_gap 的 z 阈值判断；引入"受影响干净流量"（affected clean traffic, τ）替代单元覆盖率作为行为对齐的暴露变量。假阳率校准在干净流上以物理组件粒度进行（精确二项式95%上限）。
AI.result: 在冻结单次预留测试中：72个regime-component单元中有55个(76.4%)通过参考准入，覆盖20/24物理组件；其中54/55通过运行时准入，被拒单元主动弃权；稳定假阳率0/20，单侧精确95%上限为0.1391，满足≤0.20安全准则。540个unit-arm行中，受影响干净流量比单元覆盖率使负对数似然降低29.3%（0.1264 nats/行），集群自助法95%CI [0.0593, 0.1918]。加入掩模家族及其交互项仅带来0.0015 nats/行增益（单侧上限0.0066），低于0.01实际充分性阈值。开发审计发现精确最小命中集（MHS）与贪心选择在12/12场景中选择相同支撑——因为单例证据已解决冲突，故MHS无优势。
AI.conclusion: 聚合智能体轨迹的解释应遵循有界规则：先建立暴露，再评分变化，并在轨迹无法支持声明时弃权。本文将封闭循环下的可诊断性、选择性预测和局部支持特征综合为一种前置定位（pre-localization）流程：优化与可观测性是分离的，精确MHS可在编译目标上最优但未必能识别物理故障；只有先确认聚合轨迹具备支持组件级故障解释的资格，信号评分才有解释价值。

title: Optimizing the Score, Losing Sight of the Task: Reward Hacking Across Weights, Selection, and Prompts
summary: A higher evaluation score does not always mean a better language model system. When optimization exploits an evaluator's mistakes, measured progress can conceal unchanged or deteriorating task performance. This failure can arise through parameter updates, selection among generated outputs, or revisions to persistent prompts. We develop a comparative framework for reward hacking across these three optimization substrates: weights, selection, and text. Building on the Proxy Compression Hypothesis and research on inference-time and in-context reward hacking, we examine how reachable behavior, optimization budgets, and persistent adaptation shape exposure to proxy error. We formalize a distance-dependent upper bound on evaluator disagreement and a capacity ordering for nested policy classes, then show why distance alone cannot establish a universal ranking of vulnerability. An exact finite-output illustration demonstrates how the location of a scoring defect changes the behavior favored by each method. We also map representative defenses across substrates, identifying which mechanisms transfer directly and which offer only functional analogies. Persistent prompts receive particular attention: their contents are inspectable, but the behavior induced by a small textual change may be difficult to anticipate. The formal analysis, numerical illustration, and published evidence together provide a basis for comparing optimization methods and identifying the conditions under which their defenses transfer. The resulting framework connects optimization choices to verification requirements: reliable improvement depends on controlling accessible failure modes and preserving evidence of task quality independent of the score being optimized.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个统一的比较框架，用于分析语言模型系统中三种优化基底（权重更新、输出选择、持久提示）下的奖励黑客问题。通过形式化可达行为、优化预算和代理误差之间的关系，作者建立了一个评估奖励黑客脆弱性的理论框架，并提供了防御机制的跨基底映射。
AI.motivation: 在语言模型优化过程中，评估分数的提升并不总是意味着任务表现的真正改善。当优化利用评估器的缺陷时，可能出现"奖励黑客"现象——即分数上升但任务质量不变或下降的问题。现有文献分散地讨论了不同优化机制（参数训练、推理时选择、提示优化）下的奖励黑客现象，但缺乏统一的比较框架。该研究旨在填补这一空白，通过将三种优化方式置于同一形式化框架下，帮助研究者理解不同方法的脆弱性差异以及防御机制的迁移性。
AI.method: 该研究采用形式化分析与有限个实证相结合的方法。技术上定义了预算策略类、代理奖励与任务奖励、行为散度（KL散度）等核心概念。建立了两个关键命题：（1）可达性约束代理间隙定理：在共同误差包络假设下，策略类的最大代理间隙受限于其最远可达距离；（2）包含序定理：如果策略类A包含于B，则A的最坏情况间隙不超过B。通过反例证明距离本身不能建立脆弱性的通用排序——某些情况下，更远的策略类反而具有更小的间隙。利用一个五输出的精确数值模型展示了不同评分缺陷位置如何影响各优化方法的行为。提出防御对应表，区分已建立机制、功能类比和提议迁移三个层次的证据强度。
AI.result: 理论结果表明：行为正则化可以约束误差包络；更丰富的策略类可以包含更严重的利用——但仅当它实际包含相关策略时。子空间标签本身不能确定特定代理误差如何与策略类相交。选择空间受限于生成器采样的候选，但可以在不改变生成器的情况下集中在狭窄的利用上。提示可以通过共享指令一次性移动多个输出，这在发现有用规则或系统评分捷径方面具有双重作用。参数更新可以通过多个自由度重新分配行为，但可能需要大量反馈才能发现特定变化。数值示例显示：在代理A下，柔性分布优化从0.3085（基线）改善到约0.666后过优化至0.398；选择方法达到约0.680后集中于输出e并接近真实奖励0.100。在代理B下，由于利用附近已可访问的误差，有界调节也产生严重不一致（真实奖励约0.042而代理奖励0.870）。该框架将基于Wahi等人的PROCTOR架构和工程实践提供的真实证据——包括法官短语模仿、合同分析套件的100%被利用通过率与44.1%的干净基线组合，以及腐败标签引发的回归等。
AI.conclusion: 该论文构建了一个统一的比较框架来理解权重、选择和持久提示三种优化基底下的奖励黑客问题。核心结论是：奖励黑客源于对任务表征不充分的信号进行优化，而基底的选择决定了哪些行为可达、什么信息持久、以及什么可以被检查或约束。论文明确指出，距离本身不足以建立通用脆弱性排序；类包含关系提供了能力排序，但具体方法发现的利用行为还取决于搜索几何和效率。对于实践者，防御对应关系提供了最直接的指导：改进评估器、约束可接受行为、保留独立任务质量证据、并明确指定当证据与优化分数不一致时的响应。中心设计原则是：通过独立于优化分数的证据来判断改进对任务的实际影响。持久提示提供了独特的可检查性优势，但必须辅以行为评估。

title: Prediction Is Not Detection: Evaluating Pre-Recognition Claims in Longitudinal Clinical AI
comment: 27 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables, 1 box; includes Supplementary Note
summary: Clinically useful early detection requires validated pre-recognition lead time.
