Yet event-based evaluations of longitudinal clinical AI can treat recognition-mediated care-process signals as shortcuts and recognition-dependent endpoints as reference standards, inflating apparent performance and lead time while undermining cross-center transport. Such results may serve prognosis without establishing detection before recognition. We define an interval-censored pre-recognition transition, an independent as-of reference standard, and a prespecified recognition proxy to make the claim testable.

AI.tldr: 本文指出纵向临床AI的事件驱动评估存在缺陷：将识别介导的诊疗过程信号当作捷径，将依赖识别的终点当作参考标准，从而虚增表观性能和提前期，削弱跨中心泛化能力。作者提出了一种可检验的声明框架，包括区间删失的识别前转换、独立"截至某时"的参考标准以及预设的识别代理指标。
AI.motivation: 当前纵向临床AI的早期检测评估中，存在将"识别"（recognition）相关的诊疗过程信号和终点不当用作评估基准的问题，导致性能指标和提前期（lead time）被高估，无法真正验证AI在临床识别之前实现检测的能力，也损害了模型在不同医疗中心间的可迁移性。
AI.method: 提出一个概念框架来定义和检验临床AI的真正早期检测能力：(1) 定义区间删失的"识别前转换"（pre-recognition transition），以处理时间不确定性问题；(2) 采用独立于识别过程的"截至某时"（as-of）参考标准，避免参考标准本身依赖临床识别；(3) 预设识别代理（recognition proxy），使检测领先于识别的声明可被经验证检验。
AI.result: 该内容为方法论/立场论文，尚未呈现具体实验结果。其核心贡献在于揭示了当前评估范式中的系统性偏差来源，并提供了使"AI在临床识别前实现检测"这一声明变得可操作、可验证的概念工具。
AI.conclusion: 若不区分真正的检测能力与识别介导的信号捷径，纵向临床AI的早期检测评估将持续产生误导性结论。本文提出的框架为严格评估"识别前检测"提供了必要的方法学基础，强调参考标准和评估信号的独立性对确保跨中心泛化的重要性。

title: AgenticSizing: A Large Language Model-based Multi-Agent Framework for Analog Circuit Sizing
summary: Analog circuit sizing remains a challenging and time-consuming task due to the large design space, strong performance trade-offs, and increasing circuit complexity in scaled technologies. Although recent large language model (LLM)-based methods show promise in improving sample efficiency and interpretability, existing approaches often lack explicit circuit-topology understanding and are mainly evaluated on relatively simple analog building blocks. This paper presents a multi-agent LLM-based framework for complex analog circuit sizing. The proposed framework first analyzes the circuit topology and decomposes the netlist into functional blocks and substructures. It also extracts lightweight design knowledge for reuse. Based on the extracted topology and knowledge, a planner coordinates multiple role-specialized sizing agents to update design variables and achieve global performance specifications. This workflow mimics the collaborative process of an expert analog design team and provides a structured, interpretable, and simulation-driven optimization procedure. The framework was validated on eight circuits, with the largest design containing up to 55 transistors and 60 sizing variables. Notably, for the LDO benchmark, the proposed method achieved a 60\% success rate with an average of 83 iterations, where classical optimizers failed to find feasible solutions. Further, ablation studies demonstrate that topology understanding, design-knowledge infusion, and agent specialization provide complementary benefits. The source code is available to support reproducibility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AgenticSizing，一种基于大语言模型(LLM)的多智能体框架，用于复杂模拟电路尺寸优化。该框架通过电路拓扑理解、两步分解(功能角色划分与子结构标注)、知识提取与重用，以及规划器-执行器(planner-sizer)的1+N多智能体协作机制，模拟专家设计团队的协同过程。在8个电路上验证(含最大55晶体管、60设计变量的集成LDO)，AgenticSizing在高复杂度场景下显著优于差分进化(DE)、贝叶斯优化(BO)及多智能体强化学习(MA-RL)等基线方法，消融实验证实拓扑理解、知识注入与智能体专业化具有互补增益。
AI.motivation: 模拟电路尺寸设计面临设计空间巨大、性能指标强耦合、晶体管数量随工艺节点缩减而复杂度激增等难题。现有EDA方法(进化算法、贝叶斯优化、强化学习)虽有效但仿真成本高、可解释性差；近年LLM-based方法虽具备样本效率与可解释性优势，但缺乏显式电路拓扑理解，且多局限于简单基本单元，难以扩展到含50+晶体管的实用电路。
AI.method: 四阶段框架：(1)LLM分解器两阶段分解——先按功能角色(主增益级、偏置网络、反馈网络等)划分器件，再将角色分解为受控本体子结构(差分对、电流镜、共源共栅等)；采用规范化本体(ontology)保证跨电路一致性；(2)基于LangGraph构建1+N规划器-执行器模式，规划器进行全局规范排序与角色调度，角色sizer在其作用域变量上进行局部参数更新；(3)闭环迭代优化由Cadence Spectre仿真驱动；(4)知识提取器从仿真轨迹抽取四类结构化知识(性能权衡、角色-性能关系、子结构-参数-性能关系、迁移启发式)，供后续任务复用。底层LLM为GPT-5.2，温度0.5，最大5000 tokens。
AI.result: 在8个电路(3类：OTA、BGR、LDO)上五次重复实验对比DE、BO、MARL基线。BGR：AgenticSizing 4/5成功率，平均仅22.75次仿真(DE需936次)；Two-stage FC：AgenticSizing 80%成功率(11–29次仿真)，三基线全部失败；LDO：AgenticSizing 4/5成功率，平均79次仿真(BO需524次)；高复杂度集成LDO(含BGR与FC，60变量)：AgenticSizing 3/5成功率，平均89.7次仿真，三基线在全部三次尝试中均失败。效率优势随电路复杂度增加而扩大——复杂度提升时LLM推理开销占比降低，SPICE仿真时间主导。消融研究(S0–S4)证实：(a)拓扑标注使成功率从0%升至40%且token消耗降低11.9%；(b)智能体专业化需配合知识库才能生效(S2单独使用反而从40%降至0%；S3+S4组合达60%)；(c)知识注入在多智能体框架中效果最显著(0%→60%)。三项组件呈互补增益。
AI.conclusion: AgenticSizing通过结构化多智能体协作将拓扑理解、知识引导推理与角色分工有机融合，为高维模拟电路尺寸优化提供了一种透明、样本高效的解决方案。其优势在耦合性强、约束严苛的高复杂度电路上尤为突出。未来工作将扩展到更大规模模拟/混合信号系统与先进工艺节点，并改进智能体间通信、记忆机制、验证流程及跨电路族/工艺的知识迁移。

title: CausalLoss-Fin: Attributing Financial-Agent Loss to Decisions and Infrastructure Faults
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Code and reproducibility materials: this https URL
summary: When an agent handling a payment exception loses money, the agent-step attribution methods this paper compares against will name one of its actions. They will do so even when a settlement message was dropped and the agent never had a chance: they intervene on agent actions and do not expose infrastructure faults as intervenable variables, so every dollar they explain is charged to a decision. We take a benchmark whose fault process is explicit and replayable, decompose each episode's realised delivery schedule into named, individually repairable messages, and intervene on both the agent's choices and the infrastructure's. A telescoping identity splits any policy's loss exactly three ways: an infrastructure effect, a policy differential against the best implementable policy, and a reference-policy residual. Two of the three can be negative, so none is a share; Shapley then divides the first into signed allocations over individual messages. One result is structural and needs no corpus: an agent-only baseline identifies no infrastructure cause, because its model contains no variable that could name one. What 545 planted episodes across 3 policies measure is the size of that consequence. It misfiles 100% of infrastructure episodes and charges $114,383.40 to the agent. Repairing what it names recovers 0.0% of the available loss; repairing a minimal sufficient set recovers 100.0%. Scoring messages one at a time is not merely imprecise: 27.8% (95% CI: 23.3--32.3%) of episodes do not decompose additively. We evaluate deterministic programmatic policies rather than language-model agents, which is what makes replay exact and which limits external validity to stochastic agents. The prevalence figures are properties of this generator, not field rates.

AI.tldr: 本文针对金融智能体失败归因问题指出：当基础设施故障（如消息丢失）是损失真实原因时，仅对智能体步骤做干预的归因方法会将所有损失错误归咎于智能体决策，无法识别基础设施原因。基于FinalityBench基准，提出了对智能体决策和基础设施消息同时干预的因果模型，给出精确的三段式损失分解（基础设施效应、策略微分、参考策略残差），并用Shapley值在消息间做带符号分配。实验显示，纯智能体基线将100%的基础设施故障错误归因，错误收取$114,383.40，而最小充分集修复方法以2.3次重放恢复全部可恢复损失。
AI.motivation: 现有因果归因方法（如CAR、CausalFlow、REFLECT）仅以智能体步骤作为可干预变量，在基础设施本身是因果来源的环境中无法命名基础设施原因，导致损失被系统性错误归咎于智能体决策。论文旨在量化这一变量集不完整性的代价，并提供可同时干预基础设施故障的精确归因方案。
AI.method: 1. 在FinalityBench基准上构建因果模型，以案例C和故障实现F={f₁,...,fₘ}为外生变量，以交付时刻表S、各系统视图Vₜ⁽ʲ⁾、智能体动作Aₖ、执行效果E、损失L为内生变量。2. 提出精确三段式恒等式将损失分解为基础设施效应、策略微分（相对于最佳可实施策略π*）、参考策略残差。3. 用Shapley值将基础设施效应在单个消息间做带符号分配。4. 实施七种归因方法（最后动作、最早分歧、智能体仅干预、单故障修复、最小充分集、联合贪心、联合Shapley）。5. 在四个植入地真层（单一70、合取、过决定、智能体）共545个剧集中验证。
AI.result: 智能体仅干预基线在100%的基础设施剧集上错误归因，将$114,383.40的基础设施损失错误归咎于智能体，修复其所命名的内容恢复0.0%的可用损失。最小充分集方法和联合Shapley方法在四个层上均达到100%识别准确率、0%分配误差，前者以每次剧集2.3次重放恢复100%损失，后者需280.1次重放。27.8%（95% CI: 23.3-32.3%）的剧集存在故障交互效应，单消息逐一评分无法加性分解。故障族在FinalityBench中不独立叠加（82.9%剧集失败），必须以实例级别分解。在完整语料上，乐观策略的基础设施效应为-6.8%（故障在净意义上帮助了该策略）。
AI.conclusion: 因果归因的有效性取决于变量集的完整性：将基础设施故障暴露为可干预变量是精确归因的前提，否则损失将被系统性归咎于智能体。三段式恒等式在3852/3852剧集上精确成立，无需置信带。当操作目标是修复而非完整分配时，最小充分集方法是最优选择（2.3次重放，100%恢复）。对于过决定情形，Shapley值在两个充分故障间均分责任。局限性：策略为确定性程序而非语言模型智能体，干预为动作替换而非重采样，对随机智能体的外部有效性待验证；基础设施仅通过损坏可见性而非直接转移资金施加影响。

title: VideoX-Qwen: Data-Centric Instruction-Based Video Editing
summary: Progress in general-purpose video editing depends on constructing large-scale paired supervision and effectively adapting video-generation backbones to instruction-driven editing. Unlike video generation, video editing must execute a requested transformation while preserving unrelated subjects, scene structure, motion, and temporal continuity. We present VideoX-Qwen, an integrated data-construction and model-training framework for general instruction-based video editing. Our scalable production pipeline organizes specialized generation and understanding models into complementary routes for addition, removal, replacement, and attribute editing, followed by quality screening and instruction enrichment. It produces more than 1.2 million directional video-editing records, including over 400,000 records in each major task group, with an automatic acceptance rate of 89%. The resulting corpus provides broad and structured coverage of common editing operations through a unified source-instruction-target interface. We further develop a unified Qwen-Wan editor that combines multimodal semantic conditioning with dense source-video latent guidance. A progressive image-video training strategy aligns the multimodal instruction interface, adapts the video generator to source-conditioned editing, and refines output quality with selected high-resolution data. In a 100-example comparison with UniVideo and Kling O1, VideoX-Qwen achieves the best mean result on nine of eleven reported metrics, including instruction following, editing quality, content preservation, structural and perceptual similarity, and video-distribution quality. Together, the large-scale data-production system and unified training framework provide a practical foundation for more capable instruction-driven video editing.

AI.tldr: VideoX-Qwen提出了一套数据构建与模型训练一体化框架，用于通用指令驱动视频编辑。通过任务路由式合成流水线（结合Qwen3-VL、SAM3、Minimax-Remover、Qwen-Image-Edit、Wan-Animate等专家模型）构建了120万+有方向性的(源视频,指令,目标视频)三元组数据，自动接受率89%。统一Qwen-Wan编辑器采用双条件架构（多模态语义查询+密集源视频潜变量通道拼接），配合三阶段渐进式图像-视频训练（语义对齐→联合适配→高质量精修）。在100例与UniVideo和Kling O1对比中，11项指标中9项取得最优均值。
AI.motivation: 通用指令驱动视频编辑面临两大瓶颈：(1) 监督数据稀缺——普通视频-文本数据缺乏前后配对关系，独立生成的视频在姿态、构图、时序上难以对齐；(2) 模型适配困难——预训练视频生成器缺乏对源视频、指令、保留内容和定向修改的联合理解能力。需要构建大规模配对编辑语料并设计能融合多模态指令理解与密集源视频结构保持的统一编辑架构。
AI.method: 数据端：任务路由式流水线。Qwen3-VL-235B进行源视频筛选与目标解析；加/删任务经SAM3生成掩码+Minimax-Remover合成对象缺失视频，形成双向复用记录；替换/属性编辑任务由Qwen-Image-Edit编辑首帧+Wan-Animate时序传播；统一经Qwen3-VL质量筛选与指令多样化增强。模型端：双条件架构——稀疏路径采用Qwen MLLM（LoRA适配）+可学习查询+连接器产出语义token，密集路径将完整源视频VAE潜变量与噪声目标潜变量沿通道拼接后输入Wan DiT。三阶段渐进训练：Stage1（DiT冻结，仅训练查询/LoRA/连接器，21K步）→Stage2（启用源潜变量路径，联合训练DiT，27K步）→Stage3（30K精选高分辨率视频精修500步）。推理仅需源视频与指令，配合无分类器引导的流匹配采样。
AI.result: 在100例与UniVideo、Kling O1的对比中，VideoX-Qwen在指令遵循（7.70 vs 7.61/6.91）、编辑质量（7.86）、内容保持（7.70）、背景一致性（0.9535）、SSIM（0.7658，提升33.81%）、LPIPS（0.1966，降低18.05%）、VFID-ResNeXt（0.9253）、VFID-I3D（25.96）、Kiwi-Edit Score（3.960）共9项指标上取得最优均值；Kling O1在美学质量与成像质量两项领先。消融与定性示例（主体替换、颜色编辑、多区域复合指令等）验证了大规模结构化监督与多模态源条件训练的协同效益。
AI.conclusion: VideoX-Qwen将专家视觉模型的碎片化能力转化为可复用的监督资源，并通过统一的源-指令-目标接口与Qwen-Wan双条件编辑器吸收多样化编辑任务。120万条有方向性编辑记录与渐进式训练共同支撑了指令执行能力与源内容保真度的同步提升。系统具有可扩展性——更强的专家模型可扩充监督，更广泛的编辑任务可通过统一接口被同一编辑器吸收，为指令驱动视频编辑提供了兼具数据规模化与模型通用化的实用基础。

title: CQ4OE: A benchmark for assessing LLM-assisted ontology generation from competency questions
summary: Ontology generation from Competency Questions (CQs) is a central yet labor-intensive phase of Ontology Engineering. While large language models (LLMs) offer promising automation capabilities, current evaluations remain fragmented. Task formulations are heterogeneous, gold standards often lack fine-grained CQ provenance, metrics conflate lexical overlap with structural and logical adequacy, and reference ontologies are not always explicitly designed around the evaluation CQs. Here, we address these limitations with CQ4OE, a benchmark for the systematic and reproducible evaluation of LLM-based ontology generation from CQs. For each ontology in the benchmark, we build a CQ-driven gold OWL ontology with explicit provenance linking each CQ to the classes, properties, and axioms required to answer it. From this resource, we define two complementary evaluation tasks. CQ2Term supports term-level evaluation of CQ-specific class and property prediction over 99 CQs, and CQ2Onto supports ontology-level evaluation over 118 CQs, including hierarchy, property modeling, and axiom-level structure. We demonstrate CQ4OE with experiments using nine LLMs under zero-shot, iterative, and multi-agent generation strategies, showing that LLMs recover explicit vocabulary terms more reliably than creating ontologies, particularly in property modeling, hierarchy construction, and axiom generation.

AI.tldr: CQ4OE是一个用于系统评估基于LLM的能力问题（CQ）驱动的本体生成的基准，包含CQ2Term（术语级，99个CQ）和CQ2Onto（本体级，118个CQ）两个互补任务，覆盖6个不同规模和复杂度的本体，并通过三审裁决标注协议建立CQ到术语及公理的细粒度溯源。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM本体生成评估存在三大问题：任务定义异构、参考本体与CQ缺乏细粒度溯源、度量指标混淆词法重叠与结构/逻辑充分性，导致无法在统一的需求驱动评估协议下公平比较不同方法。
AI.method: 四阶段标注工作流：(1)核心术语选取；(2)CQ过滤与术语标注（显式E、隐式I、派生R三层）；(3)CQ增广；(4)黄金标准构建。三审裁决标注协议保证溯源质量。评估方法采用五相似度聚合对齐（硬匹配+Levenshtein+Jaro-Winkler+序列匹配+语义嵌入），并通过属性对齐、双视图（全局G vs 对齐条件AC）、公理级匹配及HermiT推理闭包恢复进行多维度量化。
AI.result: 使用9个LLM在零样本、迭代、多智能体三种策略下进行实验。CQ2Term全局F1为59.1%-66.5%，类恢复优于属性（67.1% vs 55.2%）；CQ2Onto结构F1仅26.7%-33.7%，闭包F1仅16.7%，显示模型识别实体能力强但组装全局正确结构能力弱；三种策略结构F1差异仅3个百分点，但多智能体策略通过OOPS!和HermiT修复将CQ级公理覆盖从18.3%提升至24.2%；性能差异主要由领域而非模型或策略驱动。
AI.conclusion: CQ4OE通过显式的CQ到术语及公理溯源实现了透明的需求驱动评估，揭示了LLM在生成本体时三大典型缺陷：SubClassOf/SubPropertyOf链不足、属性建模不稳定、CQ完整性低（Axiom-Full仅约2%）。未来工作将扩展领域、引入私有或后截止日期本体以控制数据污染。

title: Canonical locks that encode part-whole hierarchies
summary: One of the challenges in representational learning is how to encode part-whole hierarchies in a neural net. Prior works rely on flattening tree-like structures into string-like sequences and training a sequence-to-sequence model via autoregression. While such a representation works for parse-trees in NLP, it is not entirely clear how to make it work for images. Thus, we propose a geometric primitive called canonical locks. The key idea is that parts/wholes can be modelled as higher-dimensional vectors ($d \geq 4$), and information can be encoded in their relative phase differences. Inductively, the net consists of positionally-bound bottom-up and top-down neural fields, which drive each other to achieve a state of thermal equilibrium. Additionally, we show the existence of a few symmetrical configurations in the net. The computational iterations taken to break these symmetries depend on the angle between parts/wholes arranged on a disk (or more precisely a ring) in higher dimensions. It also appears to have connections to the psychological phenomenon of mental rotation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"规范锁"（canonical locks）作为编码部分-整体层次结构的几何原语，通过高维向量间的相对相位差来表示部分与整体关系，并设计了异步感知机（APM/s）来实现这一机制，能在仅一个训练样本上学习并泛化到未见过的图像。
AI.motivation: 现有的表征学习方法在编码部分-整体层级结构时存在根本性挑战：将树形结构展平为序列并训练seq2seq模型的方式在图像任务中难以奏效。Geoffrey Hinton提出的GLOM架构虽具理论意义，但实现一直难以突破。同时第一代异步感知机（APM）存在表征坍缩、训练耗时、依赖预训练教师网络等多重缺陷，亟需一种新的几何原语来实现真正的部分-整体层次编码。
AI.method: 方法核心包含三大部分：(1) **规范锁几何原语**：将部分/整体建模为d≥4维高维空间中的向量，在超球面/圆盘上以"指南针指针"形式振荡，通过相对相位差编码关系，归纳地形成热平衡。(2) **打破对称性的动力学**：识别三种基本对称性（反对称、折叠对称、三重对称），证明任何随机配置都会振荡收敛于这三种基本模式。(3) **异步感知机（APM/s）架构**：包含编码器W_e、自底向上网W_f、自顶向下网W_b三类权重；采用内外双循环优化（内循环执行"一致性程序"，外循环使用任务标签更新参数）；引入"啜饮更新"（slurp update）在测地线上逐步移动向量；提出"深度权重对齐"约束W_f·W_b=I。视觉语义解析方面，使用CelebA-HQ数据集定义5层人脸层级（L1-L5）。
AI.result: 关键结果包括：(1) 在对称性打破实验中，反对称情形需30次迭代收敛，折叠对称需60次迭代，且通过线性模型可预测不同配置所需的迭代次数；(2) 通过三维"三折叠对称"发现了120°的隐藏对称模式；(3) 提出高维球面随机向量近正交性定理，证明d维空间向量内积以O_P(1/√d)衰减；(4) APM/s可在仅一个训练样本（无任何预训练）下学习并泛化到测试集，L1精度0.919至L5精度0.982；(6) 该对极限泛化能力可处理未见图像的90°倍数旋转；(7) 成功解码人脸图像的5层部分-整体层次路径，无需后处理聚类或匹配分配。
AI.conclusion: 规范锁为学习机器编码部分-整体层次结构提供了有效的几何原语。异步感知机第二代的进步证明，通过几何约束可以结合规模化训练的优势与快速搜索的优势。论文建立了用向量空间语言思考部分、整体及其组合分解的术语框架，为后续工作奠定基础。理论上有望扩展到90°倍数旋转的泛化、元学习架构及学习算法等。总体而言，该工作推动了GLOM哲学思想向工程现实的转化，为神经表征学习中的几何学派提供了新的实现路径。

title: FIRE: Failure-Informed Runtime Engineering for Reliable Language-Model Agents
summary: Language-model agents often reach a working solution and then fail to consistently deliver it. We study runtime policies: targeted natural-language instructions and action denials applied by the agent harness at states that preceded observed failures, without changing model weights or the user prompt. With this, keeping capability constant, we observe a meaningful unlock in delivered reliability. Across the complete 87-task Terminal-Bench 2.1 suite, with two attempts per task, policies increase repeated success (pass^2) in all three GPT-5.6 tiers: 50.6% to 54.0% for Luna, 55.2% to 60.9% for Terra, and 64.4% to 73.6% for Sol. Sol's best-of-two success changes by 1.2 points while repeated success rises by 9.2, showing that policies chiefly convert reachable solutions into dependable delivery. We further cover 14 tasks under Terra's frozen portfolio. Policy-guided Terra reaches 71.4%, compared with 64.3% for unassisted Sol, at about half the cost, demonstrating how engineering around models could unlock dependability for a use case. To isolate the mechanism we run a randomized five-arm experiment: real policies reach 61% on eligible tasks, versus 39% without a policy, 36% with a timing-matched sham, and 39 to 43% with generic verification or reconsideration. The intended corrective behavior appears in 22 of 24 coded policy attempts, against at most 14 in any other arm. Runtime policies are therefore a practical reliability layer: they make capabilities an agent already possesses substantially more repeatable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FIRE（Failure-Informed Runtime Engineering），一种在智能体执行环境中部署"运行时策略"的方法，通过有针对性的自然语言指令和动作拒绝来提升语言模型智能体的可靠性，而不改变模型权重或用户提示。在Terminal-Bench 2.1完整87任务套件上，三个GPT-5.6层级在两次尝试的重复成功率（pass^2）均获得提升，最显著的是Sol层级从64.4%提升到73.6%，而pass@2几乎不变，表明策略主要将"可达解"转化为"可靠交付"。通过随机化五臂实验（真实策略、定时匹配的sham、always-verify、reconsider、baseline）验证了提升来源于策略内容本身而非单纯的打断效应。
AI.motivation: 语言模型智能体常常能够找到解决方案，却在交付环节反复失败（如服务进程随shell退出、打开数据库前未备份证据、格式化程序破坏受保护字节等"程序性损失"）。现有缓解方法（自反思、测试时计算、通用runtime enforcement）无法将"策略内容的效果"与"单纯打断决策点"的效果区分开。作者认为智能体可靠性是一个系统属性（systems property），而非仅模型属性，通过轻量级的harness层可在不重训模型的情况下恢复性能。
AI.method:
核心方法是将"运行时策略"定义为元组P=(E, G, A, R, S)，其中E是任务描述上的资格谓词，G是观察智能体动作历史的运行时谓词，A是指令（instruct）或拒绝（deny）干预，R为释放条件。策略从观察到的失败中通过聚类机制提取，对应状态→干预→行为→验证条件链。Terra冻结组合包含8家族11条规则（含服务持久化、部署保护、数据库证据、精确替换、LaTeX日志、二进制等值、token核算、枚举）。

评估采用四种设计：①五臂随机化面板（14 eligible + 16 silent任务，共300次尝试），含真实策略、定时匹配sham、always-verify、reconsider与baseline；②匹配屏幕（服务持久化策略在Sol、Luna各7任务）；③完整87任务套件（1044次尝试）；④14任务聚焦对比。统计推断采用10,000次任务级bootstrap和10万次sign-flip置换检验，任务为推断单元。
AI.result: 完整套件上pass^2在三个层级均提升：Luna 50.6%→54.0%、Terra 55.2%→60.9%、Sol 64.4%→73.6%；Sol的pass@2仅增1.2点而pass^2增9.2点，表明策略主要将间歇性成功转化为稳定交付。五臂面板显示真实策略在eligible任务上达到60.7%，显著优于baseline 39.3%（+21.4, p=0.032）和sham 35.7%（+25.0, p=0.061），always-verify和reconsider无增益。漏斗分析显示所有arm同样频繁地进入"风险状态"（24-26/28），但仅真实策略可靠产生"修正行为"（22/24编码尝试 vs 其他arm最多14/24）。在Terra的14个覆盖任务上，带策略的Terra达到71.4%，超过未辅助Sol的64.3%，成本约为后者一半（$7.19 vs $14.48）。
AI.conclusion: 运行时策略是一种实用的可靠性层，能够将模型已具备的能力转化为更可重复的交付，而不需要重训模型。模型权重决定哪些解可达，harness决定这些解能否在重复执行中存活。模型升级与运行时策略解决不同失效来源——前者扩展可达解空间，后者防止已知程序性失败丢弃已可达解。该工作将智能体可靠性从纯模型属性重新定位为系统属性，为以更低成本恢复更昂贵模型层级的性能提供了工程化路径。主要局限：仅一个benchmark、一个harness、一个模型族；面板任务来自开发集；行为编码仅覆盖注册标记而非所有通过验证器的方式；策略编写依赖专家判断。

title: Adversarial Course-of-Action Generation: Game-Theoretic Multi-Agent Algorithms for COA matching & COA generation
comment: 5 pages. DAI 2026 Industry Track submission. Includes public reproducibility artifact link. Uses synthetic offline scenarios only; no classified data, proprietary data, human-subject data, or operational planning systems
summary: Course-of-action (COA) generation is a distributed planning problem: a system must propose structured candidate actions, evaluate them against an adversarial response, and surface options that remain tactically coherent under changing conditions. We present COA-Bench, a small offline benchmark and reproducibility artifact for comparing COA generation policies through self-play. Following the BattleCOA terminology, we reserve COA matching for asset-effect matching and COA generation for course-of-action generation; the present artifact does not implement either DecisionFunction directly. Instead, it represents COAs as typed action chains with conditional branches, assigns a synthetic COA quality score, compares opposing COAs with a BLUE-vs-RED advantage score and Nash-gap distance, and scores doctrinal coherence with an FM 3-0-inspired heuristic rubric. Across 50 synthetic scenarios spanning five operational templates, a sampled best-response policy that draws eight RED candidates reduces BLUE advantage from .516 to .485 and BLUE wargame win rate from .920 to .820; a two-stage multi-agent council with five BLUE proposer agents, RED-team adjudication, and critique-driven revision obtains .509 BLUE advantage and .820 BLUE win rate. We also identify and fix a benchmark-design issue in which scenario framing was stored as metadata but had no effect on generated COA content. COA-Bench is not an operational battle-management system and uses no real, classified, proprietary, or human-subject data. The contribution is an inspectable evaluation harness, preliminary benchmark evidence, and lessons for building auditable agentic planning artifacts.

AI.tldr: COA-Bench 是一个离线、可复现的小型基准测试框架，用于在自博弈（self-play）设置下评估对抗性行动方案（Course-of-Action, COA）生成策略。它将 COA 表示为带条件分支的类型化动作链，通过合成质量分、BLUE-vs-RED 优势分、Nash 间隙和 FM 3-0 启发的条令启发式等指标，比较不同 RED 响应策略和一种两阶段多智能体委员会对 BLUE COA 评估结果的影响。
AI.motivation: COA 生成是一种分布式规划问题，其质量并非计划的孤立属性，而是取决于兵力组合、敌方响应、时机、资源约束及联合作战平衡、持续性、风险缓解、节奏等定性规划标准。在单响应评估下表现良好的 BLUE 策略，可能在对手采样多种合理响应时表现大幅下降。然而当前缺乏一个可复现、显式区分决策函数与评估指标、并能暴露评估设计缺陷的小型基准测试框架。
AI.method: 1. **COA 表示**：将 COA 建模为类型化对象（含目标、兵力分配、领域标签、有序/链式动作、可选条件分支、可选工具调用）；动作为类别、目标、优先级及元数据。合成质量分 q ∈ [-1,1] = w_e e - w_c c - w_r r（默认权重 .5/.3/.2）。2. **配对评估**：BLUE-vs-RED 优势分 = (q_blue - q_red + 2)/4；并报告 rescale 至 [0,1] 后的 Nash 间隙作为不均衡诊断。3. **条令与兵棋诊断**：条令启发式评分目标清晰度、情报准备、联合作战平衡、持续性、风险缓解与节奏；风格化 Lanchester 兵棋检查按合成质量与条令对齐缩放原始战斗力。4. **对抗协议**：固定 BLUE 种子 COA，RED 以三种方式生成响应——单次随机最佳响应（k=1）、采集 n=8 个候选并选最高质量的采样最佳响应、条令感知选择器；外加一种两阶段多智能体委员会（5 个 BLUE proposer + RED 团队对抗 + 批评驱动修订）。5. **评分函数**：S(b_i) = αQ + βD + γV - ρP（权重 .45/.25/.10/.20），选 b⋆ = argmax_{B⁰∪B¹} S(b)，报告鲁棒性裕度 M 与压力消减 ΔP。6. **场景集**：50 个合成场景，10 个种子，5 个作战模板（城市稳定行动、海上拦截、多域战斗、防空压制、人道主义撤离）。
AI.result: 1. 在 50 个场景上，采样最佳响应（k=8）使 BLUE 优势从 .516 降至 .485，BLUE 兵棋胜率从 .920 降至 .820；条令感知选择器产生类似对抗效应（.488 优势、.800 胜率）。2. 响应预算从 k=1 增至 k=16 时，BLUE 优势单调下降：.516→.498→.490→.485→.479。3. 候选集平均多样性 .682，质量分展幅 .246，Pareto 最优候选平均 2.16/8；条令感知选择器在 56% 场景中更换所选响应，质量遗憾 .041 但条令对齐增益 .106。4. 两阶段多智能体委员会取得 .509 BLUE 优势、.820 BLUE 胜率、修订候选被选率 76%、修订多样性 .644 高于初始 .571、鲁棒性裕度 .014、共识间隙 .012，攻击压力消减 .645 vs .615。5. 发现并修复一个基准设计缺陷：场景框架参数原本作为元数据存储但对生成内容无效（静默 no-op），修复后框架敏感性 delta 为 .066 [.049, .086]。
AI.conclusion: COA-Bench 提供了一个小型、可检视的离线基准，用于在对抗自博弈下评估 COA 生成策略。它表明：（1）采样最佳响应会产生更强的合成对手；（2）候选集合具有有意义的多样性；（3）透明工件可暴露基准设计失败（如 no-op 场景框架）。主要贡献是：（1）将资产-效果匹配、COA 生成与最佳响应评估形式化为对抗 COA 生成设置，且不混淆决策函数与基准指标；（2）提供带类型化 COA 轨迹、BLUE/RED 策略比较和条令启发的可复现离线测试平台；（3）实证证据证明采样响应会改变胜率与计划质量结论。该工件不是作战兵棋管理系统，不使用真实、机密、专有或人类受试者数据；其实际价值不在任何当前策略的绝对分数，而在于能够检视策略为何表现强——生成的候选、多样性、条令饱和项及场景变量是否真正影响内容。该基准是面向更强 BattleCOA 导向基准的初步但有用基础。

title: ChainUQ: Reasoning Consistency-Aware Uncertainty Quantification for Large Language Models
summary: While large language models (LLMs) exhibit impressive reasoning capabilities, response-level confidence may remain unreliable when intermediate claims conflict with the final conclusion. Therefore, effective uncertainty quantification (UQ) is required to capture logical inconsistencies within the reasoning chain, not just the correctness of the final output. Current approaches have two major limitations: (1) their reliance on token-level probabilities fails to capture reasoning consistency, and (2) they lack mechanisms to dynamically calibrate confidence using the structural logic of the generated chain. To advance existing research, we introduce ChainUQ, a reasoning consistency-aware uncertainty quantification framework for LLMs. ChainUQ consists of two key technical components: an alignment-aware lightweight UQ module that estimates a raw intrinsic model confidence score from frozen features aligned to the final conclusion, and a reasoning consistency-aware calibrator that refines this score using reasoning-chain consistency evidence. Evaluations across diverse in-distribution and out-of-distribution benchmarks show that ChainUQ consistently improves response-level uncertainty estimation, achieving an average 3.1% relative gain in AUROC and up to 45.0% relative reduction in ECE, and can be directly transferred to new settings without additional fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: ChainUQ提出了一种面向大语言模型（LLM）响应级不确定性量化（UQ）框架，通过将推理链一致性信号整合到置信度校准中，解决了现有方法无法捕捉中间推理步骤与最终结论之间逻辑冲突的局限性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM不确定性量化方法存在两大不足：（1）依赖token级概率，无法捕捉推理一致性；（2）缺乏利用推理链结构逻辑动态校准置信度的机制。当LLM生成的推理链表面流畅但中间步骤与最终结论冲突时，仅基于最终答案或token概率的UQ方法会产生不可靠的响应级置信度。
AI.method: ChainUQ框架包含两个核心技术组件：（1）**对齐感知的轻量化UQ模块**：从冻结LLM的隐藏状态中提取与最终结论对齐的特征，通过token状态投影、响应级上下文聚合、结论感知状态编码、可靠性感知结论表示等步骤，估计原始内在模型置信度s；（2）**推理一致性感知校准器**：构造融合推理链一致性证据u(r)的特征向量（包括基础置信度线索、推理摘要、token不确定性、结构/特征间隔统计、推理步骤判断结果），采用R-Log（推理条件Logistic校准）方法，通过分位数分箱学习局部混合权重，结合锚定分数与推理条件分数进行校准。整个流程为后处理式单次推理，无需重复采样或微调骨干网络。
AI.result: 在HotpotQA（ID）、MuSiQue、StrategyQA、bAbI（OOD）四个数据集上，基于Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct等骨干模型，ChainUQ相比基线（包括SAPLMA、Factoscope、Lookback Lens、UHead等监督方法和MCP、Perplexity等无监督方法）取得最佳判别能力，平均AUROC相对提升3.1%。校准方面，R-Log在ECE上最高实现45.0%的相对降低。OOD迁移实验中（阈值与校准器参数在验证集上确定后直接迁移到测试集），随着OOD难度增加，R-Log相对ISO的排序增益呈正相关增长（Pearson r=0.707）。消融实验验证了学习库、条件选择、上下文融合、最终残差细化器各组件的互补贡献。跨骨干模型（Mistral-7B、Gemma-2-9B、Phi-14B）实验表明方法具有普适性。推理效率方面，ChainUQ头部计算成本与UHead相当，R-Log校准器远快于BWH且保持推理感知校准能力。
AI.conclusion: ChainUQ通过将响应级不确定性量化扩展为"内在模型置信度 + 推理链一致性证据校准"的两阶段框架，有效识别表面流畅但推理链逻辑不一致的不可靠响应，在不增加辅助头参数量或重复生成的前提下提升了LLM的UQ判别与校准性能，并具有良好的OOD迁移能力。

title: RankCert: When Can Simulated Learners Safely Select an AI Tutor? Robust Decision Certification Under Structural Uncertainty
comment: 19 pages, 5 figures, 7 tables. Submitted to ACM Transactions on Intelligent Systems and Technology (TIST)
summary: Simulation-based tutor selection can be unstable when predictively adequate learner models imply different policy rankings. RankCert certifies one of eight equal-budget tutoring policies only when model-averaged utility, probability-best, posterior regret, cross-domain rank, family coverage, and leave-one-domain-out and leave-one-visible-family-out averages support the same candidate; otherwise it abstains. We evaluated RankCert in 1,280 frozen held-out settings spanning five rotating held-out oracle families, 64 scenarios per family, and four cohort sizes. Calibration used a licensed, de-identified EdNet-KT1 derivative with 5,000 learners and 590,056 retained responses; all five family representatives passed the frozen adequacy gate. Minimum-domain mean pairwise top-1 agreement was 0.272917 (95% CI [0.253646, 0.293229]), showing substantial structural disagreement. Cohort-noise variance decreased from n = 30 to n = 300, while the structural family share remained nonzero. RankCert reduced total held-out decision loss relative to full-coverage point selection by 0.006605 normalized-outcome units (95% CI [0.004859, 0.008407]). At comparable coverage, however, it did not reduce selective risk relative to a confidence-gated point certificate (difference -0.000213; 95% CI [-0.003238, 0.002384]; Holm p = 0.929654). Certification occurred in 3.75% of settings and only in stable scenarios; RankCert abstained in every ambiguous, misspecified, and structural-conflict setting. "Safe" denotes only benchmark-scoped decision certification under the declared utility and uncertainty set; no human-learning, causal, deployment-effectiveness, or general-safety claim is made.

AI.tldr: RankCert是一种在结构性不确定性下选择AI辅导策略的弃权式决策认证程序。它仅在多个证据门控同时支持时才认证八个等预算策略之一，否则弃权。在1280个冻结留出场景中验证了其能降低总体决策损失，但未降低条件选择性风险。
AI.motivation: 模拟学习者的辅导策略选择存在不稳定性：预测性能充分的模型可能蕴含不同的策略排名，将未解决的模型不确定性转化为不合理的确定决策。论文旨在回答"何时有足够证据从等预算替代方案中选择一个AI辅导策略"。
AI.method: 形式化决策目标：在声明的效用与预测充分不确定性集下，只有同时满足七项条件才认证候选策略：模型平均效用最大化、概率最佳≥0.50、后验95%分位遗憾≤0.05、至少3/4域排名第一、结构覆盖≥3个充分族、留一域平均存活、留一族平均存活。在1280个留出场景（5族×64情景×4队列规模，跨稳定/模糊/结构冲突/误设四层）中进行确认性评估，使用EdNet-KT1校准五个学习者模拟族（BKT转移、PFA练习、动态IRT、注意力历史、因果阈值）。
AI.result: H1-H4经Holm校正后支持：最小域平均成对Top-1一致率为0.273（结构分歧显著）；队列噪声方差随n增大而下降但结构性族方差仍非零；RankCert比全覆盖点选择器降低决策损失0.0066标准化单位；响应NLL秩与导师排名一致性的Kendall τb仅0.142。H5未支持：在可比覆盖率下，RankCert与置信门控点证书的选择性风险差异不显著（-0.000213，95% CI包含零，Holm p=0.93）。RankCert总覆盖率仅3.75%，仅在稳定场景且n≥120时认证。
AI.conclusion: RankCert在冻结基准范围内降低了相对全覆盖点选择的总体决策损失，但未比置信门控点证书降低条件遗憾。"安全"仅指基准范围内的决策认证，不构成人类学习、因果效应、部署有效性或通用安全性的主张。频繁弃权标志着基准证据的边界而非辅导效果的判断。

title: Selection-Invariant Communication Compilers for Privacy-Aware Multi-Agent LLM Workflows
summary: Structured multi-agent workflows exchange intermediate messages whose content and form can reveal private state even when the final output is safe. We identify selection-channel leakage: after authorization fixes what may be released, a private-state-aware choice among semantically valid realizations creates an additional inference channel. We introduce the selection-invariant communication compiler(SICC), which constrains this post-authorization representation kernel rather than prescribing templates. Any deterministic or independently public-randomized generator satisfying the invariant is valid; requirement-indexed canonical forms are one auditable implementation. We prove a compositional communication-layer guarantee: authorization, public-only form generation, and a dependency-safe utility gate make the emitted transcript reveal no information beyond the complete authorized view. Private-state-aware selection remains vulnerable after surface-disjoint and length-matched controls. Across 132 AgentLeak communication replays and 100 executable LangGraph tasks, deterministic SICC retains complete protocol utility without a positive excess-gain signal; independent public randomization preserves the same result in AgentLeak and 480 controlled cases.

AI.tldr: 提出选择通道泄漏（selection-channel leakage）问题——多智能体LLM工作流中，即使授权后消息内容安全，发送方在合法表达形式间的私有状态依赖选择仍会泄露隐私。设计选择不变通信编译器（SICC），通过约束授权后的表示生成分布而非规定模板，确保已发射消息不泄露超出授权视图的额外信息。
AI.motivation: 多智能体系统中，中间消息的形式选择可能成为私有状态的侧通道。即使每条候选消息本身是安全的，发送方基于私有状态在多种合法形式间的选择仍会泄露信息（如签证依赖案例中，有时发回执，有时发粗略理由）。现有防御（提示、编辑、IFC）均未约束授权后的表示策略。
AI.method: 1. 形式化选择通道泄漏为 I(S;M|O_pub) 优化问题；2. 定义选择不变性：F(M)⊥S|O_pub,A_pub，即消息形式分布仅依赖于认证公共输入和授权策略；3. 提出SICC编译器流水线：认证需求→检索授权策略→投影授权值→固定需求索引规范形式→依赖检查→效用验证；4. 定理1证明组合保证：授权、公共随机形式生成、依赖安全效用门组合下 I(S;Z|O_pub,X_auth,A_pub)=0；5. 部署时无需标签或攻击者模型，仅OLRS作为非部署诊断。
AI.result: 在132个AgentLeak通信回放、480个受控案例、100个LangGraph执行任务中，确定性SICC保持完整协议效用且无正向超额增益信号（ExcessGain≈0）；独立公共随机化SICC在所有基准上保持相同结果。OLRS诊断显示在掩码和长度匹配后FormGain仍达0.207；红线和操作事实保留ExcessGain=0.738；SICC将攻击成功率从0.77降至0.04。
AI.conclusion: SICC将授权后通信形式约束为不依赖私有状态的形成策略，模板仅是众多可审计实现之一。定理保证仅是相对授权视图的：合规消息不添加超出X_auth的额外信息，但授权视图本身可能已含隐私。选择不变性是授权后通信层原则，而非端到端保密声明。

title: The Architect, the Adversary, and the Judge: Closed-Loop Generation of Standards-Aligned Assessment Items at Scale
comment: 31 pages, 8 figures, 16 tables. Companion paper: arXiv:2608.01000
summary: We present CLAIM, a production pipeline for K-12 assessment-item generation coupling a two-stage generate-then-attack protocol (the model drafts as a "curriculum architect", then re-enters the same conversation as a hostile adversarial reviewer), bi-directional few-shot conditioning on accepted and rejected items, the latter carrying the evaluator's diagnosis, and a knowledge dictionary of 44,844 error-correction rules mined from that feedback and retrieved per standard and item type. Across 43,227 scored items over 755 Common Core ELA standards, three item types, and ten LLMs, the pipeline reaches a 97.8% expert-evaluator pass rate on a 9,074-item production run. We then ask what that rate certifies. Re-scoring a stratified sample with three judges from other vendors, blind to the deployed verdict, reproduces the format ordering under every judge and recovers a larger open-set deficit than the deployed evaluator does; but agreement on the accept/reject binary is weak at production prevalence (kappa about 0.13), and the judges agree with each other no better. The level is therefore judge-relative, and with no student-response data our quality evidence is evaluator-judged throughout. The corpus also exposes a robust asymmetry. Multiple-choice and multiple-select generation saturate at 98% or above for both frontier models under a dozen static rules, whereas fill-in-the-blank generation is capability-tiered (82.8-96.7% across five models under a matched rule set, standards, and judge) and plateaus under prompt-only optimization, with error mass shifting between answer-key over-inclusion and omission as rules accumulate. We analyze this as open-set boundary determination, a task autoregressive decoders are structurally ill-equipped to solve, and show the asymmetry recurring when the evaluator itself is distilled: fail-recall rises from 8% to 63% while F1 saturates at 0.25.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CLAIM流水线（生成-攻击闭环、双向少样本条件、从评估反馈挖掘44844条规则的字典），为K-12 CCSS英语语言艺术标准规模化生成评估题；在9074题上达到97.8%的通过率，并揭示选择题与填空题之间存在结构性能力鸿沟——后者在多家独立评判者手下暴露更严重的开放集边界判定缺陷，将误差质量沿精确率-召回率边界推移而非真正消除。
AI.motivation: 可扩展的K-12题目生成受制于部署性（多项限制同时满足）和质量需外部判定（答案键完整且排他），需要通过闭环反馈将LLM生成器与结构化专家评估器紧密耦合；同时需要厘清通过率究竟度量了什么——是否仅为通过某个评判关口的吞吐量，而非真正的缺陷率。
AI.method: 两阶段对抗自审协议（"首席课程架构师"四阶段起草 → 同一对话中切换为"敌对审查者"，执行五项定向攻击）；通过双向少样本（已接受与已拒绝范例，拒绝范例附评估诊断）和从评估反馈挖掘的44844条知识规则字典，按（标准ID, 题型）检索并注入提示；MCQ/MSQ使用约12条静态规则即饱和，cloze则经历四轮规则累积从15条增长到42条。
AI.result: 在9074道覆盖755个CCSS ELA标准（1-12年级）、三种题型、三种难度的生产运行中，使用Claude Opus 4.6达到97.8%通过率，所有36个年级×题型单元落入95.3-99.6%的4.3个百分点区间；但跨十款LLM的测试揭示出闭合集（MCQ/MSQ≥98%）与开放集（cloze 82.8-96.7%按能力分层）格式之间的稳健不对称——三家独立评判者重现了格式排序，但接受/拒绝二元一致性较弱（k≈0.13），且规则增加只会将误差质量在答案键过纳与遗漏之间来回推移；评估器蒸馏实验同样复现了该不对称（F1饱和于0.25，失败召回率8%→63%）。
AI.conclusion: CLAIM流水线使规模化CCSS对齐题目生成通过率提升至97.8%，但这是"通过单个门槛"的吞吐量度量而非已测缺陷率，因为独立评判者难以就接受/拒绝达成一致；同一语料表明范式的边界：开放式答案键构造是开放集边界判定任务，自回归解码器结构性不适合，提示优化在精确率-召回率前沿上滑动而非超越前沿，应将cloze生成分类作为约束条件下鉴别能力的常驻压力探针。

title: FusionMMT: A Unified Multimodal and Multitask Learning Framework for Nuclear Fusion
summary: With the growing global demand for energy, nuclear fusion has emerged as a promising direction for future clean energy. Tokamaks represent one of the leading approaches to magnetic-confinement fusion. Achieving high-performance, long-pulse, and steady-state operation requires effective diagnosis of plasma states. However, existing intelligent diagnostic methods are largely limited to either multimodal single-task or unimodal multitask learning, while a unified multimodal multitask learning framework remains underexplored. To address this gap, we construct EAST-VTD640, a multimodal multitask dataset that integrates vision and time-series diagnostics from 640 EAST shots for disruption prediction, edge-localized mode (ELM) recognition, and H98 regression. On this basis, we present FusionMMT, the first unified multimodal multitask framework for intelligent tokamak plasma diagnostics. FusionMMT employs multi-scale, time-aware, and variable-aware modeling to handle heterogeneous sampling rates and the high computational cost of high-frequency sequences. It further combines task-adaptive multimodal fusion with progressive multitask optimization to learn shared and task-specific representations while mitigating cross-task conflicts and optimization imbalance. Extensive experiments on EAST-VTD640 show that FusionMMT outperforms representative multimodal multitask methods across disruption prediction, ELM recognition, and H98 regression. The source code will be released on this https URL

AI.tldr: 本文提出FusionMMT，首个面向托卡马克等离子体诊断的统一多模态多任务学习框架，并构建了EAST-VTD640数据集。框架结合多尺度、时序感知和变量感知编码处理异构诊断信号，通过任务自适应多模态融合与三阶段渐进式多任务优化缓解任务冲突。
AI.motivation: 随着聚变研究向高性能、长脉冲方向发展，托卡马克等离子体状态的精确诊断至关重要。现有AI诊断方法局限于多模态单任务或单模态多任务学习，缺乏统一的多模态多任务框架，无法充分利用异构诊断信号的互补信息。
AI.method: 1) 构建EAST-VTD640数据集（640发EAST炮，可见光图像+多通道时序诊断信号）；2) 多尺度编码器压缩高频信号；3) 时序嵌入器和变量嵌入器处理异构采样；4) TaskAdapt+Task Branch实现任务自适应多模态融合；5) 三阶段渐进式多任务优化（等权联合→不确定性加权→任务特定精修）。
AI.result: 在破坏预测（TPR 95.83%, F1 93.88%）、ELM识别（ACC 90.67%, F1 77.12%）和H98回归（MAE 0.031, R² 90.69%）三个任务上均达到最优，Joint指标87.23%，超越Uni-Hema等基线1.72%。多模态融合较单一模态提升约9.4个百分点。
AI.conclusion: FusionMMT是首个面向托卡马克等离子体诊断的统一多模态多任务框架，EAST-VTD640和FusionMMT为智能托卡马克诊断提供了统一解决方案。消融实验证实了各组件、多模态输入和渐进式训练策略的有效性。

title: Neoadjuvant chemotherapy response prediction using pretreatment diffusion and contrast-enhanced magnetic resonance imaging with clinical variables
summary: Prediction of pathological complete response before neoadjuvant chemotherapy may facilitate more tailored therapeutic planning for breast cancer patients. This work proposes a deep-learning model for pretreatment data only, combining apparent diffusion coefficient maps, dynamic contrast-enhanced magnetic resonance imaging, and clinical variables. The study uses the public ACRIN 6698/I-SPY2 multicenter dataset. The architecture employs EfficientNet-B0 pretrained encoders for image feature extraction and late fusion with clinical information. Multiple clinical variables were evaluated, including age, race, histological type, HR/HER2 subtype, SBR grade, and maximum diameter. Only HR/HER2 subtype improved the average area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) and was retained in the final model. Using stratified five-fold cross-validation, standalone apparent diffusion coefficient maps achieved a mean AUC of 0.79, whereas dynamic contrast-enhanced magnetic resonance imaging achieved 0.74. Adding HR/HER2 subtype improved performance to 0.83 and 0.81, respectively. The final configuration, using both imaging modalities and HR/HER2 subtype, achieved an AUC of 0.86. These results support pretreatment multimodal learning for response prediction, although external validation is required before clinical use.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于治疗前数据（仅T0时刻）的多模态深度学习模型，用于预测乳腺癌患者新辅助化疗（NACT）后的病理完全缓解（pCR）。该模型融合了表观扩散系数（ADC）图、动态对比增强MRI（DCE-MRI）和临床变量HR/HER2亚型，采用EfficientNet-B0预训练编码器与晚期融合策略，在ACRIN 6698/I-SPY2多中心数据集（136例患者）上通过分层五折交叉验证，最终取得AUC=0.86的预测效果。
AI.motivation: NACT并非对所有患者均有效，部分患者承受了毒性却未获益。治疗前（T0）的基线预测比纵向预测更具临床价值（可指导初始治疗强度、筛选适应性治疗患者），但也因缺乏动态变化信息而更具挑战性。已有研究多依赖治疗中或治疗后的影像信息，或依赖复杂的多序列输入与手工特征工程，泛化性受限。因此，作者希望在充分数据基础上，构建一个标准化、紧凑、易于多中心复现的治疗前多模态预测模型。
AI.method: 数据集：使用TCIA公开的ACRIN 6698/I-SPY2多中心数据集，仅筛选T0时刻同时具有ADC、DCE-MRI和临床变量的患者，最终纳入136例（46例pCR，90例非pCR）。预处理：使用2.5D表示方式（肿瘤中心三张连续切片堆叠为3通道），形成3×50×50的肿瘤patch；仅保留肿瘤区域及5像素边缘；DCE-MRI选用第三拍取后对比相。架构：每个模态由ImageNet预训练的EfficientNet-B0编码器独立提取特征，经LayerNorm后拼接，临床变量（HR/HER2亚型）经线性层+ReLU+Dropout+Norm后与影像特征融合，经两层全连接分类器输出pCR/非pCR概率。训练：分层5折交叉验证，AdamW（lr=1e-4，weight decay=1e-4），加权交叉熵，数据增强（翻转、旋转±10°、缩放、亮度对比度），Dropout=0.4，学习率衰减+早停，每折选验证AUC最佳epoch。变量筛选：对年龄、种族、组织学类型、HR/HER2亚型、SBR分级、最大直径等多种临床变量进行经验评估，仅HR/HR2亚型带来稳定的AUC提升，故最终模型仅保留该变量。
AI.result: 交叉验证结果：ADC单独AUC=0.7936±0.0940，DCE-MRI单独AUC=0.7428±0.0943；加入HR/HR2亚型后分别提升至0.8297±0.0721和0.8054±0.0751；最终ADC+DCE-MRI+HR/HR2亚型组合达到最优AUC=0.8567±0.0643，准确率76.67%，F1=0.7641。ADC作为单模态表现优于DCE-MRI，但两者具有互补性，多模态融合进一步提升性能。与其他严格预处理场景下的研究相比（多参数MRI+放射组学AUC=0.86；单中心536例T1减影+T2+临床AUC=0.888；小队列CRBM放射组学AUC=0.87），本研究以更紧凑的输入（无T2、无手工放射组学特征）在多中心公开数据集上达到了具有竞争力的0.86 AUC。
AI.conclusion: 本文验证了基于治疗前ADC、DCE-MRI和HR/HR2亚型的多模态深度学习模型在多中心数据集中预测NACT pCR的可行性，紧凑的输入设计有助于临床实现与跨中心复现。但仍存在若干局限：样本量有限（尤其pCR阳性病例仅46例）；DCE-MRI肿瘤mask由数据集原有标注经概率融合重建而来，非重新手工勾画；缺乏外部验证；DCE-MRI需使用钆对比剂，临床应用需权衡成本与禁忌。未来工作应聚焦于外部队列验证、可解释性分析、预处理优化以及可靠的自动语义分割流程。

title: Early Prediction of Pathological Complete Response to Neoadjuvant Chemotherapy Using Temporal Deep Learning on DWI
summary: Early identification of non-responders to neoadjuvant chemotherapy (NACT) is crucial for timely treatment adaptation in breast cancer. However, many existing predictive models rely on multiparametric magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), late treatment time points, or extensive clinical data, which limits their applicability. This study proposes a deep learning framework for early prediction of pathological complete response (pCR) using only diffusion-weighted MRI (DW-MRI) acquired at baseline and after the first NACT cycle. This framework feeds cropped tumor-centered patches to an EfficientNet-based temporal model that directly learns tumor shape and local tissue characteristics without explicit radiomic feature engineering. The model, trained with 10-fold cross-validation, achieved an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.90 for pCR prediction after one cycle, providing actionable information after a single treatment cycle while avoiding gadolinium administration and reducing dependence on heterogeneous clinical data. By focusing on the baseline-to-first-cycle window instead of later stages, the approach supports earlier escalation or de-escalation of NACT, and its exclusive reliance on DW-MRI facilitates protocol standardization, multi-centre deployment and privacy-preserving data sharing. These results demonstrate that DW-MRI-based deep learning on tumor-centered patches constitutes a minimally invasive, clinically deployable strategy for early pCR prediction, with direct implications for personalized treatment adaptation in neoadjuvant breast cancer therapy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于EfficientNet-B0+双向LSTM的时序深度学习框架，仅使用基线和第一周期新辅助化疗（NACT）后的扩散加权MRI（DW-MRI）数据，对乳腺癌患者的病理完全缓解（pCR）进行早期预测，在10折交叉验证下达到AUC=0.90。
AI.motivation: 现有NACT反应预测模型多依赖多参数MRI（含钆对比剂）、晚期时间点或大量临床数据，限制了其临床适用性、多中心标准化和早期干预能力。本文旨在开发一种仅基于DW-MRI、无需对比剂、在治疗早期即可提供pCR预测的简化方法。
AI.method: 使用ACRIN 6698数据集（169例患者：112例非pCR，57例pCR）。预处理包括配对ADC/DW切片、重建体积、对比度拉伸、3×50×50肿瘤中心patch裁剪（保留5像素边缘）以及非肿瘤组织掩码。模型架构为EfficientNet-B0（ImageNet预训练）作为特征提取器，连接双向LSTM（64单元，dropout=0.4）进行时序建模，加入时间注意力模块，并融合图像质量指数和分类器。使用10折交叉验证，Adam优化器，学习率1e-4。
AI.result: 最终模型在10折交叉验证下达到：平均准确率84.30%±7.08，F1-score 0.85±0.07，AUC=0.90±0.06。消融实验显示：1）LSTM时序建模优于非递归拼接；2）EfficientNet-B0优于EffNet-B3、EfficientNetV2-B3、DenseNet-121和ViT；3）加入质量指数略微提升性能。单一DW-MRI输入的AUC（0.90）优于先前纯ADC研究（0.61-0.75），与多参数方法（0.86）相当。
AI.conclusion: 仅基于DW-MRI和肿瘤中心patch的时序深度学习可在首个NACT周期后准确预测pCR，无需对比剂或临床数据，便于多中心部署和早期治疗调整。局限性包括样本量较小、依赖专家标注的肿瘤mask，以及需要外部验证。

title: DTOC: Dynamic Tool Output Compression for Adaptive Context Management in AI Agents
comment: Accepted for 29th International Conference on Discovery Science, October 5-9, 2026, Mainz, Germany
summary: As agent capabilities have grown, practical limitations increasingly stem from constrained context windows rather than model capacity. Common strategies, such as truncation, heuristic aging, and lossy summarization, may discard useful information or introduce hallucination risk. To address these challenges, we propose Dynamic Tool Output Compression (DTOC), a framework for scalable context management in LLM-based agents that models context updates as explicit and reversible operations within the agent reasoning loop. DTOC retains full tool outputs in external memory while inserting compact placeholders into the active context, enabling selective reconstruction when needed. We formalize the DTOC mechanism, integrate it into a ReAct-style agent architecture, and provide a production-oriented implementation supporting on-demand restoration of compressed outputs. Experiments on DeepSWE reveal model-dependent effects: for responsive models (Sonnet 4.6, GPT-5.4), DTOC reduces input tokens (10.3 and 12.7%) and agent steps (2.4 and 32.3%), while increasing solve rates (2.5 and 1.5 times higher) and lowering cost per solved task (3 and 3.5 times lower cost per solved task). For the other models results are more mixed, with GPT-5.5 doubling solve rate and halving cost, but no impact on solve rate and negative impact on cost for the other models. Ablation results show reversibility is critical: disable-only compression variants degraded performance, while full DTOC recovered baseline accuracy at substantially lower context cost. These findings indicate that explicit, reversible context management can improve the efficiency of long-horizon agent reasoning without degrading task performance.

AI.tldr: DTOC（Dynamic Tool Output Compression）是一种面向LLM智能体的动态上下文管理框架。它将工具输出完整保存于外部存储中，在活跃上下文中以轻量占位符替代，支持按需恢复，形成可逆、显式的压缩操作。在DeepSWE基准上的实验显示，该方法对部分模型（如Sonnet 4.6、GPT-5.4、GPT-5.5）显著提升解题率并降低成本，但对Opus 4.8和Gemini 3.5 Flash无明显收益甚至产生负面开销，表明效果高度依赖模型特性。
AI.motivation: 长时程智能体推理受限于上下文窗口大小，而非模型能力本身。现有方法（硬截断、启发式老化、有损摘要）要么不可逆地丢失信息，要么引入摘要错误和幻觉风险，亟需一种无损、可恢复且由智能体自身驱动的上下文压缩机制。
AI.method: DTOC框架包含：(1) 外部持久存储𝒮保存所有ToolOutput记录（含tool_key、tool_result、estimated_tokens、timestamp、visible标志）；(2) AssembleContext过程按visible标志构建活跃上下文，隐藏输出替换为紧凑占位符（约30-50 token）；(3) ManageContext工具接受enable/disable两个ToolKey集合，由智能体通过自然语言描述自主决定何时压缩；(4) 占位符保留key、时间戳、token估计等元数据，确保引用完整性。算法完全模型无关，仅依赖编排层抽象，集成于OpenCode的ReAct风格智能体中。
AI.result: 在DeepSWE 6个真实任务上测试5个前沿模型：Sonnet 4.6解题率从20%升至50%，token降低10.3%，每任务成本降低67%；GPT-5.4解题率从33%升至50%，步骤减少32.3%，成本降低72%；GPT-5.5解题率翻倍但步骤增加14.3%；Opus 4.8和Gemini 3.5 Flash解题率不变但token开销上升18–49%。消融实验显示：仅跟踪不压缩轻微退化（77.8%），仅禁用（disable-only）提升至81.4%，完整DTOC达83.6%且文件重读次数降为0，证实可逆性是性能关键。
AI.conclusion: DTOC将上下文管理从系统级固定机制提升为智能体显式动作，实现可逆、无损、由智能体驱动的压缩。对于压缩响应型模型（推理风格匹配选择性深度压缩）效果显著，可降低67-72%成本并提升解题率；但对输出冗长或动作碎片化的模型（如Opus、Gemini）需模型特定调优。整体表明，上下文工程应作为智能体设计的核心维度，与规划、工具使用、记忆并列，且DTOC与LLMLingua等token级压缩互补，可结合形成更丰富的压缩策略研究。

title: FairMon: A Tool for Monitoring and Visualizing Algorithmic Fairness
summary: Runtime monitoring has recently been proposed as a rigorous method for analyzing algorithmic fairness of autonomous decision systems used in critical scenarios such as credit lending, job application, and the criminal justice system. Prior work has shown that runtime monitoring, in principle, can be an effective technique for establishing the kind of human oversight required by legislation such as the EU Artificial Intelligence Act. In practice, the available monitoring tools have not been developed with this application in mind and display several critical shortcomings in these scenarios. In this paper, we present FairMon, a runtime monitoring tool tailored to fairness analysis of high-stakes decision systems. FairMon uses RTLola as a flexible specification language for monitors, which we have extended with conditional probability operators that allow for concise descriptions of algorithmic fairness properties. The tool also features a real-time visualization of intermediary values, enabling human insight into the dynamics of the monitored system.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了FairMon，一个基于RTLola的运行时监控工具，专为高风险决策系统（如信贷、就业、刑事司法）的算法公平性分析而设计，通过扩展RTLola加入条件概率算子简化公平性规约，并提供实时可视化界面。
AI.motivation: 现有的运行时监控工具并非为算法公平性分析而设计，在语法简洁性和执行可视化方面存在严重不足，难以满足EU AI法案等法规对人机监管的要求，且现有编码方式（如使用RTLola的标准流与聚合）需要至少五个输出流，门槛高、易出错。
AI.method: 作者对RTLola规范语言进行扩展，加入直接编码（条件）概率的概率算子，使equalized odds等公平性属性可用单条触发条件直接表达；工具FairMon提供图形用户界面，支持数据源配置、规范编辑以及监控过程（中间值）的实时折线图可视化；通过集成框架支持多种数据源接入，并演示与EU DSA透明度数据库API的连接。
AI.result: 作者提出了FairMon工具，相比之前工作将equalized odds的编码从至少五个输出流缩减为一条触发条件；工具具备专用概率算子、GUI可视化与集成接口，并在COMPAS数据集和EU DSA透明度数据库等场景上演示。
AI.conclusion: FairMon通过专用算子和可视化降低了流式运行时监控用于算法公平性分析的门槛，为高风险自主决策系统提供了更易用、更透明的人工监管手段，符合EU AI Act等立法对人类监督的要求。

title: MAC-RRG: Iterative Multi-Agent Collaboration for X-ray Radiology Report Generation
summary: Despite the remarkable progress of LLM-based and knowledge graph-augmented Radiology Report Generation (RRG) methods, existing techniques still suffer from inherent defects. Conventional LLM-only models lack structured medical prior knowledge, resulting in frequent medical hallucinations and low diagnostic interpretability. Current knowledge graph-enhanced schemes adopt static one-round knowledge fusion with single-source knowledge, incapable of dynamic knowledge updating according to generation feedback. This paper proposes a novel Multi-Agent Collaborative iterative framework for X-ray Radiology Report Generation, termed MAC-RRG. Inspired by multi-agent technology, our framework constructs a closed-loop optimization paradigm based on task decoupling and collaborative reasoning. Specifically, the framework first generates a preliminary radiology report from input X-ray images via a vision encoder and a basic LLM. Subsequently, a multimodal knowledge graph (MM-KG) agent mines structured disease correlation and anatomical knowledge from medical knowledge graphs, while an auxiliary knowledge agent extracts unstructured domain knowledge from public medical databases. The multi-source knowledge acquired by dual agents is fused and embedded to guide the LLM in iteratively refining the initial report. Extensive quantitative and qualitative experiments on mainstream X-ray RRG datasets, including IU X-ray, MIMIC, and CheXpert Plus, fully verify the superiority of our proposed method. The source code and pre-trained models have been released on this https URL

AI.tldr: 本文提出MAC-RRG，一种基于多智能体协作的迭代式X光放射学报告生成框架。该框架利用MM-KG智能体从医学知识图谱挖掘结构化知识，并利用辅助知识智能体从外部数据库检索非结构化知识，通过知识融合模块引导LLM迭代优化初始报告。在IU X-ray、CheXpert Plus和MIMIC-CXR数据集上取得了领先的NLG和临床疗效指标。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM放射学报告生成方法存在三大缺陷：(1)纯LLM方法缺乏结构化医学先验知识，易产生医学幻觉，诊断可解释性差；(2)知识图谱增强方法采用静态单轮知识融合，知识源单一，无法根据生成反馈动态更新知识；(3)上述方法均为一次性生成管道，缺乏迭代优化的反馈回路，导致初始报告中的实体遗漏和描述偏差无法被持续修正。
AI.method: 提出MAC-RRG多智能体协作框架，包含两阶段：(1)初始报告生成——使用Swin Transformer视觉编码器和Llama2-7B生成初步报告；(2)迭代报告优化——通过实体提取获得解剖结构和疾病实体后，由两个互补智能体分别处理：MM-KG Agent从医学知识图谱构建实体中心子图并通过关系感知图注意力编码（每个实体最多10个邻居），Knowledge Agent基于PubMedVision构建的393条知识条目，使用BGE-M3检索+重排序获取实体级文本证据。两路知识经Bio_ClinicalBERT编码后通过知识融合模块（直接拼接）与视觉token融合，投影至LLM隐藏空间。采用自回归语言建模损失进行端到端优化。视觉编码器使用Swin Transformer，语言主干使用Llama2-7B。
AI.result: 在三个主流数据集上的实验结果：(1) IU X-ray：BLEU-4达0.197（CIDEr 0.703），在BLEU-3/4、ROUGE-L、CIDEr上取得最佳；(2) CheXpert Plus：BLEU-4达0.105，临床疗效F1达0.295、Precision达0.350，均为最佳，超越R2GenGPT（BLEU-4 0.101）；(3) MIMIC-CXR：BLEU-4达0.128，在BLEU-2/3/4上取得最佳。消融实验验证了MM-KG Agent、Knowledge Agent和知识融合模块各自的贡献——三者联合使用效果最佳，top_K=10为最优邻居数，Anatomy+Disorder为最优实体类型组合，400 chunks为最优检索语料规模，直接拼接优于自注意力和交叉注意力融合策略。
AI.conclusion: MAC-RRG通过任务解耦和协作推理构建了闭环优化范式，证明了角色专业化的知识智能体能够为基于LLM的放射学报告生成提供互补的结构化和文本证据。局限性在于性能依赖于初始草稿报告的质量，实体遗漏或错误描述会导致外部证据检索不完整。未来工作将探索更鲁棒的实体提取、更大规模的医学知识库、不确定性感知检索和自适应知识融合策略。代码和预训练模型已在GitHub开源。

title: When Big Data Becomes a Curse: Spatial Heterogeneity and the Limits of Learning from Passive Acoustic Monitoring Data
summary: Passive Acoustic Monitoring produces large archives whose recordings are clustered by deployment, season, station identifier, and acquisition configuration. We analyze 908,072 AIS-labeled 679-second recordings from 38 deployments, 20 Atlantic Canadian station identifiers, and 21 receiver positions. The AIS-contact prior varies by more than 200-fold, and per-deployment screening distributions require local interpretation. Bidirectional cross-season transfer over the 18 station identifiers observed in both seasons predicts station identity above the 5.56% uniform-chance level, with balanced accuracy of 15.9% for AIS-contact and 16.4% for no-AIS-contact recordings. The same descriptors predict the two hydrophone models at 74.1% and 85.6% balanced accuracy, respectively, but hydrophone model is strongly confounded with season and other deployment-level acquisition differences. On a retrospectively screened and capped benchmark of 54m507 recordings, repeated station-grouped holdout yields an ROC-AUC of 0.612 with a station-bootstrap 95% interval of 0.582 to 0.648, compared with 0.661 under a random-window diagnostic. Their paired difference is 0.049 (0.040 to 0.056). Removing raw energy changes unseen-station ROC-AUC from 0.612 to 0.603, while an exploratory training-station scale analysis is non-monotonic. These results show that random-window validation overstates transfer to unseen station identifiers in this corpus. They support dependence-aware validation and broader independent spatial sampling, while spatial-expert models remain a hypothesis rather than an established remedy.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了加拿大Atlantic地区908,072条水下被动声学监测(PAM)录音,指出大数据规模可能因空间异质性和站点依赖性而误导机器学习模型向新站点的迁移能力评估。通过对比随机窗口验证与站点分组留出验证,发现随机验证高估了向未见站点的迁移性能,ROC-AUC差距为0.049。
AI.motivation: PAM数据虽被视作"大数据",但观测按部署、季节和站点聚类,共享地理和采集配置依赖性。传统的随机划分验证假设i.i.d.条件,在多站点声学数据中可能高估模型泛化能力。研究旨在揭示大数据量可能强化局部依赖而非提供真正独立的站点支持。
AI.method: 1) 基于30类AIS标签连接生成船舶接触标签;2) 提取5个声学描述符(谱平坦度、谱熵、峰均比、能量方差等均值);3) 使用300树随机森林进行分类;4) 采用4种验证协议(随机窗口确认站、已知站点跨季节、留一区域、未见站点);5) 站点分组分层5折交叉验证;6) 配对协议对比通过共享站点重采样估计Δ_AUC;7) 对3种分类器(随机森林、直方图梯度提升、逻辑回归)进行鲁棒性检验。
AI.result: 主要结果:1) AIS接触先验变化超200倍(0.49%至99.8%);2) 18个跨季节站点标识符属性仅达15.9%/16.2%平衡准确度(机会水平5.56%);3) 换能器型号预测达74.1%/85.6%,但与采集差异严重混淆;4) 未见站点ROC-AUC为0.612(95%CI:0.582-0.648),而随机窗口验证为0.661;5) 配对差Δ_AUC=0.049(95%CI:0.040-0.056),1000次重采样均未非正;6) 训练站点比例呈非单调关系;7) 谱平坦度是最重要的预测特征。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明在多站点PAM数据中,大数据量本身不能保证向未见站点的迁移能力。随机窗口验证系统性高估迁移性能。声学大数据应被视为地理空间域泛化问题,需要以站点标识符为单位进行依赖感知验证。空间专家模型仍为假设而非已验证的解决方案。未来工作需要更广泛的独立空间和采集支持。

title: The Cost of Conservation: Coordination-Memory Laws for Exact-Support Generation
summary: Many AI systems make decisions locally, even when every realized output must obey an additive conservation law, such as selecting exactly a fixed number of items. This constraint can be statistically invisible: small subsets of a balanced fixed-budget output look increasingly independent, yet communication-free coordinate-parallel generation needs exponentially many pre-shared plans, while a sequential exact sampler needs only logarithmic memory. We study product measures conditioned on additive conservation laws in the intermediate regime where one plan is selected before a fixed-order pass, every plan is a bounded-state stochastic executor whose support is entirely legal, and the mixture of plan laws approximates the target distribution in total variation. Our main result identifies the optimal asymptotic selector rate, up to constant factors, with the killed spectral profile of the conservation-difference walk. The resulting coordination cost decreases as an inverse power of live-state width, with an exponent determined by intrinsic conservation rank rather than alphabet size; the law extends to noncentral budgets and heterogeneous local scores. The converse is driven by a state-versus-resource-sum obstruction, while a rate-matching construction compiles discrepancy control into exact-support finite-state plans. Complementary results characterize block-parallel plan complexity and the benefit of programmable output order. Together, these results show precisely how online memory substitutes for front-loaded coordination in exact-support generation.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究在加性守恒律约束下进行精确支撑生成的协调-记忆权衡问题。在固定顺序、有限状态接口下，证明选择器速率与"被杀谱轮廓"等价，核心交换率为 Θ(S^(-2/r))，其中 r 是内禀守恒秩，并验证了局部统计无法判定执行记忆代价，存在碎片化不可见性。
AI.motivation: 实际 AI 系统（如束搜索、混合专家路由）常需在固定顺序、有限在线内存下生成严格满足守恒约束（如恰好选择 k 项）的输出。统计简洁性不能保证执行简洁性：通信自由的并行生成需指数级预共享计划，而顺序采样仅需对数内存。论文旨在精确量化"前置协调"与"在线记忆"之间的交换关系。
AI.method: 执行模型：固定顺序、宽度 S 的有界状态随机执行器，每个计划具有合法支撑，混合律在 TV 距离下近似目标 iid 条件律。技术上采用：(1) 基于被杀差分游走核 K_{p,v} 的谱轮廓 Λ_{p,v}(S) 进行反证（结合 Faber-Krahn 与 Nash 不等式）；(2) 加权消去编译器，通过代码字级精确后验实现（Proposition 1）；(3) 异质位置情形的 Doeblin 小化与均匀比较；(4) 用于块并行与可编程阶的列线/轨道平均构造；(5) 配对独立仿射种子码本以线性描述代价闭合部署账。
AI.result: 主要定理 1（守恒秩谱律）：选择器速率在常数因子内满足 Λ_{p,v}(S)/(2ln2) ≤ R_fix(S) ≤ (8q/p_min/ln2)·Λ_{p,v}(S)，且 R_fix(S) = Θ_{p,v}(S^(-2/r))，其中 r 为差分格内禀秩。推论 1（定额安全路由前沿）、定理 3（秩分割守恒几何）给出持久状态预算 B_η(d) = (r/2)·H(α_1,…,α_J)/ln2 + Θ_η(r)。定理 4（局部统计不可定价守恒）证明两个局部不可区分但执行记忆相差 Θ(log r) 比特的靶律共存；m/√r 局部检测阈值尖锐。有限审计：秩 1/2 游走尾斜率 -1.964/-0.948，UltraFeedback 9-of-18 slates 中位下界 5,938 坐标并行计划。
AI.conclusion: 在线记忆以由内禀守恒秩控制的速率替代前置协调，但碎片化将此代价隐藏在局部统计之下。论文精确界定了哪种接口被定价（固定顺序、合法支撑、有界状态），并与其他体系结构路径（丢弃、批处理分配、动态调度、可修复性、秩程序化顺序）划清界限。定理为接口特异性的资源定理，而非架构无关的不可能性。

title: VACS: Value-Aligned Compositional Shielding for Multi-Agent Reasoning
summary: Multi-agent reasoning systems in high-stakes domains must be both accurate and safe, yet agents often follow heterogeneous value priorities (e.g., rigor, conciseness, safety), causing conflicting recommendations. Existing methods do not jointly provide: (i) principled inference of each agent's implicit values from behavior, (ii) compositional formal safety guarantees without full online communication, and (iii) value-aware conflict resolution with faithful explanations. We present VACS (Value-Aligned Compositional Shielding), a four-layer framework addressing all three. Layer 1 learns value-dimension rewards from pairwise preferences using Bradley-Terry modeling and infers per-agent value weights via deep MaxEnt IRL. Layer 2 encodes value constraints in a Lean-inspired DSL and synthesizes compositional assume-guarantee shields for runtime safety. Layer 3 resolves disagreement through nucleolus-based credit allocation and Hamiltonian consensus optimization under long-term value constraints. Layer 4 extracts a critical reasoning path from co-state sensitivities and generates formally grounded natural-language explanations. Our contribution is primarily a unified systems design with formalized interfaces and operational guarantees at the verifier-constrained decision level, rather than a complete end-to-end formal proof of all language-model internals. In controlled proof-of-concept evaluations with role-conditioned agent panels on NEJM-AI QA, MathInstruct-Subset, and a cybersecurity incident-response benchmark (CyberSec-Eval), VACS outperforms strong baselines in accuracy (85.4%, 95.0%, and 90.0%) while reducing logical inconsistency rates to near zero.

AI.tldr: VACS提出一个四层框架，将多智能体推理中的价值对齐与形式化安全保证相结合。第一层通过Bradley-Terry模型与深度MaxEnt IRL推断各智能体的隐式价值权重；第二层将价值约束编码为受Lean启发的DSL规则，并综合合成组合式assume-guarantee防护盾；第三层通过核仁信用分配与Hamiltonian共识优化解决冲突；第四层基于协态敏感性提取关键推理路径并生成可验证的自然语言解释。在数学、临床问答与网络安全基准测试中，VACS在准确率上优于强基线，并将逻辑不一致率降至接近零。
AI.motivation: 在高风险领域（数学证明、临床诊断、网络安全）中，多智能体系统虽然通过整合多样化视角提升推理质量，但各智能体往往持有不同的隐式价值优先级（如严谨性 vs. 简洁性），导致最终聚合结果出现内部不一致、不可解释或难以审计等问题。现有方法缺乏统一框架来同时解决：(i)从行为中推断智能体隐式价值；(ii)在无需在线通信的情况下提供组合式形式化安全保证；(iii)进行价值感知的冲突消解与忠实解释。
AI.method: 四层框架：Layer 1——Bradley-Terry建模从成对偏好学习各价值维度奖励函数，再用深度MaxEnt IRL推断每个智能体的价值权重向量；Layer 2——将五个价值维度（完备性、简洁性、泛化性、健全性、安全性）编码为Lean启发的DSL约束φ_k，并合成基于assume-guarantee推理的组合式"剪枝-重排"防护盾，确保本地安全；Layer 3——构造合作博弈，通过核仁（nucleolus）进行公平的信用分配，并以核仁权重和价值对齐分数驱动Hamiltonian优化（含协态λ的长程约束求解），最大化加权共识得分；Layer 4——利用Hamiltonian协态对动作嵌入的敏感性提取关键推理路径，映射为Lean-DSL证明证书，再以模板与LLM两种渲染器生成自然语言解释。
AI.result: 在MathInstruct-Subset（200题）、NEJM-AI QA（1200+题）与CyberSec-Eval（500题）四个智能体面板上，VACS分别达到95.0%、85.4%、90.0%的准确率，逻辑不一致率降至0.0%，显著优于多数投票、加权投票、Informed Voting与仅防护盾等基线。消融实验证实四层各司其职：Layer 1驱动价值恢复，Layer 2消除不一致，Layer 3提升共识质量，Layer 4保障解释忠实性。解释验证中专家评分为4.5/5，优于验证器仅追踪（3.4）与纯梯度显著性（3.2）。安全性压力测试中，对抗用例拒绝率达96.8%（对比无防护投票的31.4%失败率）。
AI.conclusion: VACS作为系统设计与概念验证贡献，在受控的、角色条件化的智能体面板上验证了价值对齐+组合式防护+核仁共识+验证器锚定解释这一统一管线的可行性，可显著提升准确率并近乎完全消除逻辑不一致。但作者明确指出其局限：(i)评估面板为工程化的价值异质性，未验证在自然异质的前沿模型上的发现能力；(ii)价值轮廓离线估计，假设平稳性，未建模漂移；(iii)形式化保证以有限候选集与验证器为条件，并非端到端完整证明；(iv)Bradley-Terry与核仁计算的扩展性受限；(v)仅在三个基准、固定面板下测试，外部有效性待验。作者将其定位为可部署多智能体价值对齐推理的概念验证，而非可投入运行的成熟方案。

title: When Verifiers Vote Backwards under Verdict Substitution: Signed Pivotal Value in Correlated Self-Consistency
summary: Replacing one ballot can change a majority decision only on queries decided by a single vote; this structural fact requires no independence assumption. We study the sign of that change using a labeled, verdict-style intervention: one correctness signal replaces one correctness-indicator ballot in $k{=}7$ self-consistency panels. This diagnostic intervention is not identical to deployed answer-identity plurality. A primary MATH-500 experiment ($n{=}570$) gives a different-model verifier a $+24.2$pp pivotal gain, whereas a role-reversed configuration gives $-11.2$pp; an exploratory code stress test (14 pivotal rows across 9 tasks) gives $-24.5$pp. An exact signed-gain decomposition accounts for all observed signs through the verifier's state-specific accuracy and the composition of the two one-vote tally states, rather than global accuracy or model provenance. Same-source signals lose accuracy on the pivotal stratum (65$\to$44\% in the primary configuration), while error correlations provide a descriptive error-association diagnostic. Controlled degradation and a $k\in\{3,5,7\}$ subset sensitivity analysis probe the stability of the observed pattern around this accounting. Under the evaluated ties-incorrect answer-identity plurality analysis, the structural zero and strong-verifier benefit persist, but the role-reversed harm attenuates to $-0.9$pp and is not significant. The results therefore establish harmful verdict substitution, not universally harmful deployed plurality, and motivate a testable but unverified hypothesis for negative process-reward-model weights.

AI.tldr: 本文研究Self-Consistency多数投票中,以一个外部验证信号替换其中一票时的符号性问题(有益还是有害)。核心发现:替换一票只能在margin=1的"关键票"问题上改变多数结果(结构性零);而在关键票问题上的增益符号,取决于验证器在S=3与S=4两个关键状态下的条件准确率及状态组成,而非全局准确率或模型来源。实验在MATH-500和LiveCodeBench上给出反号证据,提出可证伪的负PRM权重假设。
AI.motivation: 动机源于Kuang et al.(2026)观察到PRM最优权重常为负的"反直觉"现象,以及现有方法无法确定单票替换后改变的方向(对错)。本文把"结构性可改变"与"经验性方向"严格区分。
AI.method: 方法:(1)在k=7、温度0.8的同模型自洽小组中,用二元正确性信号替换一票,做留一交叉;(2)推导符号增益的精确分解恒等式G_piv=(4/7)[P(S=3|m=1)P(V=1|S=3)−P(S=4|m=1)(1−P(V=1|S=4))];(3)四组配置实验(MATH-500主实验与角色互换、LiveCodeBench两组);(4)受控退化(随机翻转正确判决)与k∈{3,5,7}子集敏感性分析;(5)在"平局判错"的答案身份多数投票下重做分析;(6)Bootstrapping CI(朴素+任务聚类)。
AI.result: 结果:主实验(n=570)异模型验证器关键区增益+24.2pp[14.1,33.7];角色互换n=380得−11.2pp[−20.9,−1.2];LiveCodeBench原配置(n=14关键行)−24.5pp[−40.8,−9.5];强验证器n=240得+17.5pp[9.2,26.5];同源信号在所有配置下增益为零或非显著。同源信号的全局准确率在关键问题上骤降(如65→44%、87→35.7%);误差相关系数被作为描述性诊断。在答案身份多数投票下,强验证器收益保持(+15.0pp),但互换配置的有害性衰减至−0.9pp且不显著,共识区增益严格为零。
AI.conclusion: 结论:有害的"判决替换"已被确立,而非普遍有害的部署式答案身份多数投票。符号增益可由精确恒等式用状态条件准确率和关键状态组成来解释;全局准确率与模型来源可能误导。同一来源的强信号难以构造(五种尝试均不显著);受控退化刻画了单边腐败下的轨迹。提出关于负PRM权重的可证伪假设,需实际PRM与加权聚合测试加以验证。本研究确立的是描述性会计恒等式,不主张相关性导致该现象的因果解释。

title: Unanimity Without Persuasion: A Single Round of Debate Erases the Disagreement That Verification Needs
summary: A debate panel can become unanimous without becoming more correct. This is dangerous for downstream safeguards: a substituted verification ballot can change only narrow-margin votes, while richer arbiters lose disagreement as a natural targeting signal. We show that one debate round can erase that resource without requiring persuasion. Tracking a heterogeneous 7-judge panel through a blind round and three debate rounds on 600 code-correctness candidates, unanimity on a fixed cohort jumps from 39.5\% to 95.2\% in round 1 (93.1\% of the total collapse), while accuracy moves by less than one point and 96.3\% of verdict flips follow the displayed peer majority. An execution-based verification ballot corrects 8 of 2,037 pre-debate candidate-substitution instances but changes zero in every later round; by round 3 every wrong decision is unanimous, erasing dissent that had flagged two-thirds of the panel's errors. Identical-cohort controls explain why: no-peer reconsideration reproduces 79.6\% of the collapse, real labels without reasoning reproduce 91.5\%, and random labels steer flips toward whatever they display; the full-debate condition adds 4.3 percentage points over labels only (clustered 95\% CI 0.7--8.1). The one-round collapse reproduces in two additional real runs and two fake-label seeds, remains under panel sizes 3--7, and appears in MATH-500. Parse failures concentrate on contested candidates ($p<0.001$), making attrition non-ignorable. The design implication is operational: verify before any second-pass evaluation or peer exposure, and never treat post-debate unanimity as independent evidence of reliability.

AI.tldr: 本文通过7人异构LLM评审团在600个代码正确性候选解上经历1轮盲评+3轮辩论的实验，揭示仅一轮辩论就将一致性从39.5%飙升至95.2%（占全部崩塌的93.1%），而准确率几乎不变（<1pp），并使验证投票的有效干预从8次降为零。控制实验表明这一崩塌主要由"二次重新审视"（贡献79.6%）和"标签跟随"（累计达91.5%）驱动，而非实质性说服，呼吁在辩论前完成验证而非将后辩论一致性视为可靠性证据。
AI.motivation: 多智能体辩论（Multi-agent debate）通常以最终准确率作为评估指标，但下游安全机制（如执行验证、外部仲裁）实质依赖的是评审团内部的分歧（disagreement）作为不确定性信号和干预靶点。然而当LLM评审员的错误高度相关时，多数票可能系统性地压制正确的少数意见。He等人（2026）的研究表明辩论后仲裁困难，但其分析未涉及辩论本身对分歧分布的影响。本文旨在量化辩论对评审团分歧的影响及其对外部验证信号可用性的后果。
AI.method: 实验设置：7名来自不同提供商的异构LLM评审员（GPT-4o-mini、Claude Haiku等）对600个来自HumanEval+和MBPP+的代码正确性候选解进行评判，以执行测试套件作为确定性真值标签。流程包括1轮盲评（round 0）+3轮辩论（rounds 1-3），每轮评审员看到匿名同伴的上轮裁决和最多400字符的理由，按固定队列（n=291）进行配对追踪。干预规则分类：替换（substitution）、追加（addition）、覆盖（override），并基于Banzhaf关键投票者定理推导Fact 1：单票替换仅在投票差m=1（关键案例）时能改变决策。控制实验包括：虚假标签（独立随机生成）、仅真实标签（不含理由）、无同伴二次审视，以及去除最易失败评审员的6人子组。
AI.result: 核心发现：(1) 辩论将关键案例从10→2→0→0，替换验证投票的有效干预从8次降为0次；(2) 一致性从39.5%飙升至95.2%（93.1%的总崩塌发生于第1轮，95% CI 88.9–96.8），准确率仅从91.8%变动到92.4%（McNemar p=0.50）；(3) 96.3%的裁决翻转朝向所展示的同伴多数（CI 94.0–98.4），全错决策由8个增至22个且全部一致通过；(4) 无同伴二次审视再现79.6%的崩塌，随机标签再现69%（并使89.5%的翻转跟随随机多数），仅显示真实标签达91.5%，完整辩论仅比仅标签条件多4.3pp（CI 0.7–8.1）；(5) 解析失败高度集中于有争议的候选解（31.1% vs 3.7%关键率，χ²=151.9, p<0.001），固定队列比较校正了约13pp的虚高；(6) 跨模型翻转率差异极大（0.7%–26.1%），但排名在真实与虚假条件下Spearman ρ=0.99；(7) 结论在3-7人评审组、6人子组、MATH-500任务、两个额外真实运行和两个虚假标签种子中均得到复现。
AI.conclusion: 辩论在实质说服发生之前就已破坏下游安全机制所依赖的分歧信号；单轮辩论即消灭了"可靶向的错误"。设计启示：(1) 若需同时使用辩论与替换式验证，应在任何二次评估或同伴暴露之前使用验证器检查round-0边缘差；(2) 后辩论一致性不应视为可靠性证据——它主要源自二次审视和标签对齐而非实质性说服；(3) 重复的解析失败本身可作为有争议候选解的廉价旗标，用于路由至验证器或人工；(4) 任何依赖分歧的下游机制（路由器、弃权规则、不确定性估计）在辩论后均面临信号已被擦除的风险。本研究将替换规则下的辩论后干预从经验困难转化为结构性不可能性。

title: Toward User-Mediated Self-Repair in Ubiquitous Robots Through Goal-Oriented Agentic AI
summary: Ubiquitous robotic systems often lack traditional visual interfaces, necessitating resilient natural language interaction for maintenance and repair tasks. This paper presents a goal oriented agentic AI architecture designed to enable non-expert users to perform technical repairs through situated dialogue. The framework utilizes a multi-layered approach that decouples high-level strategic planning from reactive conversational execution to transform unconstrained human instructions into a structured hierarchy of goals. We conducted a study involving twenty participants to evaluate the system's efficacy using a physical hardware testbed. The architecture achieved a 95\% task completion rate, and participants reported positive self-efficacy following real-time guidance that adapted to conversational diversions and linguistic variations. A comparative analysis with an online baseline revealed that the transition to a physical environment significantly decreased perceived social presence (p=.0005), and trust and competence, (p=.037), while the agentic framework remained robust throughout the interaction. These findings indicate that goal oriented agentic AI can support the sustainability of body-worn technologies by empowering users to perform critical maintenance in ubiquitous contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种目标导向的智能体AI架构，通过多层次多智能体系统将高层战略规划与反应式对话执行解耦，使非专家用户能够通过自然语言对话完成可穿戴/泛在机器人的物理维修任务。基于20人参与的物理实验验证，架构实现了95%的任务完成率，并能稳健处理语言切换和元查询等非规范性输入，但相比在线基线，物理环境显著降低了用户对社会临场感与信任能力的评价。
AI.motivation: 泛在/可穿戴机器人因长期与人体接触容易发生机械故障，而其界面常常隐蔽或缺少视觉反馈，传统静态手册或线性教程无法应对分支逻辑和内部依赖，因此需要一种能够通过对话引导非专家用户完成自助维修的智能体AI中介。
AI.method: 构建分层多智能体架构，包含四个组件：(1) 预交互运行的"慢思考"目标分解智能体（基于Llama 3.1 70B，将自然语言指令转化为目标/子目标层级结构并建模条件分支与依赖）；(2) 持久化处理智能体（基于ChromaDB存储对话历史、目标状态与中间变量）；(3) 战略智能体（高层目标管理，异步执行，监控全局状态并决定当前激活目标）；(4) 对话智能体（基于Qwen 30B的"快思考"执行层，受限于当前激活目标，负责实时口语化交互）。通过物理测试平台（带LED状态灯、鳄鱼夹电线和蓝/绿颜色配置贴纸的条件分支接线任务）结合Pygame动画机器人面孔（含眨眼、扫视等拟人行为、面部检测触发、Whiper STT），招募20名大学生参与完成接线维修任务，并与N=70的在线基线对比分析。
AI.result: 客观结果：19/20完成维修，任务完成率95%；平均对话轮次19.7（理论最优9轮，t(19)=2.27, p=.035），显著高于在线基线11.4轮。主观评价：信任与胜任力M=4.87/7 (SD=1.57, α=.93, d=0.56)，社会临场感M=4.09/7 (SD=1.45, α=.80, d=0.06)，自我效能M=4.95；与在线基线相比，物理环境显著降低了社会临场感(p=.0005)和信任胜任力(p=.037)，但系统有用性(M=4.60 vs 4.21)和感知理解(M=4.25 vs 4.21)保持稳定。系统对语言切换(10.5%)和元查询(21.1%)表现出稳健的恢复能力。AI熟悉度与信任无显著相关(r=-0.07, p=.775)。
AI.conclusion: 目标导向智能体AI可通过情境对话有效赋能用户主导的泛在机器人维护，95%的完成率证明其在缺乏视觉反馈的隐蔽物理维修场景中的可行性与稳健性；然而物理环境的"现实鸿沟"（电气风险感知、操作复杂性）会显著降低用户的社会临场感和信任评价，表明数字环境下的感知可能被人为放大。考虑到小样本(N=20)、仅后测的自我效能测量以及受控的条件分支任务，这些结果应被视为可行性证据而非因果改进或广泛泛化性的证明。未来工作需扩大样本、采用前后测对照设计，并测试更复杂的多故障诊断与长期维修会话。

title: The Free-Recipe Limit: Every Recipe Effect Measures Which Premise of an Idealised Learner Broke
comment: 42 pages, 9 figures, 17 tables (incl. appendices); code, pre-registration files, and result base to be released with the paper
summary: Fix a corpus and send recipe search to infinity: try every order of the skills, every arrangement from blocked to interleaved, every composition, and keep the best. Two quantities decide what that search was worth: the diameter of the reachable set it explores, and the resolution at which anyone can tell two endpoints apart. Where the diameter falls below the resolution, no amount of search converts into a decision, and the signature is not an absence of winners but winners that do not survive re-running. We measure this recipe-search wall with 761 fine-tuning runs on 12 base models (0.5B-14B, three pretraining families) over competition-mathematics skills: base checkpoints, supervised fine-tuning under AdamW, exact-match scoring at k=4. Within one coherent domain at fixed volume the three classical freedoms average 0.010-0.021 against a 0.019 floor, and the largest contrast, 0.0619, clears a three-seed resolution and then reads +0.010 and -0.015 on two reruns. The departure with a systematic answer is coherence: halving one pooled corpus and letting the halves write answers under incompatible but equally correct conventions moves arrangement from capability to allocation between conventions, by two orders of magnitude over a same-convention control, and writing the convention into the input switches the phenomenon off. The switch replicates on a second pretraining family and survives an independent re-execution of its own protocol, with a re-execution spread (0.087) smaller than the resolution a search-selected order cell carries (0.144). Order itself is a transient whose sign crosses zero three times inside a single run. Volume, the one lever nobody calls a recipe, is the one that reliably pays. A public scorecard grades all 26 pre-registered claims: 18 supported, 5 failed, 2 untested, 1 mixed.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"自由配方极限"(Free-Recipe Limit)框架：固定语料库进行无限配方搜索时，两个量决定搜索价值——可达集的直径和测量分辨率。当直径低于分辨率时，搜索无法转化为可靠决策，胜出者无法在重跑中幸存。通过761次微调实验证明：一致性领域内三种经典自由度（顺序、排列、组合）均落在噪声底板内，而唯一具有系统性答案的偏离是一致性破坏——内部矛盾使排列从移动"能力"转变为移动"分配"，效应扩大两个数量级。数据量才是真正可靠的杠杆。
AI.motivation: 后训练流程中存在三个未明说的决策（哪些技能一起训练、阻塞还是交错、哪个技能先训练），搜索空间为O(n!)，但文献给出矛盾指导。本文不从测量角度添加新观测，而是从"无限搜索"的思想实验出发，定义可达集直径与分辨率两个量的比值，建立"配方搜索墙"命题，诊断任何观测到的配方效应究竟测量的是哪个理想前提的破坏。
AI.method: 1.理论框架：在懒惰区线性学习者中证明三种自由度在一致性领域、固定体积下严格为零，给出有限预算下的二项展开式和一致性破坏时的闭式偏置。2.实验装置：12个基模型（Qwen2.5/3、Llama-3，0.5B-14B），竞赛数学技能，监督微调+AdamW，k=4精确匹配评分，五种训练臂（only_A/only_B、A→B、B→A、shuffle）产生十种测量。3.冲突程序：将同一合并语料库随机对半切分，仅改变两半是否要求不兼容但同样正确的输出惯例（如数字vs拼写）。4.预注册：所有26项主张在数据产生前冻结，分辨率定价 δ_sel=0.144。
AI.result: 1.一致性领域内：组合0.0101、排列0.0140、顺序0.0205，均在0.0191底板内不可分辨；最佳顺序格0.0619在两次重跑中读为+0.010和-0.015，符号反转。2.一致性破坏：数字vs拼写 D=-0.0985（5.16倍底板），合成冲突 D=-0.2346（12.3倍底板），8种子全部为负；对照仅-0.005。3.体积倍增：每翻倍+0.0463，2.4倍底板，唯一可靠杠杆。4.跨族复制：Qwen3-8B五种子全部为负 D=-0.0875（4.58倍底板）。5.协议重执行：再执行两次均值-0.1258、-0.0825，六新种子全负，重执行离散度0.087小于搜索选择顺序格的0.144。6.顺序瞬态：单次运行内符号过零三次，预算依赖而非标量。7.26项预注册主张：18支持、5失败、2未测、1混合。
AI.conclusion: 配方搜索受限于两个被测量的数字——可达集直径（一致性领域内固定体积时最大单对比0.0619）和测量分辨率（三种子设计0.054、实际单次运行约0.14）。失败模式不是效应不存在，而是不可分辨：最佳格清除乐观阈值后重跑时符号反转。打破一致性是唯一系统性偏离，它改变了排列移动的量（从能力到分配），移动幅度扩大两个数量级；将惯例写入输入即可关闭该开关。筛选问题廉价：两组语料库是否会对同一输入给出不同标签？若否，在此规模上不应将运行预算花在排列上，预算应属于体积。

title: EADC: Evaluation of Advanced and Deep-level Compliance in Large Language Models
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have been used in various industries. However, ensuring their compliance with complex laws and regulatory frameworks remains a great challenge. Existing evaluation paradigms mainly rely on static benchmarks that suffer from three severe limitations: First, the compliance rules being used do not comply with the requirements of Artificial Intelligence (AI) laws and regulations; Second, they only handle apparent, explicit compliance risks, leaving implicit and covert compliance risks undetected; Third, they fail to track the systematic propagation of risks along logical dependency chains or evaluate compliance within nuanced, context-based real-world scenarios. To bridge this critical gap, we introduce EADC, a novel advanced evaluation benchmark of LLMs based on an AI compliance knowledge graph and AI compliance legal experts. By mapping abstract legal rules into structured logical multi-relational graphs, our framework enables automated, evolving agents to distill and synthesize highly sophisticated adversarial scenarios. This compliance benchmark is reviewed and corrected by human AI legal experts throughout the whole process. The resulting dataset (4,435+ QA pairs) provides an extensive, multi-dimensional taxonomy covering critical regulatory frontiers, including bias and discrimination, fairness, personal privacy protection, and values. Crucially, our compliance dataset moves beyond shallow string-matching by incorporating contextual long-horizon interactions and logic-driven hazard chains, capturing deeply embedded compliance anomalies that bypass traditional filters. Experiment evaluations demonstrate that our framework exposes critical regulatory blind spots in state-of-the-art LLMs, offering a rigorous, AI laws and regulations-aligned benchmark to safeguard high-level and deep compliance in the application of LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EADC基准，基于AI合规知识图谱和法律专家审查，评估大语言模型在高级深度合规风险（隐性与隐性、逻辑推理链、情境化场景）方面的能力，并通过4435+问答对在多个前沿LLM上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM合规评估基准存在三大局限：(1)合规规则未对齐AI法律法规；(2)仅检测显式合规风险，无法识别隐性与隐性风险；(3)无法追踪风险沿逻辑依赖链的系统传播，也难以评估情境化真实场景中的合规性。
AI.method: 将抽象法律法规转换为一阶谓词逻辑与多关系图结构，构建AI合规知识图谱；利用演化代理自动合成对抗性场景，并由AI法律专家全程参与审核与修正；构建4435+问答数据集，涵盖偏见歧视、公平性、个人隐私、价值观四大维度，包含上下文长程交互与逻辑驱动的风险链。
AI.result: 在GPT 5.5、Gemini 3.5 Flash、Claude Sonnet 5、DeepSeek V4、Qwen3.7等前沿LLM上的评测结果显示，这些模型在隐性与隐性、逻辑关系链、情境化合规风险检测方面存在显著盲点；现有Do-Not-Answer、TrustLLM、SafetyBench等基准在高级合规风险覆盖上严重不足。
AI.conclusion: EADC提供了一个与AI法律法规对齐的、严谨的高级深度合规评估基准，揭示了当前SOTA LLM在深层合规风险理解上的关键缺陷，为LLM应用中的高阶合规保障提供了系统化诊断工具。

title: TREND-10K: A Comprehensive Dataset for Next-Generation Video Quality Assessment Based on Preference-Driven Media
summary: The increasing prominence of short-video platforms, coupled with the advanced commercialization of AI-generated content (AIGC) videos, has led to a shift in the types of video media trend consumed by users in their daily lives. Traditional user-generated content (UGC) is gradually being replaced by professional short dramas and AIGC entertainment. Consequently, VQA for contemporary media content has become increasingly important. This requires a unified evaluation framework that can handle diverse video content and evolving media trends. In this context, we introduce TREND-10K, a next-generation comprehensive VQA dataset consisting of the trend-driven part and the static part, containing $10,000$ videos across a wide spectrum of content types. The trend-driven part is based on the TREND-Search framework, which captures user preference profiles from trending lists on online platforms and formulates sampling strategies based on these profiles. The static part, on the other hand, is composed of supplementary samples selected from publicly available datasets. To support unified evaluation for various video types, we incorporate three evaluation dimensions: technical, aesthetic, and AIGC-trace. Experiments show that our dataset ensures high annotation quality and exhibits remarkable generalization across multiple content categories. In conclusion, our work presents a robust framework for advancing VQA, addressing challenges caused by the temporal evolution of user perceptual habits and preferences.

AI.tldr: TREND-10K 是一个面向下一代视频质量评估（VQA）的综合性数据集，包含 10,000 个视频。它由"趋势驱动"部分和"静态"部分组成，涵盖技术、美学和 AIGC 痕迹三个评估维度，旨在解决传统 VQA 数据集在内容多样性和时效性方面的局限。
AI.motivation: 随着短视频平台兴起和 AIGC 视频的商业化，用户消费的视频内容从传统 UGC 转向专业短剧和 AIGC 内容。现有 VQA 数据集普遍存在内容类型单一、时间静态、缺乏更新机制等问题，无法适应快速演变的媒体趋势和新兴内容，因此需要构建一个能够持续适应媒体趋势演化的综合性 VQA 数据集。
AI.method: 1. **TREND-Search 系统**：自动从 YouTube 趋势列表（八个语言区域）抓取视频元数据，构建分类法（major category–subcategory–keyword 层次结构），并使用指数平滑策略聚合跨周期趋势，形成统一采样计划。2. **三步数据收集**：在线搜索与视频爬取（含内容筛选和元数据验证）；补充 T2V 生成（使用 Sora、VEO、Kling 等多个 SOTA 模型）；静态部分从开源数据集（VITAL-Pretrain、AIGVE-60K）重新标注。3. **三维主观评估**：技术质量、美学质量、AIGC 痕迹感知（1-5 Likert 量表，至少 15 名标注员/视频），采用训练机制、热身机制和异常值筛选保证标注质量。
AI.result: 1. **数据集质量**：IAA（Krippendorff's Alpha）在技术、美学、AIGC 痕迹维度上分别为 0.621、0.586、0.677；技术-美学分数高度正相关（SRCC=0.815）；AIGC 痕迹级别越高，技术-美学相关性越强（L4-L5 SRCC=0.907）。2. **数据集内评估**：VITAL 模型取得最佳平均性能（0.860），三个维度均表现优异。3. **跨数据集泛化**：在 TREND-10K 上训练的模型在 KVQ、FINEVD 等短视频数据集以及 AIGC 基准（AGAV-3K、AIGVQADB、GAIA）上表现优于或相当于 LSVQ 训练。4. **迁移学习**：在 LSVQ 预训练基础上微调 TREND-10K，在所有测试集上一致取得最佳泛化效果，VITAL 模型表现尤为突出。5. **联合训练效果**：DOVER++ 联合优化技术+美学标签略优于单维度监督。
AI.conclusion: TREND-10K 作为一个基于用户偏好驱动的新一代综合性 VQA 数据集，通过 TREND-Search 框架实现了自动化、动态化的数据采集流程，能够适应媒体趋势的持续演化。其三维评估框架（技术、美学、AIGC 痕迹）为多样化的视频内容提供了统一的感知质量评估标准。实验证明该数据集在预训练和微调方面均能有效提升 VQA 模型的泛化能力。未来计划每三到六个月更新一次数据集，并开源 TREND-Search 框架和标注平台，推动 VQA 社区发展。

title: Identifying Intelligent Processes via Online Sequential Testing
summary: Active sequential hypothesis testing studies how to identify an unknown hypothesis with a given set of sensing actions. We study this in the setting of identifying large language models (LLMs), \textit{i.e.}, if a user is conversing with an LLM drawn from a known set of models, how can they identify which one is in use? Here, the available sensing actions (evaluations) are themselves a design choice: an evaluator must first decide which environments and prompt families to construct, and only then decide how to use them sequentially. We formalize these two levels as an outer probe-design problem and an inner identification problem. Simply put, the outer stage selects a set of probes to be sent to the entire set of models, creating a kind of fingerprint dataset. This is followed by the inner stage, which sequentially sends a budget-minimizing set of those probes to identify the model in use. For the outer problem, we show that selecting which evaluations to construct at minimum cost, so that every pair of candidates is distinguished, is exactly a weighted set cover problem. Since the response distributions of the candidate models are not known exactly but only through calibration samples, we give a one-shot procedure that estimates the cover instance from these samples. For the inner problem, we bound the number of evaluations needed to identify the unknown model in terms of how well the available evaluations distinguish each pair of candidates.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在黑盒接口下识别未知大语言模型（LLM）的主动序贯假设检验问题，将其分解为外层探针设计问题（probe-design）和内层识别问题（identification）。外层问题通过构造探针模块的集合使所有候选模型两两可区分，被证明等价于加权集合覆盖问题；内层问题在固定评估集下给出基于两两分离裕度的序贯测试样本复杂度上界，并通过锦标赛式组合控制误差。此外，论文提出在仅有有限校准样本的情形下，利用单次（one-shot）均匀校准程序从经验频率中恢复近似的集合覆盖实例，并保证所得到的设计近似满足原始的分离性目标。
AI.motivation: 在黑盒访问条件下，如何以最小代价构造一组可用于区分多个候选 LLM 的探针（评估），并以尽可能少的交互轮数在线识别当前对话背后的模型。经典主动序贯假设检验假定感知动作已固定，但实际场景还需先决定构建哪些环境与提示族，存在外层设计问题。同时，模型的真实响应分布未知，只能从校准样本中估计，需要带有限样本保证的算法。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为两层：① 外层 probe-design：从有限带成本的探针模块集合 U 中选择子集 S，使每个模型对 (i,j) 都被某个被选模块以 ℓ₁ 距离至少 η 区分。证明此即加权集合覆盖，并给出 (16) 的整数规划。② 内层 identification：在固定动作集 A_S 上做贝叶斯序贯检验，给出后验置信停止规则 τ_δ，并证明 Proposition 3.3（Witness bound）：η-分离设计 S 给出 V_δ(γ_S;b_0) ≤ (M−1)⌈(8/η²) log((M−1)/δ)⌉，通过对每对构造二元假设检验后用锦标赛组合并用 Hoeffding + union bound 控制误差。③ 有限样本校准：利用两阈值 η_- < η_+ 与经验总变差距离，以每 (i,a) 对 n=⌈16Λ/g²⌉ 个样本（Λ=K log2+log(2mA₀/β)）构造经验覆盖集合 Ĉ_u，由 Hoeffding + 2^K A₀ m 的联合界得到 |d̂_ij(u)−d_ij(u)| ≤ g/2 的均匀保证（Lemma 4.1），进而得到 Theorem 4.2 的两边界（two-margin）保证：任意经验覆盖为 η_- 分离；若 η_+ 可分则 α-近似设计 Ŝ 满足 C(Ŝ) ≤ αC(S*_{η_+}) 且 V_δ ≤ (M−1)⌈(8/η_-²) log((M−1)/δ)⌉。
AI.result: 主要结论包括：1) 外层最小代价 η-分离设计 = 加权集合覆盖（Proposition 3.6）；2) 内层 η-分离设计给出上界 V_δ ≤ (M−1)⌈(8/η²) log((M−1)/δ)⌉（Theorem 3.3），同时证明 ℓ₁²/8 ≤ Jensen-Shannon 散度，提供信息论解释；3) 单次校准使用 nMA₀ 个样本即可在概率 1−β 下恢复近似覆盖实例（Theorem 4.2），保证经验可行性蕴含 η_- 分离，经验不可行则无 η_+ 分离设计，并保留近似比 α。
AI.conclusion: 本文为黑盒 LLM 识别建立了一个两层框架——外层探针设计被精确等价于加权集合覆盖，内层序贯识别在两两分离裕度下有显式样本复杂度上界。在仅有校准样本的实际情形下，给出的 one-shot 均匀校准程序能以可控样本量得到具有两边界保证的近似解，且该解继承了内层界：V_δ ≤ (M−1)⌈(8/η_-²) log((M−1)/δ)⌉。工作为在预算受限下构造评测套件并对未知 LLM 进行序贯判定提供了理论与算法基础。

title: RCShift: Certifying When Partial Linkage Suffices for Finite-Sample Decisions
summary: Systems with costly gold outcomes and cheaper auxiliary observations must decide how much record linkage to retain. Complete pairing retains every joint counter, while separate margins retain none. Neither endpoint is calibrated to a declared finite-sample decision. Universal reconstruction can retain cycle directions invisible to the likelihood-ratio family. Family-exact storage can exceed what the decision requires because certified residual loss may fit within finite-sample slack. We introduce RCShift, which certifies two routes to sufficiency under a declared observation contract. Its exact mode characterizes minimum-cost family-exact storage through LR-visible cycle directions. Its approximate mode bounds reverse Le Cam deficiency. Its integer mode certifies whether a chosen set preserves the full experiment's minimum integer record count at specified size and power. In a rank-two witness, one aligned counter preserves a four-record minimum. An equal-cost misaligned counter and the margins require eleven records, while universal reconstruction requires two counters.
